title: The poly(A) signal AAUAAA in the proximal 3'UTR is read as a stop-proximal PABP cue and suppresses the NMD verdict
element: The hexamer AAUAAA (and its principal variant AUUAAA) implanted in the 3'UTR half of the stop window, at fixed offsets +30/+60/+120/+240 nt downstream of the termination codon.
test: Extend the existing single-base harness (analysis_plans/measure_position_bank.py) from a 1-nt substitution to a 6-nt block substitution in the STOP branch, recomputing channel 5 over the filled span with the already-validated rolling_gc reimplementation (no-op floor 9.5e-7). Population: isoforms whose stop-window downstream half is FULLY FILLED (frame channels 6-8 on to the window edge, i.e. 3'UTR >= 500 nt at W=1000), so the model has no zero-padding 'transcript ends here' cue and cannot get 3'-end proximity for free; additionally exclude any isoform with a natural AAUAAA/AUUAAA in the implant footprint, and any footprint overlapping a channel-4 junction mark (overwriting a junction deletes an EJC, a catastrophic confound). Arms, all 6 nt at identical positions: (1) AAUAAA; (2) AUUAAA; (3-6) four permutations of the identical multiset {A,A,A,A,A,U} that are not functional signals -- AAAAUA, AAAUAA, UAAAAA, AAAAAU; (7) no-op re-implant of the observed hexamer as the method floor. Run the full offset panel plus a mirrored in-CDS panel upstream of the stop, all at the same offset mod 3. Replicate at a narrower stop-window checkpoint (stop500) where the fully-filled requirement admits a much larger eligible population.
matched_reference: Three references, per trap 1. (a) Method floor: the no-op re-implant, which must return ~1e-6. (b) Other positions: the four downstream offsets plus the in-CDS mirror, all frame-offset-matched, so a hexamer preference that exists everywhere is visible as such. (c) Matched population: the four permutation arms have the IDENTICAL mononucleotide multiset and contain zero G and zero C, so the G+C indicator that channel 5 is computed from is identically zero across every arm at every position -- channel 5 is bit-identical, not merely GC-balanced. This is the block generalisation of the A-vs-T operator the brief already identified as the only clean single-base operator.
would_refute: A null or sign-inconsistent per-isoform distribution (median Delta inside the control envelope for most isoforms) refutes it, and is a real result: it says the model's 3'UTR-length sensitivity is carried entirely by junction count and padding extent, not by the polyadenylation signal. Equally refuting: an effect of the same magnitude in the in-CDS mirror panel, or an effect that disappears once padded windows are excluded (which would mean the original signal was the padding cue, not the hexamer). A positive effect for the non-functional permutations of the same magnitude refutes motif identity in favour of A-richness.

title: A class-II AU-rich element downstream of the stop increases NMD susceptibility, and does so most where the EJC branch is silent
element: The nonamer UUAUUUAUU -- the canonical class-II ARE core, an AUUUA pentamer in a U-rich context -- implanted in the 3'UTR half of the stop window.
test: Same 9-nt block-implant harness in the STOP branch, fully-filled downstream windows only, junction-free footprints, no natural AUUUA in the footprint. Arms at identical positions: (1) UUAUUUAUU (one AUUUA pentamer); (2) an isolated-pentamer arm to test context grading; (3-6) four permutations of the identical multiset {U x 6, A x 3} that contain NO AUUUA pentamer -- e.g. UUUUAAUUU, AAUUUUUUA, UAUUUUUAU, and one further verified-clean arrangement; (7) no-op floor. Offsets +30/+60/+120/+240 downstream, frame-offset-matched, plus the in-CDS mirror. Stratify every readout by mechanism class from results_interp_all/mechanism_classes.tsv (PTC+, PTC- with upstream PTC-bearing ORF, PTC- no trigger, no reference-AUG anchor), because the mechanism-class interaction is a sharper falsification target than the marginal effect. Apply the bank's created-motif exclusions (created ATG, created in-frame stop) identically across ALL arms -- drop an isoform from every arm if any arm triggers an exclusion, or the two partitions stop being matched, which is trap 3's lesson generalised from positions to arrangements.
matched_reference: (a) Method floor: no-op re-implant. (b) Other positions: the offset panel and the in-CDS mirror. (c) Matched population: the control arms are permutations of the SAME nine letters, all A and U, so the G+C indicator is identically zero across all arms and channel 5 is bit-identical everywhere. This is the specific reason this design is worth running: an ARE is the most composition-extreme element in the transcriptome, an AU-vs-GC operator would be hopeless here (the brief reports 100% same-signed controls with |t| median 5.79 under a G-vs-notG operator), and permuting within a pure A/U multiset is the only way to ask about pentamer identity with the composition channel held exactly fixed. A further matched population: the same implant in isoforms whose slot-0 stop has no downstream junction, where there is no EJC-dependent verdict for an ARE to add to.
would_refute: A per-isoform distribution centred inside the control envelope refutes it. So does a positive effect that is flat across mechanism classes -- if an ARE moves PTC+ isoforms (already at 70% NMD+, logit near ceiling) as much as no-trigger isoforms, the effect is not interacting with the decay mechanism and is more likely an artifact of implanting a homopolymeric U-run. So does an effect present at every offset including inside the CDS. A negative here is informative and publishable in the discussion: it says the model's NMD signal is EJC-geometric and contains no generic 3'UTR-instability component, which sharpens what the model can be claimed to be a model of.

title: G-tract / G-quadruplex potential in the proximal 3'UTR increases NMD susceptibility, tested with an operator that holds the GC channel exactly fixed
element: A canonical quadruplex-forming tract, (GGGAAAA)3GGG (24 nt, four G3 runs with A-rich loops), implanted downstream of the termination codon; and the same element in the 5'UTR side of the ATG window as a second, differently-signed arm.
test: Block implant of 24 nt in the STOP branch (and separately in the ATG branch upstream region), fully-filled windows, junction-free footprints, no natural G3N1-7G3N1-7G3N1-7G3 in the footprint. THREE arms, chosen because they fail in orthogonal ways and no single control can hold everything fixed at once: (1) target (GGGAAAA)3GGG; (2) the G->C mirror (CCCAAAA)3CCC, which is channel-5 EXACT -- the G+C indicator is bit-identical position by position, since compute_rolling_gc sums the G and C rows -- but differs in G count, and does not form a quadruplex at physiological pH; (3) a permutation of the target's own multiset (G x 12, A x 12) with maximum G-run length 2, which holds G count, C count and length exactly and perturbs channel 5 only at block-interior positions, by an amount that is computed and reported per arrangement. An effect that survives BOTH controls is not explicable by either failure mode. Offsets +30/+60/+120/+240, frame-offset-matched, plus the in-CDS mirror. Stratify by the isoform's own downstream GC quartile, to check the effect is not confined to already-GC-rich backgrounds where a marginal G4 is not the differentiator.
matched_reference: (a) Method floor: no-op re-implant. (b) Other positions: the offset panel, the in-CDS mirror, and the 5'UTR arm. (c) Matched population: the G->C mirror is the block form of the G-vs-C operator the brief names as one of only two operators with a near-null reference, and here it is exact rather than approximate -- channel 5 is bit-identical between arms at every position. The permutation arm supplies the G-count match the mirror cannot. Reporting both is the honest statement that no single arm holds GC pattern and G count simultaneously at this composition.
would_refute: An effect on the mirror contrast that is not reproduced on the G-count-matched permutation contrast refutes the structural reading -- it would mean the model prefers G over C, which the brief already warns is confidently non-null at every position under a G-vs-notG operator. An effect present only in the top downstream-GC quartile refutes generality. A flat profile across offsets, or an equal-magnitude effect in the in-CDS mirror, refutes localisation. A 5'UTR arm with the same sign and magnitude as the 3'UTR arm argues the model has one generic G-tract response rather than a termination-context-specific one.

title: DRACH-forming arrangements of a fixed nucleotide multiset separate from non-DRACH arrangements, with a metagene peak just downstream of the stop
element: The m6A consensus DRACH, instantiated as GGACU, contrasted against non-DRACH arrangements of the identical multiset {G,G,A,C,U} (e.g. GGCAU), implanted at a positional panel spanning the stop codon.
test: Enumerate arrangements of {G,G,A,C,U} (60 distinct strings), partition into DRACH-matching ([AGU][AG]AC[ACU]) and non-matching, and implant every arrangement at each of a frame-offset-matched panel: -60, -30, +15, +30, +60, +120, +240 relative to the stop-codon centre. Subsample to ~20 arrangements per partition and ~500 isoforms if the full grid is too large. Fully-filled windows, junction-free footprints, no natural DRACH in the footprint. Created-motif exclusions applied at the ISOFORM level across all arrangements jointly -- drop the isoform from every arm if any single arrangement triggers an exclusion, otherwise the partitions cease to be matched. For each arrangement compute the induced max |delta channel 5| against the background and carry it as a per-arrangement covariate.
matched_reference: (a) Method floor: no-op re-implant. (b) Other positions: the seven-offset panel, which is also the primary structured prediction. (c) Matched population: the two partitions are arrangements of the IDENTICAL mononucleotide multiset, so total GC is exactly equal and only sub-block positional GC differs; that residual is bounded, computable per arrangement, and entered as a covariate, with the separation re-reported within strata of it. This is the one design in my set where channel-5 invariance is approximate rather than exact, which is stated up front rather than discovered later.
would_refute: No per-isoform separation between partitions refutes it. A separation with no stop-proximal peak refutes the m6A reading specifically, even if the contrast is non-zero, because a level shift is explicable by the residual GC positional difference. A separation that vanishes once the channel-5 covariate is conditioned on refutes it outright. Honest prior: I expect this to come out negative -- the model has no methylation information and DRACH is degenerate and ubiquitous -- and its main value is as a cheap, composition-controlled calibration of whether the stop branch responds to ANY RBP-motif-scale element, which sets how much to believe H1-H3.

title: A CU-rich PTBP1-type element is a PROTECTIVE 3'UTR element, and its opposite sign is the control that validates the whole element family
element: (CU)10 -- a 20-nt CU-repeat polypyrimidine tract of the kind PTBP1 binds -- implanted downstream of the termination codon, contrasted against (CA)10.
test: Block implant of 20 nt in the STOP branch, fully-filled windows, junction-free footprints, no natural pyrimidine tract of comparable length in the footprint. Arms at identical positions: (1) (CU)10; (2) (CA)10 as the exactly GC-invariant reference; (3) (CCU)6CC as the graded arm (longer uninterrupted pyrimidine runs bind PTBP1 better, so a larger effect is predicted); (4) a phase-shifted (UC)10 as the phase control; (5) no-op floor. Offsets +30/+60/+120/+240, frame-offset-matched, plus the in-CDS mirror. Stratify by n_downstream_ejc (already a tabular feature, results_4ct_dn/selected_orfs.tsv) into 1 / 2 / >=3, and test the predicted monotone decline in effect magnitude. Finally, run the cross-hypothesis coherence check: if H1-H5 all move the logit the same direction, the correct conclusion is that none of them is an element and the family is measuring implant-versus-background.
matched_reference: (a) Method floor: no-op re-implant. (b) Other positions: the offset panel and the in-CDS mirror. (c) Matched population: (CU)10 and (CA)10 both contain exactly ten C and zero G at the identical alternating positions, so the G+C indicator vector is bit-identical and channel 5 is exactly equal at every window position; the arms differ only in whether the interleaved base is a pyrimidine or a purine, i.e. PTBP1 site versus hnRNP L CA-repeat. Both arms are also biologically real elements rather than one being a scramble, which is a stronger comparison than motif-versus-nonsense. (d) A fourth reference unique to this hypothesis: the SIGN of H2 and H3 measured in the same isoforms under the same harness.
would_refute: A positive or null per-isoform distribution refutes the protective reading. A flat profile across n_downstream_ejc strata refutes the interaction with mechanism and argues for an artifact. Most importantly, if this element moves the logit in the SAME direction as the ARE and the G-tract, the whole family is refuted at once -- the model is detecting perturbation, not element identity -- and that single result would be worth more than any of the five individual positives.

title: Retained-intron donor signature: an unspliced MAG↓GURAGU with no junction mark on it
element: The 9-mer spanning an unspliced exon–intron boundary, canonically CAG|GTAAGT (5′ss consensus MAG↓GURAGU), present CONTIGUOUSLY in the mature transcript at a position where channel 4 is zero. Its 3′ mirror is the retained intron's acceptor end, YYYYNCAG↓ — a polypyrimidine tract that is visible to this model only here, because in every properly spliced transcript the PPT and branch point have been removed before the model ever sees the sequence.
test: Permutation-panel implant in encoded space, directly on results_4ct_dn/nmd_orf_data.h5 (no FASTA needed). At a fixed offset o in the stop window's downstream half, overwrite a 6-nt block with each of the 90 distinct permutations of the multiset {G,G,A,A,T,T}; GTAAGT is one of them. Repeat at three codon offsets o, o+1, o+2, and independently in the ATG window's upstream half (5′UTR intron retention). Run all 5 seeds at atg1000_stop1000. Arm 2 (the specificity arm): run the identical 90-permutation panel twice, once with channel 4 off at the implant point (unspliced) and once with channel 4 on (spliced boundary); the statistic is the difference-in-differences of the donor's rank between the two conditions. Arm 3: extend to the 12-nt block CAGGTAAGTA to test the full boundary, and to a 15-nt pyrimidine-run block for the acceptor mirror. Arm 4 (real data): stratify by SQANTI structural category intron_retention from the classification file and predict the implant effect SATURATES (is smaller) in transcripts that already carry a retained intron.
matched_reference: Three references, as trap 1 demands. (i) Method noise floor: the 89 non-donor permutations, which share the EXACT mononucleotide multiset, so channel 5 (rolling GC) is bit-identical across the whole panel and channels 4, 6–8 are untouched — the only varying input is nucleotide ORDER. Trap 2 is eliminated, not matched. (ii) Other positions: the same panel at a second offset ≥100 nt away, and in the opposite window (atg_cnn and stop_cnn are separate modules, so a donor detector living in one and not the other is meaningful). (iii) Matched population: within the panel, compare the donor only against permutations sharing its created-motif status at that offset — creates in-frame stop / creates ATG / creates an MAG — which is trap 3 handled at the level of the individual control string rather than the position.
would_refute: GTAAGT ranks at the median of its own 90-permutation panel in most isoforms; or its apparent advantage disappears once permutations are stratified on created-in-frame-stop status (meaning the 'effect' was TAA inside GTAAGT, not the donor); or the effect is the same size with channel 4 on as with it off (meaning the model reads a G/T-rich 6-mer, not an unspliced boundary); or the reverse complement ACTTAC scores as high (no strand/orientation specificity).

title: The exonic junction shadow: MAG↓G as a sequence-only junction detector redundant with channel 4
element: The exonic halves of the two splice sites — (C/A)AG at the last three bases of an exon and G at the first base of the next — which are the ONLY splice-site information surviving into a mature mRNA. Because junctions are computed as cumsum(exon_lengths)[-n] (export_rds.R:286), the channel-4 mark sits exactly on the exonic G at donor position −1, so the element straddles window indices j−2 … j+1 as MAG|G.
test: Arm A (implant): 12 distinct permutations of the multiset {C,A,G,G} implanted at matched offsets in the stop window's downstream half, WITHOUT setting channel 4; per-isoform rank of CAGG. Arm B (redundancy, the decisive one): run the same panel at positions where a real junction mark already exists vs. positions with no mark, in the same isoforms. A genuine sequence-only detector predicts (i) implanting CAGG at an UNMARKED position shifts the logit in the same direction as turning the mark on, and (ii) the shift is sub-additive where the mark is already present. Arm C (capability, held out): ONE retrain with channel 4 DELETED from the tensor and n_downstream_ejc deleted from the tabular block (7 channels, 4 tabular), against a matched control retrain in which channel 4 is position-SHUFFLED within each transcript and n_downstream_ejc is permuted across isoforms — same tensor shape, same parameter count, same optimization, information destroyed. The contrast is delete-vs-shuffle, and the question is how much AUPRC the sequence-only model recovers over the shuffled-information control.
matched_reference: For A/B: the other 11 permutations of {C,A,G,G} — composition-identical, so channel 5 is bit-identical and a general 'more G is better' preference (the failure mode that killed the Kozak +4 result, brief §5) is inside the control set rather than outside it. For C: the shuffled-channel retrain, matched on architecture, dimensionality, data, epochs and seed set, differing only in whether channel 4 carries real positions.
would_refute: CAGG ranks at chance in its own panel; or the implant effect is identical at marked and unmarked positions (no redundancy structure, so no detector); or the channel-4-deleted model's AUPRC is statistically indistinguishable from the shuffled-channel control, meaning junction position is genuinely not recoverable from this input and the brief's §2 concern stands unmitigated.

title: Junction phase relative to the start codon: exon asymmetry (non-3n boundaries) as an NMD element
element: The PHASE of an exon–exon junction relative to the ORF's AUG — equivalently, whether the cumulative exon length up to that junction is a multiple of 3. Exon-boundary phase is set entirely by where the splice sites fall, so it is a sequence-determined property; asymmetric (non-3n) exons are the canonical frame-disrupting alternative-splicing class.
test: The operator is: MOVE a junction mark by ±1, ±2, ±3 nt and touch nothing else. Channels 0–3 and 5 are literally unchanged (no nucleotide is edited, so the rolling GC over the 50-nt support is identical), channels 6–8 are unchanged, and only channel 4's index moves. Compute, per isoform and per junction, Δlogit(shift 1 or 2) − Δlogit(shift 3). Run over all junctions inside the stop window's downstream half and, separately, inside the ATG window. Second, non-perturbative arm: partition real isoforms by the phase of the LAST junction relative to the reference AUG and ask whether the model's residual — after conditioning on n_downstream_ejc, which the brief's branch decomposition says dominates — carries phase information. Conditioning on the EJC count rather than on the annotated ORF keeps this clear of trap 6. Decisive spuriousness control: restrict a subset to junctions whose bases at j, j±1, j±2, j±3 are all identical (homopolymer context), where a 'the model learned mark-on-a-G' explanation predicts no shift effect while the phase explanation still predicts one.
matched_reference: Shift-by-3 is the matched reference and it is matched on exactly the right things: same displacement magnitude class, same 'the mark moved off its original base' status, same number of edited channel-4 entries, phase PRESERVED. Second reference: the same shift protocol applied to junctions in the ATG window upstream of the AUG, where phase relative to the AUG is defined but frame disruption of the main ORF is not the mechanism. Third: the 5 seeds give the method's own noise floor.
would_refute: Shift-1/2 and shift-3 produce indistinguishable Δlogits — meaning phase is never computed. This is a likely outcome and an informative one: with 32 conv channels per branch, a phase-conditioned junction detector may simply never have been worth a filter, and a clean negative would bound what 'the model learned the EJC rule' can mean (it would have learned existence and count, never symmetry). The result is also refuted as PHASE if the effect vanishes in the homopolymer-context subset, which would reassign it to the identity of the base under the mark.

title: Stop-to-junction spacing: measuring the escape distance instead of assuming 50 nt
element: The spacing, in nucleotides, between an in-frame stop codon and the exonic half-site of the next downstream exon–exon junction. Spacing greater than the escape distance is the element that raises susceptibility; spacing below it is the last-exon/50-nt escape. This is a positional sequence element — it is set by where the terminal splice sites fall relative to where the ORF terminates — and it is NOT in the tabular block: n_downstream_ejc is a COUNT (METHODS.md:401), never a distance.
test: Restrict to isoforms with exactly ONE junction downstream of the stop inside the stop window. Move that mark to distance d ∈ {6, 10, 14, …, 200} nt downstream of the stop while HOLDING n_downstream_ejc fixed at its real value, so the tabular feature cannot be what responds, and read Δlogit(d) per isoform across the 5 seeds. The architecture makes a sharp prediction: any genuine distance response must be confined to d ≲ 42 nt (the conv2 receptive field) and quantized at ~4 nt (the post-mid_pool jump), and FLAT beyond, because past the receptive field the encoder can only report that a junction exists somewhere in the window. A response extending well past 42 nt falsifies my model of the encoder and points at a channel-5 or pooling-edge artifact instead. Follow-up ONLY if the primary arm shows a breakpoint pinned at the receptive-field limit: one retrain with conv2 widened (k2 = 15, RF = 18 + 14·4 = 74 nt) or dilated, which makes the escape distance MEASURABLE rather than clipped, and the success criterion is the LOCATION of the breakpoint in the distance sweep — a measurement, not a credit assignment, so it is not the branch-Shapley-share criterion killed in §6.
matched_reference: (i) The same sweep with the mark placed UPSTREAM of the stop at matched |d| — upstream junctions are not NMD-triggering, so this reference should be flat or opposite-signed, and it is matched on every channel-editing operation performed. (ii) The same sweep on reference-CDS ORFs with n_downstream_ejc = 0, where no distance effect should exist. (iii) The 5 independent seeds as the method's noise floor; a breakpoint claim requires seed agreement on the LOCATION, not merely on the sign — brief §6 already established that across-member sign agreement alone is worthless (65–92% at meaningless positions).
would_refute: Δlogit(d) is flat across the whole 6–200 nt sweep (the model reads existence, never distance); or the response is identical for upstream and downstream placements (it reads 'a mark moved', not 'a mark moved relative to the stop'); or the fitted breakpoint sits exactly at 42 nt with no seed-to-seed spread, in which case the number is the receptive field and NOT biology — and the honest conclusion is that the escape distance is not measurable with the current checkpoints, which is why the widened-conv2 retrain is stated as the price of a real number.

title: hnRNP A1 exonic silencer UAGGGA, tested apart from the stop codon it contains
element: The hnRNP A1 exonic splicing silencer TAGGGA / TAGGGT and, as a contrast, the SRSF1-class exonic enhancer GGAGGA — hexamers that act in EXONIC sequence and therefore survive splicing into the mature transcript, unlike the branch point and polypyrimidine tract. Tested within 50 nt of an exon boundary and, separately, at boundary-distant positions.
test: Permutation panel over the multiset {T,A,G,G,G,A} — 60 distinct arrangements, all composition-identical so channel 5 is bit-identical — implanted at fixed offsets in BOTH the ATG window's upstream half and the stop window's downstream half, at three codon offsets, across the 5 seeds. The whole design turns on one confound handled head-on: TAGGGA CONTAINS TAG, and at one of the three offsets it creates an in-frame stop. So each permutation is labelled by its created-motif status at that offset (creates in-frame stop / creates ATG / creates an MAG junction-consensus), and TAGGGA is ranked ONLY against permutations sharing its label. Second arm: the same protocol for GGAGGA over the multiset {G,G,A,G,G,A} (15 arrangements) with the opposite predicted sign. Third arm, real data: is the implant effect larger at positions within 50 nt of a real channel-4 mark than at boundary-distant positions, matched on offset and on local GC?
matched_reference: (i) The 59 composition-identical permutations of {T,A,G,G,G,A}, subsetted to those matched on created-motif status at the same codon offset — this is trap 2 eliminated (channel 5 identical) and trap 3 handled per control string rather than per position. (ii) The GGAGGA enhancer panel as a signed reference: a real silencer/enhancer distinction predicts opposite directions, whereas an AU-richness artifact predicts the enhancer panel to be flat or same-signed. (iii) Boundary-proximal vs boundary-distant placement, matched on offset and local GC, as the positional reference.
would_refute: TAGGGA ranks at chance among created-stop-matched permutations (the apparent effect was the TAG, i.e. stop-codon creation, not the silencer motif); or GGAGGA moves the prediction in the SAME direction as TAGGGA (the model reads composition/low-complexity, not regulatory identity); or the effect shows no boundary-proximity dependence, which would strip the splicing interpretation even if the hexamer effect is real. Any one of these kills the splicing-fidelity reading, and the honest fallback is 'a hexamer with an effect and no mechanism'.

title: The transcript 3' end is in the input as a padding boundary, and stop-to-poly(A) distance is read as a threshold, not a distance
element: The transcript 3' cleavage/poly(A) site — the last nucleotide of the mature SQANTI transcript — and its nucleotide distance from the stop codon (the 3'UTR length). In the input this element exists in exactly one place: the boundary between filled one-hot sequence and all-zero padding in the downstream half of the stop window. data_prep.encode_window_v5 allocates np.zeros((9, win_size)) and fills only arr_start:arr_end with w_end = min(seq_len, end), so all nine channels — including frame channels 6-8 — are identically zero beyond the transcript end. measure_position_bank.frame_span() already recovers that boundary from channels 6-8.
test: Filled-extent operator on the stop window, two arms, using results_4ct_sweep checkpoints at atg1000_stop1000 (half_win = 500) and atg2000_stop2000 (half_win = 1000), 5 seeds each. Cohort: ref-CDS slots with n_downstream_ejc == 0 and observed 3'UTR in [150, 900] nt so the boundary can be placed both inside and outside the window (n = 20,811 EJC-free ref-CDS slots available; subsample 2,000, gene-stratified). For each isoform, rebuild the stop window with the filled extent's right edge set to L in {100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500, 700, 900, unclipped}: TRUNCATE by zeroing all nine channels beyond the new edge; EXTEND by generating new bases from a Markov-1 chain fit on that isoform's own 3'UTR (this is sequence GENERATION of arbitrary length, not the dead dinucleotide-preserving shuffle of a 3-mer, which is the identity map only because a 3-mer has one valid arrangement). Then recompute channel 5 over the new extent with measure_position_bank.recompute_gc, and refill channels 6-8 by continuing (pos - orf_start_0based) % 3 exactly as data_prep.py:207-211 does. ARM A: sequence-only, frac_stop held at its observed value. ARM B: frac_stop updated to orf_end / (orf_end + L) so the tabular block is coherent with the sequence. Arm B minus Arm A isolates the tabular route from the sequence route — available cleanly only because ORF_FEATURE_COLS carries frac_stop = orf_end/tx_length, a RATIO, so absolute 3'UTR length is nowhere in the tabular block. Record per-isoform Δ log-odds vs a no-op re-encode through the identical rebuild path.
matched_reference: Three references, as trap 1 requires. (1) Method noise floor: the no-op rebuild at the observed extent, which ANALYSIS4 measured as exactly 0.0 against a recomputed baseline. (2) Other geometry: the identical extent operator applied to the ATG window's UPSTREAM edge (distance to the transcript 5' end), same isoforms, same recomputation, same L grid — no NMD mechanism predicts a monotone effect there, and it carries the identical max-pool sample-size artifact. (3) Matched population: the same operator on ref-CDS slots with n_downstream_ejc >= 1 (n = 7,912), matched to the EJC-free set on observed 3'UTR length, stop-window GC, and slot-0 attention weight. This matching is not optional — the observed 3'UTR medians differ strongly by EJC stratum (EJC-free 875 nt NMD+ vs 1,115 nt control; EJC+ 1,957 vs 1,809), so 3'UTR length and EJC count are confounded in the marginal and in opposite directions.
would_refute: A flat per-isoform slope with a null step (median slope ~0, fraction positive ~0.5, step within the control-geometry distribution) refutes the claim that the model encodes 3'UTR length at all. An effect of equal size at the ATG window's upstream edge refutes it as 3'UTR-specific and relabels it a max-pool sample-size artifact. An effect that is identical in the EJC>=1 matched population refutes 'EJC-independent'. An effect present only in Arm B refutes the sequence-side claim and relocates it to the tabular ratio. Note that the marginal association here runs the WRONG WAY in the EJC-free stratum (NMD+ 3'UTRs are shorter), so a null is a live and unsurprising outcome; a positive causal result would be a genuine model-as-instrument finding that the marginal hides.

title: Implanting the canonical poly(A) signal AAUAAA near the stop codon is protective, and beats its own five composition-identical permutations
element: The canonical polyadenylation signal hexamer AAUAAA (DNA AATAAA), and the ATTAAA variant, sitting at a defined nucleotide offset downstream of the stop codon in the 3'UTR — i.e. within the filled downstream half of the stop window. It is nowhere in the tabular block; ORF_FEATURE_COLS has frac_start, frac_stop, is_ref_cds, is_sqanti_cds, n_downstream_ejc and nothing about 3' motifs.
test: Implant-vs-permutation at controlled offsets. Cohort: N = 1,500 ref-CDS slots whose observed 3'UTR is >= 600 nt, so EVERY implant offset lands in real sequence and the padding-extent confound of H1 is structurally excluded (report the per-offset unpadded count beside every number, as ANALYSIS4 requires); and which contain no exact AATAAA or ATTAAA anywhere in the stop window, screened by exact 6-mer match on channels 0-3. At offsets d in {+20, +50, +100, +150, +250, +400} nt downstream of the stop codon's last base, overwrite 6 nt with each of the SEVEN sequences: AATAAA and its five other distinct arrangements of the multiset {A x 5, T x 1} — TAAAAA, ATAAAA, AAATAA, AAAATA, AAAAAT — plus a no-op. Then recompute channel 5 over the filled extent via recompute_gc. Channels 4 and 6-8 are untouched: an implant creates no junction and does not change frame. This is a WINDOW-LOCAL edit, so the model's five ORF slots are fixed and the effect measured is the encoder's response, not a re-selection — stated as scope, not hidden. Cross-check axis: 09_export_polya.py already joins SQANTI polyA_motif_found / polyA_dist to predictions; ask whether per-isoform implant response predicts which isoforms SQANTI independently calls motif-positive.
matched_reference: Three. (1) Noise floor: the no-op re-encode at each offset. (2) Other sequences at the same position: the five permutations of AATAAA are EXACTLY mononucleotide-composition-matched — same 5 A + 1 T, same GC (zero), so channel 5 changes identically to the base for all six implants. This is the direct answer to trap 2 ('composition dominates identity'): the operator is composition-neutral by construction, not by hoping. It escapes the dead 'dinucleotide-preserving shuffle of a 3-mer' because that failed only for the degenerate reason that 100% of 3-mers have exactly one valid arrangement; a 6-mer with 5 A and 1 T has six. (3) Matched population / other positions: the identical 7-way implant in the ATG window at the mirrored offsets UPSTREAM of the start codon, where no poly(A)-signal mechanism operates, same isoforms, same recomputation. Frame offset is matched by construction because all six implants sit at identical coordinates (trap 3).
would_refute: AATAAA ranking at chance within its permutation set (median rank ~3.5 of 7) refutes the identity claim and leaves only A-richness. A flat offset profile refutes the proximity/PABPC1 claim even if the identity effect is real. A protective effect of the same size in the mirrored ATG-window implant refutes 3' specificity. A POSITIVE (NMD-promoting) sign would refute the PABPC1-antagonist mechanism as stated and would be reportable as such.

title: The junction-free run length from the stop codon is a distinct element from the downstream-EJC count, and channel 4 permits the only perfectly composition-neutral operator in this input
element: The uninterrupted junction-free run of 3'UTR extending from the stop codon to the next exon-exon junction, or to the transcript 3' end if there is none — its length in nucleotides. In the input this is a run of zeros in channel 4 downstream of the stop-window centre, terminated either by a 1 (junction) or by the padding boundary. It is a DISTANCE; n_downstream_ejc is a COUNT; the two are never separated in the current pipeline.
test: Channel-4 insertion sweep, two arms. Cohort: ref-CDS slots with n_downstream_ejc == 0 and 3'UTR >= 600 nt (so the whole d grid is unpadded), N = 2,000 gene-stratified. For each isoform set encoded[4, idx] = 1.0 at a single position d in {+20, +40, +55, +75, +100, +150, +250, +400} nt downstream of the stop codon's last base, one position at a time. Nothing else changes: no nucleotide channel moves, GC is exactly unchanged, frame is exactly unchanged. ARM A: sequence-only, n_downstream_ejc held at 0. ARM B: n_downstream_ejc incremented to 1 for d > 50 (coherent with the rule ORFik applied). Arm B minus Arm A separates the CNN's positional reading of channel 4 from the tabular count's contribution — the brief reports the structural branch at 59-78% of mean absolute displacement with EJC count dominating, but no analysis has ever separated positional from count. Reverse control within isoform: on slots that DO carry a junction in the stop window, delete the mark (set channel 4 to 0) and measure the mirror effect. This is not the dead inference-time flag ablation: that failed because zeroing a flag shrank control positions (0.66x) alongside targets (0.42x), i.e. it measured attention dilution; here the operator is a single-position edit inside a channel that is 1 at a handful of positions in the unperturbed input, both arms include a coherent-tabular version, and the reference is other POSITIONS in the same channel rather than the flag's presence versus absence.
matched_reference: Three. (1) Noise floor: no-op re-encode. (2) Other positions: the same single-mark insertion swept across the UPSTREAM half of the stop window and across the ATG window, where a junction is common in real data but where no downstream-EJC mechanism applies; this is the position reference that the flag-ablation failure lacked. (3) Matched population: the same sweep on slots with n_downstream_ejc >= 1, matched on 3'UTR length and attention — if the effect is the model counting rather than measuring, adding one more mark to a slot that already has three should behave differently from adding the first. Crucially, the operator's ON-MANIFOLD status is stronger here than for any nucleotide operator: the model's sequence is MATURE mRNA, so splice-site motifs (GT/AG) are in the excised introns and are absent from the input at real junctions too. A channel-4 mark therefore carries almost no local nucleotide correlate in the training data either. Residual correlation (exonic splicing enhancer composition near junctions) is controlled by matching insertion positions on local 6-mer composition and by the within-isoform deletion mirror.
would_refute: A pure step at d ~ 50 with zero post-step slope refutes the EJC-free-run claim and confirms the canonical rule as the whole story — a clean, publishable negative for my lens. Zero step AND zero slope in Arm A with a full effect in Arm B refutes any CNN positional reading of channel 4 and relocates all junction evidence to the tabular count. An equal-magnitude effect for marks inserted UPSTREAM of the stop refutes the whole probe as an artifact of perturbing channel 4 at all.

title: 3'UTR GC composition downstream of the stop is the EJC-independent element, tested by block resampling rather than single-base substitution
element: The GC fraction of the 200-nt block of 3'UTR immediately downstream of the stop codon (and, as a dose series, of successive 200-nt blocks out to +600). A compositional property of a named, localized region — which section 8 admits as a sequence element.
test: Block resample at targeted GC. Cohort: ref-CDS slots with 3'UTR >= 800 nt so all three blocks are unpadded; N = 2,000, split by EJC stratum. For each isoform and each block B in {+0..+200, +200..+400, +400..+600}, replace the block with sequence generated from a Markov-1 chain fit on that isoform's own 3'UTR but reweighted to a target GC in {0.30, 0.40, observed, 0.55, 0.65}, five draws per target with different seeds. Recompute channel 5 over the filled extent with recompute_gc; channels 4 and 6-8 untouched; padding extent unchanged, so H1's boundary confound is held fixed. Exclusion screen, applied identically at every target (trap 3 on frame-matched exclusions): reject any draw that creates an AATAAA/ATTAAA hexamer (which would contaminate with H2's element) or that changes the count of in-frame stop codons within the block, and report the per-target exclusion rate beside every effect, since exclusion rates are known to differ by 23.6% vs 8.7% across conditions here.
matched_reference: Three. (1) Noise floor and the resampling artifact: the SAME block resampled at the isoform's OBSERVED GC, five draws — this is the reference the contrast is taken against, so 'resampling at all' is differenced out and only GC varies. This is how the design escapes trap 2, which killed the single-base GC operator: that operator failed because one base moves the 50-nt rolling GC across 50 positions and control positions were 100% same-signed with median |t| 5.79, i.e. every position looked confident. Here GC is moved by design over a 200-nt block and the null is a same-length, same-position, same-generator resample at unchanged GC. (2) Other positions: the identical block-resample operator applied to a 200-nt block of 5'UTR in the ATG window, same isoforms, same targets, same exclusions. (3) Matched population: the EJC>=1 stratum matched on 3'UTR length and block GC — if the effect is EJC-independent NMD it should be attenuated where the EJC trigger is already satisfied.
would_refute: A per-isoform slope indistinguishable from the observed-GC resample reference refutes the compositional claim. An equal slope in the 5'UTR block refutes 3' specificity and says the model has a global GC preference — which the project has already been caught by once and which this design is built to detect rather than to avoid. No proximity gradient (slope at +0..200 equal to slope at +400..600) refutes the termination-coupled part of the mechanism while leaving a bulk-composition effect. An equal or larger slope in the EJC+ stratum refutes 'EJC-independent'.

title: The terminal 3'UTR is structurally invisible to the model for most slots; anchor a third window at the transcript 3' end and see whether that recovers EJC-independent NMD
element: Terminal-3'UTR sequence within 1,000 nt of the transcript 3' end — the poly(A) signal, the downstream U/GU-rich element, and terminal AU-rich tracts — as a class. Measured here: at the selected atg500_stop500 configuration (half_win = 250) only 12.0% of the 209,174 selected ORF slots have their 3' terminus inside the stop window; at stop1000, 24.0%; at stop2000, 43.1%. For ref-CDS slots specifically, mean 3'UTR is 1,728 nt. So for roughly three quarters of slots the terminal 3'UTR is not in the input at all, at any width the project has trained.
test: Retrain with a third encoder branch. Add a `three_prime_end` window of width 1000, centred on the transcript's last base (so half is real sequence, half is padding for every isoform — a constant, hence uninformative, geometry), encoded by the existing encode_window_v5 with a CLIP at the stop codon so it can never re-read what the stop window reads. That clip is not optional: the code's own midpoint-clip rationale (data_prep.py:246-269) is that overlapping windows make the branch decomposition meaningless and make it width-dependent, and the same failure would recur here. Fuse as a fourth term, Linear(128 -> 64) instead of Linear(96 -> 64), everything else unchanged. Train 5 seeds, identical schedule and chromosome split (test chr1/3/5/7, val chr2/4). CONTROL RETRAIN, run in the same batch: an identical architecture whose third window is anchored at the transcript's FIRST base, clipped at the start codon — exactly the same parameter count, same schedule, same seeds, only the anchor differs. Then, on the 3'-anchored model only, run the ANALYSIS4 padding-aware positional profile at the new anchor to read out which offsets from the cleavage site carry the evidence, and check whether the peak coincides with -10 to -30 (the poly(A) signal window) before any motif is claimed.
matched_reference: The 5'-terminus-anchored control retrain is the matched reference and it is matched on the only thing that would otherwise explain a gain: parameter count, fusion width, optimizer, schedule, seeds, split, and the amount of additional sequence the model sees. It differs in one bit — which end of the transcript the third window is anchored to. Second reference: the PTC+ stratum inside the 3'-anchored model itself, where the canonical EJC mechanism already explains the label and no terminal-3'UTR gain is predicted. Third: the existing 10 sweep checkpoints (atg1000_stop1000, atg2000_stop2000, 5 seeds each) bound the seed-to-seed AUPRC spread, which is the noise floor any ΔAUPRC must clear.
would_refute: ΔAUPRC within seed noise in every stratum refutes the claim that terminal-3'UTR sequence carries recoverable NMD information. A ΔAUPRC gain that is equal in the 5'-anchored control refutes the anchor and attributes it to capacity or to 'more sequence'. A gain that is equal in PTC+ and in PTC- no-trigger refutes 'EJC-independent' and suggests a transcript-length proxy — testable directly by checking whether the gain survives matching on tx_length. No concentration of the positional profile near -10 to -30 refutes the poly(A)-signal interpretation even if the AUPRC gain is real, in which case the element is unresolved and the finding stops at 'terminal 3'UTR sequence', which is still a nameable region.

title: The 50-nt rule is absent from the tabular block: stop→nearest-junction spacing as a local co-occurrence element
element: The nucleotide spacing d between the termination codon and the NEAREST downstream exon–exon junction. Operationally: a junction mark lying within ~42 nt 3′ of the stop (canonical last-junction escape, ribosome displaces the EJC) versus the identical junction placed beyond that distance (retained EJC, UPF1 assembly, decay).
test: GROUNDING (verified, not assumed): `n_downstream_ejc` is the unthresholded count of junctions with position > orf_end — 100% agreement with a raw recount over 1,211 slot-0 ORFs sampled from results_4ct_dn/selected_orfs.tsv. It therefore scores a junction 8 nt downstream identically to one 707 nt downstream. Among slot-0 ORFs with ≥1 downstream junction, the nearest sits at ≤42 nt in 25.4%, at 43–55 nt in 6.2%, and >200 nt in 14.9% (percentiles 8/42/83/148/707 nt at 5/25/50/75/95). So a quarter of 'EJC-positive' slots are textbook escapers that the tabular feature calls triggers, and the only place the distinction can live is channel 4 inside conv2's receptive field, which I recomputed from model.py as exactly 42 nt (conv1 k=15 → MaxPool1d(4) → conv2 k=7 spans input [4j−19, 4j+22]).  TEST — junction-relocation ladder on the stop branch. Donor set: slot-0 ORFs with n_downstream_ejc ≥ 1 whose nearest downstream junction is at d0 > 200 nt (~15% of eligible slots; thousands). For each donor, move that single channel-4 mark to d ∈ {6,12,18,24,30,36,42,48,55,70,100,150}, leaving nucleotide channels 0–3, rolling-GC channel 5, frame channels 6–8, and the ENTIRE tabular block bit-identical (n_downstream_ejc is unchanged by construction, so nothing the structural branch reads moves). Score all five checkpoints; record Δlog-odds(d) − Δlog-odds(d0) per isoform per member. Sample d on a 6-nt grid so the mid-pool's 4-nt quantization cannot alias with the hypothesized 42–55 nt knee. Reuses the cached-forward-pass pattern of analysis_plans/measure_position_bank.py; needs a new stop-branch operator (the existing bank is start-window only). Escalation arm if a knee appears: retrain with conv2 DILATED (dilation 4, k=7, RF ≈ 114 nt) — identical parameter count, receptive field the only variable — and re-run the ladder on the same donors to ask whether the knee moves to 50–55 nt (the data taught it the real rule) or stays pinned at 42 (the old knee was the receptive-field edge).
matched_reference: Three references, per trap 1. (a) METHOD NOISE FLOOR: relocate the mark to d ∈ {250,300,400} — all far outside the receptive field and mechanistically interchangeable, so their spread is the operator's own noise. (b) OTHER POSITIONS: the mirrored relocation UPSTREAM of the stop at matched |d| (−6 … −150). An upstream junction is translated over and its EJC displaced, so it does not trigger; the mark has the same channel, the same count, and the same distance from the window anchor, making this the tightest possible geometric control — a knee there is artifact, not biology. (c) MATCHED POPULATION: the identical operator in the ATG window of the same slot at the same anchor-relative offsets, where junction position carries no termination meaning.
would_refute: A flat Δlog-odds(d) curve within the noise floor from reference (a) in the large majority of donors — the model's EJC competence is entirely the count and the 50-nt rule is not encoded. Equally refuting: a knee of the same magnitude and location in the upstream mirror (b), which would make it a window-geometry artifact. Both are live outcomes and both are publishable, since the brief currently asserts 'EJC count dominates' without ever having asked whether spacing is represented.

title: In-silico nonsense ladder: PTC position along the ORF, and the AUG-proximity escape element
element: The position of a premature termination codon along the coding sequence — specifically (i) a PTC within ~150 nt 3′ of the initiation codon (AUG-proximity escape) and (ii) a PTC in the last exon (no downstream junction). The element is created by a single-nucleotide nonsense substitution at a chosen in-frame codon (CAA→TAA, CAG→TAG, CGA→TGA, TGG→TGA, GAA→TAA, TCA→TAA, TTA→TAA, TAT→TAA, TGT→TGA, …), i.e. the real mutation class.
test: For each donor transcript (slot-0 ORFs with a reference-CDS start, ORF length ≥ 600 nt, ≥2 junctions so both an EJC-triggering region and a last exon exist), enumerate every in-frame codon that a SINGLE base change converts to a stop. For each such codon, rebuild the slot end-to-end through data_prep.encode_window_v5 with the mutated sequence: the start and its frame channels 6–8 are unchanged (same AUG), the stop window is recentred on the new stop, the ORF-midpoint clip is recomputed, channel 5 is recomputed from the window's own filled extent, channel 4 is refilled under the new clip bounds, and frac_start/frac_stop/n_downstream_ejc are recomputed. Using the real encoder keeps this on-manifold — this is a nonsense mutation, not a synthetic perturbation. Score with all five checkpoints in two input configurations: (A) native K=5 with the other slots at donor values, and (B) single-slot masked input so attention is 1.0 on the perturbed slot, removing attention dilution as an explanation (legal because no parameter depends on K and one-ORF isoforms exist). CONFOUNDER ARM, mandatory: run the whole ladder twice, once with is_sqanti_cds held at the donor value and once forced to 0. The brief states TD2 avoids calling PTC-bearing ORFs, and that ref/TD2 disagreement is a 49.5%-vs-12.0% NMD proxy — so if the positional profile exists ONLY when the flag is flipped, the model is reading a tool's bias and not the sequence, and that must be reported as the finding.
matched_reference: At the SAME codon and the SAME nucleotide substitution type, the change that does NOT create a stop. Each nonsense-creating single-base change has a partner in the same codon (or the adjacent codon at the same frame offset) with identical base identities before and after — e.g. C→T creating TAA from CAA, matched against a C→T at a third position that is synonymous. This is exact GC and purine matching (trap 2: only GC-matched operators approach a null reference) and frame-offset matching (trap 3: created-motif exclusion rates differ 23.6% vs 8.7% by codon offset). The control isolates STOP CREATION from nucleotide identity, which is the only contrast that supports a mechanistic claim. Second reference: the same nonsense ladder run on the last-exon region alone, where the positional profile should be flat.
would_refute: A monotone curve with no AUG-proximal trough — the model has only the EJC arm and the proximity rule is absent. Or a profile that vanishes when is_sqanti_cds is forced to 0 in both conditions — the profile was the annotation flag, not the sequence. Or a profile identical to the synonymous-control ladder — the effect is the nucleotide change, not the stop.

title: Stop-codon termination context (−3 to +4) modulates NMD only where termination is EJC-triggering
element: The stop tetranucleotide and its immediate 5′ neighbourhood: the base at stop+1 (the '+4' of the stop signal) within a fixed stop triplet, and the last sense codon at stop−3..−1. Concretely, the contrast TGA-C (leakiest known context) versus TGA-G/TGA-A, and TAA-purine (tightest) versus TAA-pyrimidine, plus the −1 codon identity.
test: Build a stop-window position bank mirroring analysis_plans/measure_position_bank.py (which is currently start-window only): one cached forward-pass sweep substituting all four bases at every position in a bank spanning stop−12 … stop+12, plus ~37 frame-matched control positions further out, with channel 5 recomputed exactly as data_prep does and created-motif exclusions recorded. Then derive ONLY GC-matched contrasts — C-vs-G and A-vs-T at stop+1, within a fixed stop triplet — never G-vs-notG (that operator is dead: 100% same-signed controls, |t| median 5.79). Stratify every contrast by (i) the slot's own n_downstream_ejc > 0 and (ii) attention tercile, because the brief shows the Kozak −3 effect changes sign across attention terciles (+0.0058 middle, −0.0024 top) and reverses with the slot's PTC status (+0.0087 vs −0.0001). Report the difference-in-differences: (triggering − non-triggering) within attention stratum. Sizing verified from selected_orfs.tsv slot 0: triggering stops number 6,170 TGA / 2,523 TAA / 2,165 TAG; non-triggering 15,498 / 8,831 / 6,856 — enough for within-triplet × within-tercile cells.
matched_reference: (a) The same GC-matched contrast at NON-triggering stops of the same triplet identity — matched on stop codon, on window geometry, on frame, and on attention, differing only in whether termination at that stop is an NMD-competent event. That is the mechanism-matched population. (b) The 37 frame-matched control positions, extended to the stop window, carrying the identical operator, exclusions and recomputation path — the method's own noise floor. (c) Within-triplet only, so the contrast never compares TAA to TGA and cannot be a stop-identity effect in disguise.
would_refute: The stop+1 effect is the same size at triggering and non-triggering stops (no interaction) — it is a generic base preference, which is exactly how Kozak +4 died. Or the effect is inside the control-position spread at every attention tercile. Or the sign is inverted (leaky context raises predicted NMD), which would contradict the readthrough mechanism and point to a composition confounder.

title: The exonic footprint of a splice junction as a sequence-only junction surrogate
element: The nucleotide signature a spliced junction leaves in the MATURE transcript: the exonic half of the donor consensus at the upstream exon's 3′ end ((C/A)AG) abutting the G-biased first base of the downstream exon — i.e. the junction-spanning 4-mer CAGG / AAGG — together with junction-proximal exonic splicing enhancer density (GAAGAA / GGAGGA-class SR-protein sites).
test: Donor set: slot-0 ORFs with n_downstream_ejc = 0 and no junction mark anywhere in the stop window (so no real junction can interact). Implant CAGG and AAGG at offsets d ∈ {60, 90, 120} nt downstream of the stop — deliberately OUTSIDE conv2's 42-nt receptive field around the stop, so any effect is the encoder recognising a junction-like motif rather than perturbing the stop detector. Channel 4 is never set; channel 5 is recomputed exactly as data_prep does; the tabular block is untouched. Run each implant at offsets ≡0, ≡1 and ≡2 mod 3 relative to the stop and report created-motif exclusion rates separately per offset class (trap 3: 23.6% vs 8.7%). Second arm: implant a 12-mer ESE cassette (GAAGAAGAAGAA) at the same offsets against its own permutation family. Score all five checkpoints.
matched_reference: Composition-matched permutations of the identical base multiset. For CAGG the multiset {C,A,G,G} has 4!/2! = 12 distinct arrangements; excluding the target and any that are themselves consensus leaves ≥8 controls with IDENTICAL GC fraction, identical purine count, and hence an identical channel-5 trajectory — the only reference class trap 2 reports as approaching null. This escapes section 6's dead 'dinucleotide-preserving shuffle of a 3-mer is the identity map' by using 4-mers and 12-mers, and the arrangement count will be ASSERTED in code before the run rather than assumed, which is the check that failed the first time. Second reference: the identical implant placed UPSTREAM of the stop at matched distance, where a junction is translated over and does not trigger.
would_refute: The target arrangement sits inside the distribution of its own permutations for most donors — the encoder has no nucleotide-level junction detector, channel 4 is doing all of it, and any sequence-only deployment of this model requires junction annotation. That is a clean negative and is directly actionable for Track A.

title: The poly(A) signal hexamer downstream of the stop as a faux-3′UTR / PABPC1-proximity element
element: The canonical polyadenylation signal AAUAAA (and the variant AUUAAA) located in the sequence 3′ of the stop codon, and its distance from the stop.
test: Donor set: slot-0 ORFs with n_downstream_ejc = 0 (EJC arm silent, so the faux-3′UTR arm is isolated) and no AATAAA or ATTAAA within the stop window. Implant AATAAA at d ∈ {40, 80, 150, 300} nt downstream of the stop; channel 5 recomputed, channel 4 and the tabular block untouched. Second arm: within donors that already carry a natural proximal PAS, relocate it by swapping the hexamer with the equal-length stretch at a new offset, which conserves the window's entire base composition exactly. All five checkpoints. Offsets sampled at all three codon-frame classes with exclusion rates reported per class. STATED LIMITATION, not buried: an implanted PAS cannot actually cleave in silico, so the claim is 'the hexamer is a learned feature whose biological reading is 3′-end proximity', not 'shortening the 3′UTR rescues'. That cap is analogous to trap 8.
matched_reference: The hexamer's own arrangement family, which here is unusually clean: AATAAA is five A's and one T, so there are exactly 6 arrangements, differing only in the T's position — identical GC, identical purine content, identical channel-5 trajectory. Better still, the four INTERNAL-T arrangements (ATAAAA, AATAAA, AAATAA, AAAATA) have identical DINUCLEOTIDE composition as well ({AA×3, AT, TA}), so the target differs from its three controls in motif identity and in nothing else measurable. The arrangement count will be asserted in code before the run — this is what makes it escape the dead 3-mer shuffle rather than repeat it. Second reference: ATTAAA, the second-most-used real PAS, as a same-direction positive control; it should behave like AATAAA and unlike the arrangements.
would_refute: AATAAA sits inside its own arrangement distribution for most donors, or shows no distance dependence, or ATTAAA behaves like the null arrangements. Any of these says the model has no PAS/3′-end-proximity feature and that the faux-3′UTR arm is not represented — consistent with the brief calling long 3′UTRs 'less central', but currently that is an assumption rather than a measurement.

title: The +4 base of the termination tetranucleotide lowers NMD only where an EJC is available to displace
element: The single nucleotide immediately 3' of the stop codon (+4) of the ORF in slot 0 — the fourth position of the mammalian tetranucleotide termination signal (stop+N4) — read against the other frame-1 positions of the 3' flank (+7, +10, +13, +16, +19) as its own within-isoform control set. In the stop window at width 1000, the stop occupies indices W/2-1, W/2, W/2+1, so +4 is index W/2+2.
test: Retarget analysis_plans/measure_position_bank.py from the slot-0 ATG window to the slot-0 STOP window, tag atg1000_stop1000, five sweep members (seeds 100-500), ~500 isoforms. Bank = {+4} + frame-1 controls inside conv2's 42 nt receptive field {+7,+10,+13,+16,+19} + frame-1 controls outside it {+25,+28,...,+58} + frame-matched positions upstream inside the CDS. All four bases measured at every position, so every contrast (A-T, G-C, GC-AT, purine) is a re-cut of one forward-pass sweep and operators cannot differ in anything but the operator. Channel 5 recomputed over the filled extent by the exact reimplementation already in the script; channel 4 and the 5-number tabular block untouched. HARD EXCLUSION specific to this position, and it is the trap: setting +4=T creates an in-frame tandem stop at +4..+6 whenever (+5,+6) is AA, AG or GA — roughly 19% of isoforms. Those are dropped from the primary contrast and analysed separately (they are hypothesis 5 observed rather than implanted). Stratify by n_downstream_ejc from selected_orfs.tsv.
matched_reference: Three, as section 7.1 demands. (1) Method noise floor: the identical operator at the same frame offset at +25..+58, outside the 42 nt receptive field around the stop centre, where the architecture provably cannot relate that base to the stop. (2) Other positions: the frame-1 positions +7..+19, which sit in the same post-stop composition regime, so a CDS-to-UTR compositional boundary cannot masquerade as a +4 effect, and which are frame-matched (section 7.3 — created-motif exclusion rates differ 23.6% vs 8.7% across codon offsets). (3) Matched population: the same operator at non-EJC-triggering stops, and at isoforms matched on downstream-20-nt GC and frac_position.
would_refute: Within-isoform ranks of +4 indistinguishable from uniform against the frame-matched controls; or a +4 effect of equal size in the PTC and non-PTC strata (that is a composition or annotation-boundary effect, not termination fidelity); or an effect that persists undiminished at +25..+58, which would mark it as a method artifact rather than a stop-proximal element.

title: Non-optimal synonymous codon runs immediately before the stop, via a composition-exact wobble exchange
element: A run of >=6 consecutive low-optimality synonymous codons in the 36 nt immediately 5' of the stop codon — i.e. inside conv2's 42 nt receptive field around the stop centre — defined over 4-fold degenerate boxes (Ala, Gly, Pro, Thr, Val, Leu-CTN, Ser-TCN, Arg-CGN).
test: New operator class — composition-exact synonymous wobble exchange. Restrict to 4-fold boxes and exchange wobble bases between two codons only within the same GC class (C<->G, or A<->T). Consequences are exact, not merely matched: amino acid sequence unchanged; is_gc unchanged at every position so channel 5 is bit-identical (data_prep.py:97); total A/C/G/T counts in the window unchanged, so the documented model-wide G-over-C preference contributes zero at first order; channels 6-8 positional and untouched; channel 4 and the tabular block untouched. Four conditions per isoform, matched on edit count and on delta(mean tAI or human codon frequency): (a) CLUSTERED-DEOPT, low-optimality wobbles concentrated in codons -6..-1; (b) SCATTERED-DEOPT, same count spread over -12..-1; (c) NEUTRAL-EXCHANGE, same positions and edit count chosen so delta(optimality) ~ 0; (d) DISTAL, condition (a)'s recode applied at codons -40..-34, inside the stop window but outside the 42 nt receptive field. Eligibility: orf_length >= 150 nt so the span lies inside the stop window's filled extent after the ORF-midpoint clip, and >=6 exchangeable 4-fold codons in the span; report the eligible fraction. No-op check: exchanging a codon's wobble with itself must return exactly 0.0.
matched_reference: (1) Method floor: condition (d), the same recode outside the receptive field, plus the exact-zero no-op check. (2) Other positions/arrangement: condition (b), identical optimality change and identical composition, different spatial arrangement — this is the reference that isolates clustering from count. (3) Matched population/matched operator: condition (c), identical edit count at identical positions with no optimality change — this is the reference that makes the claim about codon identity rather than about 'you edited six bases'. Additionally the non-EJC-triggering stops as a population where the mechanism predicts no effect.
would_refute: (a) ~ (c): editing wobbles moves the model regardless of optimality, so the element is base identity not codon optimality. (a) ~ (b): count matters and arrangement does not — a weaker but still positive result about optimality, reported as such rather than spun. (a)-(c) ~ (d)-(c): the effect is not stop-proximal and is a whole-window artifact that survived the exactness constraints, which would indict the operator.

title: TAG<->TGA at the terminator: the unique GC-exact stop-identity operator, with an in-frame decoy ladder
element: The identity of the terminating triplet itself, restricted to the TAG<->TGA exchange (positions 2 and 3 of the stop codon). This is the only stop pair with an identical G+C count, so it is the only stop-identity operator with exact channel-5 invariance; TAA differs in GC from both and is excluded for that reason.
test: Two-base substitution at the slot-0 stop window centre (indices W/2 and W/2+1), TAG<->TGA in both directions, on isoforms whose observed slot-0 stop is TAG or TGA (stop_codon column of selected_orfs.tsv). Verify numerically that channel 5 is bit-identical before and after, which it must be since is_gc is unchanged at both edited positions. Channel 4 and the tabular block untouched. DECOY LADDER, all at in-frame offsets so the frame channels are matched: implant TAG vs TGA at +12 and +21 (inside the 42 nt receptive field around the stop) and at +60 and +90 (outside it). Because both conditions at a decoy are implants at the same index, the native triplet's identity cancels in the difference, and the window-local unpropagated substitution's off-manifold contamination is common to the two conditions and cancels too. Five members, tag atg1000_stop1000, stratified by n_downstream_ejc.
matched_reference: (1) Method floor: the +60/+90 in-frame decoys, outside the receptive field. (2) Other positions: the +12/+21 in-frame decoys, inside the receptive field and in the same 3'-flank composition regime — a model that has merely learned a 3-mer detector fires there too, a model that has learned a terminator reader does not. (3) Matched population: non-EJC-triggering stops, and isoforms matched on 3'-flank GC and orf_length. The within-isoform design also excludes the obvious observational confounders — stop identity correlates with gene-level GC isochore and with CDS length, and both conditions here are the same isoform.
would_refute: An equal TGA-vs-TAG response at the +12/+21 in-frame decoys, which means the model reads a 3-mer wherever it appears and has no terminator-specific representation; a null at the terminator; or a terminator effect that does not differ between the EJC and non-EJC strata, which would leave it uninterpretable as termination fidelity.

title: A tandem in-frame stop inside the readthrough window, tested against a one-nucleotide frame shift
element: An in-frame stop triplet located 6-18 nt 3' of an EJC-triggering stop — the 'backup stop' that truncates a readthrough ribosome's excursion into the 3' flank before it reaches the first downstream junction.
test: Implant TAA vs AAT — both have G+C = 0, so channel 5 is bit-identical between the two conditions and the entire contrast is composition-exact — at in-frame offsets +6, +9, +12, +15, +18 and at out-of-frame offsets +7, +10, +13, +16, +19 (same three bases, same GC; the frame channels differ because channels 6-8 are computed from position, data_prep.py:207-211, and are never touched by a substitution). Distal arm in frame at +60 and +90. Both arms are implants at the same index, so the window-local unpropagated off-manifold contamination is common to the two conditions and cancels in the difference. Stratify by n_downstream_ejc and by whether the first downstream junction lies beyond the implanted stop. INTERNAL REPLICATION: the ~19% of isoforms excluded from hypothesis 1 because +4=T creates a tandem stop are this same element observed rather than implanted, on a population selected by an entirely different criterion.
matched_reference: (1) Method floor: the in-frame implant at +60/+90, outside conv2's 42 nt receptive field around the stop, where the architecture cannot co-represent the implant and the stop; this is a method reference, not biological evidence, and is labelled as such. (2) Other positions/frame: the out-of-frame implant at the adjacent offset — identical three bases, identical GC, identical distance from the stop, differing only in frame-channel alignment. This is the biological control. (3) Matched population: the same implant at non-EJC-triggering stops, and at stops whose first downstream junction is <=50 nt and therefore non-triggering.
would_refute: In-frame indistinguishable from out-of-frame at matched offset — the model has a stop-3-mer detector, not a frame-aware termination detector, and the whole translation-aware reading of this architecture is wrong. Or a null at every offset. Or an effect as large at +60/+90 as at +6..+18, which indicts the implant as a composition artifact despite the GC match.

title: Wobble-phase GC as the ORF-authenticity signal driving slot attention
element: The 3-nt phase of G+C placement in the ORF's own frame — the GC3 excess over GC1/GC2 — measured over the ~40 nt flanking each anchor, i.e. the frame-3-minus-frame-1/2 GC differential inside conv2's 42 nt receptive field around the ATG and around the stop.
test: Phase-swap operator. In the target span, exchange the base at a frame-3 position p with the base at p+1 (frame 1) whenever the two differ in GC class. MATCHED CONTROL operator: exchange p+1 (frame 1) with p+2 (frame 2) whenever they differ in GC class. The two operators are matched on exchange distance (1 nt), on GC-class exchange, on edit-count distribution, and therefore on the magnitude of the residual channel-5 perturbation (a 1-nt displacement inside a 50-nt rolling support changes channel 5 at ~2 positions per edit by 1/50); they differ only in whether the wobble phase is involved. Total base composition is exactly preserved by both, so the model-wide G-over-C preference cancels. Apply to (i) the reference-CDS slot and (ii) the highest-attention non-reference slot, plus a distal arm outside the receptive field. Five members, tag atg1000_stop1000.
matched_reference: (1) Method floor: the same operator applied to a distal span outside the 42 nt receptive field, plus the exact-zero no-op check. (2) Other positions/phases: the frame1<->frame2 exchange, matched on distance, GC-class and edit count — this separates 'the model responds to phase' from 'the model responds to a 1-nt rearrangement'. (3) Matched population: ORFs where TD2 and the reference CDS agree (real coding) versus where they disagree, and out-of-frame upstream ORFs, which should show a smaller Delta alpha because there is less phase structure to destroy. This population split is a positive control with a predicted ordering, not just a stratification.
would_refute: Delta alpha equal under frame3<->frame1 and frame1<->frame2 — the model responds to a 1-nt rearrangement, not to codon phase. Or Delta alpha ~ 0 under both. Or the effect landing in the verdict term rather than the selection term, which would break the mechanistic story even if the number is nonzero. HARD CAP, stated up front per section 7.8: because the only ground truth for 'which ORF is translated' is GENCODE traced through the isoform, a positive result licenses 'wobble phase predicts the ANNOTATED ORF', not 'predicts ribosome selection'. Ribosome profiling would be required for the stronger claim, and the claim will be written at the weaker level.

title: Kozak is read as an arrangement, not as a base: composition-conserving permutation of the −6…−1 hexamer
element: The ordering of purines within the six nucleotides immediately 5′ of the start codon — ATG-window array indices W/2−7 … W/2−2, i.e. codon positions −6…−1, with −3 (index W/2−4) the hypothesized privileged slot — crossed with the +4…+6 triplet (indices W/2+2 … W/2+4).
test: Restrict to isoforms whose slot-0 ATG window has all bases at −6…−1 present as ACGT and whose hexamer multiset contains at least one purine and one pyrimidine (so both sides of the split exist) and admits ≥12 distinct arrangements. For each isoform enumerate distinct arrangements of the native multiset and sample S=24, stratified to ≥8 with purine at −3 and ≥8 with pyrimidine at −3, always including the native arrangement (flagged, so it can be dropped in a sensitivity cut). Write the arrangement into channels 0–3 at indices W/2−7…W/2−2; recompute channel 5 over the filled extent with the existing rolling_gc reimplementation (measure_position_bank.py:53-75); leave channels 4 and 6–8 untouched (no junction is created and the ORF start does not move, so frame is unchanged). Score all five results_4ct_sweep members at atg1000_stop1000 and atg2000_stop2000. Apply the existing created-motif exclusion (any AUG or in-frame stop created inside the hexamer) and report its rate separately for the purine-at-−3 and pyrimidine-at-−3 halves; restrict to multisets where those two rates are within 2 percentage points, since trap 3 shows exclusion asymmetry is what silently unbalances a contrast. Second arm: extend the permuted block to include +4…+6 and re-cut the same passes as a 2×2 (−3 purine yes/no) × (+4 G yes/no) to test conjunction versus additivity. Pilot 500 isoforms, production 2,000.
matched_reference: The identical forward passes re-cut by which of the six positions defines the purine/pyrimidine split. Across the six re-cuts the isoform, the window geometry, the base composition, the total GC, the position set and the frame offsets are all identical — only the read-out position changes — so this is a strictly stronger reference than the 37 frame-matched control positions, which differ from the targets in observed-base composition (purine fraction 0.742 at −3 versus a control median of 0.509). Secondary references: the five randomly-initialized members (architecture plus input distribution alone), and the per-split exclusion rates.
would_refute: −3's median per-isoform contrast lying inside the range spanned by −6, −5, −4, −2 and −1 — i.e. a flat six-position profile, meaning the model reads upstream purine content but not its position. Also refuting: the per-arrangement Δ being predicted by the ℓ1 change the rearrangement induces in channel 5 (a residual composition artifact that survives multiset conservation through the rolling window's edges), or the 2×2 arm showing exact additivity of −3 and +4, which would kill the conjunction half.

title: Cap proximity as a sequence element: a 5′UTR-length truncation ladder for the TISU/short-UTR class
element: The length of transcript sequence present 5′ of the start codon — equivalently the position of the transcript's 5′ terminus relative to the AUG — which appears in the ATG window as the boundary between zero padding and filled sequence (readable as the lower edge of the filled extent, channels 6–8).
test: Restrict to isoforms whose slot-0 ATG window has ≥150 nt of filled upstream sequence (~70% of ref-CDS isoforms by the local 5′UTR distribution) and ≥150 nt of filled downstream sequence inside the midpoint clip. Build a per-isoform ladder by moving the filled extent's lower bound to W/2−1−L for L ∈ {150, 96, 60, 36, 24, 18, 12, 6, 0}: zero channels 0–8 below it and recompute channel 5 over the new [lo, hi], which is exactly the array data_prep.py would emit for a native transcript with that 5′UTR length. Score five members at both configurations. Matched arm: remove the same number of positions from the inward (downstream, midpoint-clipped) edge instead, an equal-information, equal-padding-fraction edit with no cap-proximity meaning. Calibration arm: compare the synthetic Δ at L against the native cross-section of isoforms whose true upstream fill is ≈L (n≈1,270 below 30 nt), matched on n_downstream_ejc — the dominant structural feature per the brief's branch decomposition — and on label prevalence.
matched_reference: Three, all needed. (1) Downstream-edge truncation removing an identical number of filled positions from the same window of the same isoform — this is what isolates cap proximity from 'less sequence, weaker evidence'. (2) The native short-5′UTR cross-section at matched n_downstream_ejc, which tests whether the synthetic input lands where real ones of that length do. (3) Randomly-initialized members, to show the curve is not produced by the padding geometry alone.
would_refute: The upstream ladder lying inside the downstream control's envelope at every L; or a monotone dependence on removed length with no break in the 6–30 nt band; or the synthetic curve at L disagreeing in sign with the native cross-section at L, which would mean the truncation is not producing the input the model learned that class from.

title: oORF versus N-terminal extension: a frame-resolved upstream AUG implant with composition-identical controls
element: An AUG in the 5′UTR in strong context (implanted 9-mer GCCACCATG) and, critically, its reading frame relative to the main ORF: out of frame creates an overlapping ORF that terminates inside the CDS, in frame creates an N-terminal extension that shares the main ORF's stop.
test: For each eligible isoform (≥200 nt of filled upstream sequence, ≥200 nt of filled downstream sequence inside the midpoint clip), implant the 9-mer at upstream offsets d, d+1, d+2 for d ∈ {30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180} nt from the main AUG, so the three frame classes are represented at distances matched to within 1 nt. Four cassettes per position: GCCACCATG and the composition-identical GCCACCAGT, GCCACCGAT, GCCACCGTA (the same {A,G,T} multiset permuted; TAG/TGA/TAA deliberately avoided). Edit channels 0–3, recompute channel 5 over the filled extent, leave 4 and 6–8 untouched. Placebo arm: the identical 4 cassettes × 3 frames × 6 distances placed downstream of the main AUG. Apply the created-motif exclusion over the cassette ±2 nt symmetrically across all four cassettes and all three frames, and report the rates. Five members, both window configurations; pilot 500 isoforms, production 2,000.
matched_reference: Two, nested. (1) The three permuted cassettes — identical base multiset, identical 9-nt footprint, identical destroyed native bases, differing only in whether the last three bases spell a start codon; this is the composition-exact reference the project's single-base operators cannot achieve. (2) The three frame classes at d, d+1, d+2 — same cassette, same isoform, matched distance to within 1 nt, differing only in the frame channel alignment at the implant site. The downstream placebo arm is the biological specificity control.
would_refute: No separation between out-of-frame and in-frame implants once the permuted cassettes are subtracted, which would mean the model counts AUGs and does not resolve frame. Equally refuting in the opposite direction: an identical frame effect in the downstream placebo arm, which would mean the model has learned 'out-of-frame AUG anywhere in the window' — a bag-of-motifs artifact of global max pooling rather than scanning, and would forbid the biological claim.

title: AUG dose in the 5′UTR: decoy titration, with the max-pool saturation alternative built in as the thing to exclude
element: The number and density of strong-context out-of-frame AUGs in the 5′UTR — a graded compositional/positional property of the leader, not a single motif occurrence.
test: Restrict to isoforms with ≥260 nt of filled upstream sequence. Implant K copies of GCCACCATG at 40-nt spacing starting 60 nt upstream of the main AUG and proceeding 5′, K ∈ {0,1,2,3,4,6}, all at offsets chosen out of frame with the main ORF. Control series: the identical K positions filled with the composition-identical GCCACCAGT. Recompute channel 5, leave channels 4 and 6–8 untouched, apply the created-motif exclusion at every junction with native sequence.
