Three exclusions of the saturation alternative, all internal: (i) stratify by the number of NATIVE strong-context AUGs already present in the window, counted directly from channels 0–3 of the stored window — under saturation the K=1 increment must shrink as native AUG count rises, under a dose account it need not; (ii) repeat on the atg2000_stop2000 members, whose windows contain roughly twice as many native competitors — under saturation the K=1 increment shrinks with window width; (iii) fit the per-isoform curve and report the increment from K=1 to K=2 separately from the increment from K=0 to K=1, since presence detection predicts the former is at the method's noise floor. Five members; pilot 500, production 2,000 isoforms.
matched_reference: The AGT-cassette series at the identical K positions — identical footprint, identical base multiset, identical destroyed native bases, differing only in whether each decoy spells a start codon. The native-AUG-count strata and the two window widths are the matched references for the saturation alternative specifically, and they are matched because the same isoforms and the same implants are used across them.
would_refute: A step function: Δ(K=1) indistinguishable from Δ(K=6) with the K=1→2 increment at the no-op floor, which refutes the graded-dose element and, if it coincides with a K=1 increment that shrinks with native AUG count and with window width, positively establishes presence-detection instead. Also refuting: the AGT control reproducing the curve (a footprint artifact), or the whole curve being predicted by the cumulative ℓ1 change in channel 5.

title: First AUG wins: the same Kozak operator applied to the transcript's 5′-most AUG versus the annotated start, paired within isoform
element: The Kozak context (the −6…−1 hexamer) of the 5′-most AUG in the transcript, as distinct from the context of the annotated start codon.
test: Identify, from channels 0–3 of the stored slot-0 ATG window, the 5′-most ATG inside the filled extent that is (a) not the anchor, (b) ≥10 nt from the window's upstream edge so its −6…−1 hexamer is fully present, and (c) out of frame with the main ORF (readable from its index modulo 3). Roughly 73% of isoforms have their full 5′UTR inside a W=1000 window (median 5′UTR 267 nt), so the transcript's true first AUG is usually in view; report the fraction where it is not and treat those as ineligible rather than as a first AUG. Apply the hexamer permutation operator to that AUG's context, and in the same forward-pass batch to the annotated start's context, in the same isoform. Third anchor in the same batch: a frame-matched non-AUG position the same distance upstream, carrying the identical operator — the geometry control. Five members, both configurations, with exclusion rates reported per anchor. Confirmatory arm before any manuscript statement: the propagated substitution, applying each edit to every slot window containing that coordinate.
matched_reference: The annotated-start anchor in the same isoform is the reference for the first-AUG anchor and vice versa: identical isoform, identical operator, identical exclusion rules, identical forward-pass batch, identical window. The non-AUG geometry anchor at matched distance is the reference for both, and it separates 'an AUG's context' from 'any upstream position's context'.
would_refute: The two contrasts having the same sign and indistinguishable magnitude per isoform (no anchor specificity), or the non-AUG geometry anchor reproducing the first-AUG contrast (a distance-from-the-anchor artifact rather than a start-codon-context effect), or the first-AUG contrast vanishing while the annotated-start contrast survives — which would say the model reads annotation-adjacent context only, and would be a clean, publishable negative about the instrument's scope.

title: Termination context (stop+1…+6) read off the stop branch's 32 max-pool winners
element: The stop triplet plus the six nucleotides immediately 3' of it — the termination hexanucleotide (e.g. TGA-C, a leaky readthrough context, vs TAA-G, an efficient one).
test: (1) Hook bn2/ReLU of stop_cnn; for 41,765 isoforms x 5 slots take the argmax over length of each of the 32 channels, and use MaxPool1d(return_indices=True) to recover the exact conv1 position that won each of the 7 bins inside conv2's kernel, giving 7 exact 15-nt kernel footprints per (channel, slot). (2) At each winning conv1 position decompose the preactivation exactly into its 9 additive per-input-channel terms (conv1 is linear in the channel axis; residual exactly 0). Keep only channels where nucleotide channels 0-3 carry the majority of positive preactivation mass and channel 5 carries <10%; this discards GC-detector, junction-detector and frame-detector channels by construction rather than by inspection. (3) Tabulate argmax offsets relative to the stop for surviving channels; test concentration at stop+1..+6 against a padding-aware null that excludes any argmax whose 42-nt footprint intersects the midpoint-clip padding. (4) Build PWMs from top-decile-activation footprints separately in PTC+ and PTC- slots (the per-slot conditional verdict readout). (5) Causal validation in N=1,000 PTC+ isoforms: replace the observed stop+1..+6 hexamer by each of its composition-preserving permutations — base counts identical, so channel 5 is exactly invariant and the perturbation footprint is exactly 42 nt.
matched_reference: Three references, per trap 1. (a) Method noise floor: the identity permutation, plus the ~7e-7 production batch-size floor. (b) Other positions: the identical composition-preserving permutation applied to 30 control hexamers at stop+7..+12, +13..+18 and elsewhere in the window, all at the same codon phase — matched because permutation preserves base composition exactly (so channel 5 does not move) and because created-motif exclusion rates differ 23.6% vs 8.7% between codon offsets (trap 3). (c) Matched population: PTC- slots drawn to the same n_downstream_ejc distribution, because the prediction is that the effect exists only where termination is premature.
would_refute: No surviving nucleotide-dominated channel shows argmax enrichment at stop+1..+6 above the padding-aware null; or the permutation range at stop+1..+6 does not exceed the frame-matched control blocks' range at matched n; or the effect is the same size in PTC- slots, which would make it a generic stop-composition effect rather than termination efficiency.

title: A U-rich tract 4–40 nt 3' of the stop, identified by the 4-nt plateau and 42-nt horizon signatures
element: A U-rich (poly-pyrimidine) tract of >=8 nt positioned 4-40 nt 3' of the stop codon.
test: Implant U8 vs A8 — exactly GC-matched, so channel 5 is bitwise identical and the perturbation footprint is exactly 42 nt — at offsets d = 4, 8, 12, ..., 60 and at d = 100, 150, 200, in N=800 backgrounds stratified by PTC status. Exclude implants creating an in-frame stop or AUG, applying the exclusion at matched codon phase to U8 and A8 alike. Three architecture-specific signatures decide it. (i) 4-nt plateau: MaxPool1d(4) bins are stride-4 and aligned to array index 0 while the stop sits at a fixed array index, so Delta-logit(d) should be piecewise constant in blocks of 4 with a phase common to every isoform at a given window size. (ii) 42-nt horizon: if the effect is a joint stop x tract relation it must collapse for d >~ 40, because no single conv2 unit can see both; if it is flat out to d=200 it is bulk composition. (iii) Exact channel mediation: because the branch output IS the 32 channel maxima, restore individual channels' maxima to their pre-implant values between the encoder's max and its fc and re-run the rest of the network exactly — this is an intervention, not an attribution, so there is no completeness error.
matched_reference: A8 at the same offsets in the same backgrounds: identical length, identical base composition class (GC=0 for both, so channel 5 is unchanged), identical frame phase, identical created-motif exclusion. Plus a within-isoform reference — the same U8-vs-A8 implant at matched offsets 5' of the stop, inside the CDS, where the termination-coupling hypothesis predicts nothing.
would_refute: No lag-4 periodicity above lags 1-3; or the effect at d=200 equals the effect at d=8; or the implant's Delta is spread over more than ~10 of the 32 channels under exact mediation; or U8 and A8 are indistinguishable at matched n.

title: 3-periodic coding-like composition in the 42 nt downstream of the stop (the faux 3'UTR signature)
element: Codon-position-specific base composition — the 3-periodic GC3/codon-usage signature — in the first ~42 nt 3' of the stop codon, read in the upstream ORF's own reading frame, at fixed bulk GC.
test: Restrict to PTC+ slots (reference-AUG anchored, junction >50 nt downstream), where the downstream region has a defined frame. Apply synonymous recoding over tracts of length L = 9, 15, 21, 30, 42, 60, 120 nt starting at stop+1, in the upstream ORF's frame, in two directions: (a) maximize codon-position-specific composition contrast, (b) minimize it toward uniform. Hold amino-acid sequence identical and bulk tract GC constant to within one codon's worth; report residual channel-5 movement and regress it against a channel-5-only control. Architecture-derived prediction: conv1's k=15 kernel spans five codons and is the only place a periodicity detector can live, and MaxPool1d(4) over a period-3 signal is near-constant, so detection should step between L=9 and L~15 and saturate by L~42 (conv2's receptive field). A response that keeps growing to L=120 is bulk composition, not a periodicity detector.
matched_reference: (a) The low-periodicity recoding is the matched partner of the high-periodicity recoding: identical amino acids, identical bulk GC, identical length, identical frame phase — the only thing that differs is codon-position composition. (b) The same paired recoding applied inside the CDS 5' of the stop, where the composition change is identical but the biology predicts no NMD consequence. (c) Recoding always respects codon boundaries, so phase is fixed by construction (trap 3).
would_refute: High- and low-periodicity recodings indistinguishable at matched GC; or a monotonic response growing to L=120 with no step near 15 and no plateau near 42, which would say it is bulk composition; or the 5'-of-stop control showing the same effect size.

title: Re-admitting the invisible half: real unselected oORFs as slots 6–8
element: An upstream, out-of-frame AUG whose ORF reads past the main start codon and terminates inside the CDS (an oORF), together with its -3 purine start context — specifically the ~half of real upstream-PTC-bearing ORFs that the top-5 selection discards (12,010 in the full scan vs 5,913 in the slots).
test: No parameter depends on K and the model is permutation-invariant across slots, so the checkpoint runs unchanged at K=6-8. For ~4,000 isoforms carrying at least one unselected qualifying upstream ORF in the full scan, encode the extra slot's two windows with the same encode_window_v5 and midpoint-clip code and its true five tabular values, and measure per-isoform Delta-logit against the K=5 baseline. Three controls make it interpretable. (i) Exact null: add the slot but leave it masked — masked softmax sets it to -inf, giving it exactly zero weight, so Delta-logit must be exactly 0.0; any nonzero value is a bug, not a finding. (ii) Dilution baseline: re-admit a byte-identical copy of an existing slot, which perturbs the softmax denominator identically but adds no information. (iii) Matched decoy: re-admit a real unselected ORF from the same transcript matched on orf_length, frac_start, frac_stop and n_downstream_ejc, differing only in oORF-vs-uORF class or in the -3 base. Because attn_score sees one slot at a time, no cross-slot relation is computable — so if oORF class registers at all it must be carried by the added slot's own sequence, which localizes the element to that window.
matched_reference: The matched decoy — matched on all five tabular features so any residual difference is attributable to sequence — plus the dilution baseline, which isolates the pure softmax-denominator effect that would otherwise be mistaken for the finding. This is the specific failure mode that killed inference-time flag ablation (it shrank controls 0.66x alongside targets 0.42x); here the denominator effect is measured directly rather than assumed away.
would_refute: A GBM on the added slot's five tabular numbers predicts Delta-logit with R^2 > 0.9, meaning no sequence element is involved; or oORF and matched-uORF re-admissions are indistinguishable; or the masked-slot null is not exactly 0.0, which invalidates the whole setup.

title: The -6…-1 Kozak block as a selection element, split exactly into selection and verdict
element: The hexamer immediately 5' of the start codon — the extended Kozak block (gccRcc) — treated as a block rather than as six independent bases.
test: (1) Use the head-swap form, already implemented and guarded in analysis_plans/probe_head_swap.py (manual reconstruction checked against model(...), ensemble dAUC -0.0008, per-member table in the run log), so that logit = sum_r alpha_r v_r exactly with v_r = g(e_r) a per-slot verdict. The perturbation then splits exactly: Delta-logit = sum_r Delta-alpha_r * v_r + sum_r alpha_r * Delta-v_r + sum_r Delta-alpha_r * Delta-v_r, three terms with zero residual by arithmetic. (2) The operator is a composition-preserving PERMUTATION of the -6..-1 hexamer: all four base counts held exactly, so channel 5 is exactly invariant and the perturbation footprint is exactly the 42-nt receptive field. (3) Per isoform, compute the range of logit over the permutation set and the selection/verdict share of that range. (4) Because sum_r Delta-alpha_r = 0, test whether the redistribution is DIRECTED: does weight move specifically toward the slot with the higher n_downstream_ejc, or merely away from the perturbed slot? Only the former supports a selection mechanism.
matched_reference: The identical permutation operator applied to 30 frame-matched control hexamers elsewhere in the same ATG window, at the same codon phase, in the same isoforms — matched because permutation preserves base composition exactly (channel 5 unmoved) and because the control blocks share the isoform, the window, the padding state and the frame (trap 3). Plus a matched population: the split must be computed at matched slot attention, since the brief already measured that the Kozak effect reverses sign between attention terciles (+0.0058 middle, -0.0024 top).
would_refute: The permutation range at -6..-1 does not exceed the frame-matched control blocks' range at matched n; or the Delta-alpha term is not the dominant term, which would say Kozak acts as a verdict feature and contradict the selection story; or the attention redistribution is undirected with respect to the receiving slot's PTC status.

title: The 50-nt boundary is a learnable distance element: slide the junction mark 3' of the stop with the EJC count pinned
element: An exon-exon junction located d nt 3' of the in-frame stop codon, carried as a single 1.0 in channel 4 of the stop window. The element is the ORDERED DISTANCE RELATION (stop codon, junction) -- not the junction, and not the count of junctions.
test: SLIDE, don't implant, as the primary arm -- this is the on-manifold choice. Select isoforms whose slot-0 stop window has EXACTLY ONE channel-4 mark in the downstream half, whose ORF is >=400 nt (so the midpoint clip leaves >=200 nt of filled upstream room), and whose downstream half is filled to at least +250 (test with frame_span(), already implemented in analysis_plans/measure_position_bank.py:64). For each isoform, zero the existing mark and re-place it at d in {+4,+8,...,+240} and, as the control arm, at d in {-4,...,-200} (upstream of the stop, still inside the window). Recompute channel 5 over the filled extent with the existing recompute_gc() -- it will be numerically unchanged, since channel 4 does not enter the GC computation; assert that, as the cheapest possible correctness guard. CRITICALLY: hold orf_features at its baseline value for every offset, including the upstream arm. The tabular block is therefore bit-identical across the entire sweep, so no part of the curve can be attributed to the count. Score all 5 sweep checkpoints (seeds 100-500, results_4ct_sweep). Secondary arm: IMPLANT a mark into isoforms with zero downstream junctions, for shape agreement with the slide.  SPURIOUS IF: (a) the curve tracks the window's padding boundary or the transcript end rather than the stop -- excluded by requiring fill to +250 and by verifying the curve is invariant to how much filled sequence lies beyond the last offset; (b) the mark is off-manifold because real junctions sit on splice-derived exon-end composition and my relocated mark does not -- this is exactly why the primary arm SLIDES an existing mark (the (nucleotide, mark) joint is wrong only in position, never in existence or count) and why the implant arm is secondary and required only to agree in SHAPE, not in level; (c) the effect is the no-op floor -- bounded by re-placing the mark at its original d, which must return |delta| <= 3.3e-5 (the measured floor in probe_ism_cost_runlog.txt).  ADJACENCY TO A DEAD METHOD: this is NOT inference-time flag ablation (brief section 6). That method removed information and was found to measure attention dilution. Here the information content of the tabular block is held exactly constant and only a position moves; there is nothing to dilute.
matched_reference: THREE references, as trap 1 demands. (1) Method noise floor: re-placing the mark at its original position, which is an exact no-op and bounds every effect from below (measured floor 3.3e-5). (2) Other positions: the upstream arm -- the identical single mark, identical nucleotides, identical tabular count, identical GC, moved only to the 5' side of the stop where the biology says it is inert because elongating ribosomes have already stripped it. This is matched on every quantity in the input except the sign of the stop-junction relation, which is the whole hypothesis. (3) Matched population: isoforms are paired with themselves (every offset is the same isoform), and the population is additionally stratified by baseline n_downstream_ejc and by stop-codon identity so the breakpoint distribution is not read off a composition-skewed subset. A fourth, observational reference already exists in the data for free: isoforms whose only downstream junction lies WITHIN 50 nt of the stop are counted as EJC-positive by the tabular feature but are not PTC-positive biologically -- if the model's slide curve has a real boundary, its predictions on that natural-experiment stratum must be shifted toward non-NMD relative to the count-matched >50 nt stratum.
would_refute: Three distinct negatives, all informative and all pre-registered. (1) FLAT: the curve is within the no-op floor at every d, in both arms. Conclusion: channel 4's position carries nothing; the model's entire EJC signal is the tabular count, and the 'structural branch dominates' result in the brief is a statement about an annotation, not about sequence. (2) BREAK AT ~42 nt WITH A 4-nt STAIRCASE: that is conv2's receptive field and mid_pool(4)'s quantization, not biology. The honest claim collapses to 'the architecture can only represent junction proximity out to 42 nt', which refutes the biological reading and simultaneously identifies the fix. (3) GRADED, NO BREAK: refutes the step sub-hypothesis; the model encodes junction distance as a continuous discount, which is not the textbook mechanism. Only a break in the 46-58 nt range, absent from the upstream arm, supports the claim as biology.

title: The stop tetranucleotide (stop codon plus its +4 base) modulates susceptibility, tested by matched-substitution rather than matched-base
element: The four nucleotides at the termination site: the stop triplet itself (TAA / TAG / TGA) and the nucleotide immediately 3' of it, e.g. TGA|C (leakiest) versus TAA|A (tightest). The element is the tetranucleotide, localized at the stop anchor in the stop window.
test: TWO operators, both anchored at the stop in the stop window, both with channel 5 recomputed over the filled extent and channels 6-8 untouched (the stop stays a stop, so the frame one-hot and every tabular number are unchanged). (a) STOP IDENTITY: substitute TAA <-> TAG <-> TGA at the anchor. ORF geometry, orf_features and the midpoint clip are all invariant. The composition confound is real and severe (TGA carries a G), and the fix is to match the SUBSTITUTION rather than the base: apply the IDENTICAL single-base change, at the identical offset within an in-frame codon, at codons -3, -6, -9, +3, +6, +9 relative to the stop, where the same base lands in a non-stop context inside the same window at matched distance. The contrast is (delta at the stop codon) minus (mean delta at the matched non-stop codons). A position-independent base preference -- the exact confounder that killed Kozak +4 in section 5 -- cancels identically in that difference and cannot survive it. (b) THE +4 BASE: GC-matched operators ONLY (A<->T and G<->C), per trap 2, which reported control positions 100% same-signed with |t| median 5.79 under a G-vs-notG operator. Stratify by whether slot 0 carries a junction beyond 50 nt (derivable from junctions.tsv plus the ORF stop; the tabular count alone will not do, since it has no distance filter). MATCHING FOR (b) IS WITHIN-GENE: use label-discordant sibling isoforms of the same gene that DIFFER in slot-0 downstream EJC status. The brief states 21.9% of discordant pairs share slot-0 EJC count, so the complementary 78.1% are the pairs this test wants -- same gene, same broad sequence context, opposite EJC status. That makes the conditionality contrast within-gene rather than a between-population comparison of unlike transcripts. SPURIOUS IF: the effect is base composition (excluded by the matched-substitution difference in (a) and by GC-matched operators in (b)); or the model is reading 'last real codon before padding' rather than a stop (excluded by requiring the downstream half filled to >= +200); or +4 correlates with 3'UTR GC (excluded by the GC-neutral operator plus channel-5 recomputation, which together leave channel 5 bit-identical -- assert it).
matched_reference: (1) Noise floor: substituting the observed base for itself, bounded at 3.3e-5. (2) Other positions: the SAME base change at the SAME within-codon offset at codons +/-3, +/-6, +/-9 from the stop -- matched on the substituted nucleotide, on frame offset (trap 3: exclusion rates differ 23.6% vs 8.7% between codon offsets), on distance from the anchor, and on the local GC support that channel 5 integrates. This is the reference the Kozak +4 result never had, and it is why this proposal is not that proposal repeated at a different anchor. (3) Matched population: within-gene label-discordant sibling pairs differing in slot-0 EJC status -- controls gene identity, expression context and broad composition, and reuses the validity framework already trusted in section 5 (concordance 0.919 overall, 0.803 at matched EJC count).
would_refute: If the stop-identity delta is indistinguishable from the matched non-stop-codon deltas, the model does not read stop identity and the existing stop-codon frequency result (10_export_stop_codon_freq_sf37.py) is a compositional or selection artifact of which ORFs get scanned, not a causal element. If the +4 effect is present but EQUAL in EJC-positive and EJC-negative siblings, it is a global base preference and is refuted by its own mechanism -- a termination-efficiency element cannot act where there is no EJC to strip. That second negative is the sharp one: an effect that survives without the conditionality is a confounder, and section 7 note 7 warns this has already happened twice.

title: The start codon is a composite element, not a base preference: an epistasis null built from the 42-nt receptive field
element: The composite AUG-plus-context element: the AUG trinucleotide together with the purine at -3, required JOINTLY within a single 42-nt window. Secondarily, the stop-plus-junction composite (stop triplet with a channel-4 mark <42 nt downstream).
test: TWO coupled experiments in the slot-0 start window, both using GC-NEUTRAL operators (A<->T, G<->C) at EVERY perturbed position, so that channel 5 is bit-identical before and after -- assert max|delta channel 5| == 0 as a hard guard. This single constraint is what makes a two-position perturbation interpretable at all, because two nearby substitutions otherwise share ~50 nt of rolling-GC support and delta_ij != delta_i + delta_j for a purely compositional reason. (a) TRAVELLING-AUG IMPLANT. At offsets o in {-90,-87,...,-9} and {+9,...,+90} (frame offset recorded, both in-frame and out-of-frame with the native AUG), implant ATG, and as the matched control implant ATC. ATG->ATC is a single G->C change -- GC-neutral, one base different, same length, same position -- so the pair differs in START-CODON IDENTITY and in essentially nothing else. Then run a local ISM at o-4..o-1 and o+4 in both backgrounds. The claim is that a -3 sensitivity appears in the ATG background and not in the ATC background. (b) PAIRWISE EPISTASIS WITH AN ARCHITECTURAL NULL. For an anchor position i (the A of the native AUG; separately, the T of the stop in the stop window), sweep partner positions j at separations 3..120 nt. Measure delta_i, delta_j, delta_ij and form epsilon_ij = delta_ij - delta_i - delta_j. THE NULL IS FREE AND EXACT: for |i-j| > 42 nt no conv2 unit sees both positions, batchnorm is in eval mode and is per-channel affine (it cannot couple positions), and the only remaining path is the global max -- so epsilon at separations >42 nt is the distribution of 'interaction that is NOT a composite motif', measured with the identical operator, the identical isoforms, the identical bases and the identical GC guarantee. That is a null built from the architecture rather than from a shuffle, which matters because the project's shuffle-based null already died (dinucleotide shuffle of a 3-mer is the identity map). SPURIOUS IF: epsilon at short separation is GC coupling (excluded by the bit-identical channel-5 assertion, which is checkable, not argued); or the implanted ATG changes which ORFs would be selected (it does not -- this arm is window-local and slot membership is fixed by construction; the on-manifold version of that concern is the separate full-rescan proposal); or the implant creates an in-frame stop or a second ATG (excluded by the created-motif exclusion already implemented at measure_position_bank.py:146-153, applied to both the ATG and ATC arms so the exclusion RATE is matched -- trap 3).
matched_reference: (1) Noise floor: the no-op substitution, 3.3e-5. (2) Other positions: the >42 nt separation arm for epistasis -- matched on operator, isoform, base identity, exclusion rate and GC invariance, differing ONLY in a separation the architecture cannot bridge with a joint filter. And the ATC implant for the travelling-AUG arm -- matched to one GC-neutral base. (3) Matched population: within-isoform pairing throughout; both arms of every contrast are the same isoform and the same checkpoint, so gene identity, expression and label are held exactly.
would_refute: If the epsilon distribution at <42 nt separation is indistinguishable from the >42 nt distribution, the model holds NO composite sequence elements and every element it uses is a marginal single-position preference. That is a strong, publishable constraint on what 34,050 parameters with 32 conv channels per branch can encode, and it also retroactively validates the marginal ISM design the project has been using. If implanted AUGs produce no new -3 sensitivity while the native -3 does, then -3 is not part of a start-codon composite and the Kozak claim cannot be stated as 'the model reads Kozak context'; at best it reads a base at an index. If implanted AUGs produce a LARGER -3 sensitivity than the native AUG, the saturation explanation is confirmed and the tiny marginal effect stops being evidence against the element.

title: The oORF cassette: an upstream ORF whose stop lies out of frame INSIDE the CDS, implanted through the full scan-and-select pipeline
element: A minimal upstream ORF cassette -- gccRccAUGG + N sense codons + an in-frame stop -- implanted at a defined offset in the 5'UTR. The element is the FRAME RELATION between the cassette's stop and the main AUG: a cassette terminating in the 5'UTR (leaky, reinitiation-competent) versus the same cassette shifted 1 nt so it reads past the main AUG out of frame and terminates inside the CDS (an oORF, no reinitiation rescue).
test: A FULL-PIPELINE IMPLANT, which is the point -- every perturbation in this project so far has been window-local, and the brief's own open question 4 flags that as 'the off-manifold version'. Edit the transcript FASTA; re-run an ORF scan over the edited sequence; re-run the documented priority selection (reference CDS, then TD2 CDS, then top Kozak, ties by transcript order -- select_priority_orfs, data_prep.py:515); re-encode ALL K windows for ALL slots; re-score. Junction coordinates shift by the insert length downstream of the insertion point and must be shifted too, and n_downstream_ejc must be recomputed for every slot. GUARD, and it is the whole credibility of the arm: the harness must reproduce results_4ct_dn/selected_orfs.tsv exactly on UNEDITED transcripts before a single edited one is scored. BACKGROUNDS: the 15,765-isoform 'PTC-, no trigger' class (2.2% NMD+), which has headroom and no competing trigger. THREE IMPLANTS PER BACKGROUND PER OFFSET, all the same length: (i) cassette in frame f such that its stop falls in the 5'UTR; (ii) the SAME cassette at offset o+1 so the ORF reads past the main AUG out of frame and terminates in the CDS; (iii) the same cassette with ATG mutated to ATC -- composition matched to one GC-neutral base, creates no ORF, and therefore cannot displace anything from the top-5 slots. SPURIOUS IF: (a) the effect is slot DISPLACEMENT rather than the element -- a new ORF can push a real one out of the 5 slots, and the brief already documents that only 5 of a mean 36.6 ORFs are kept. Excluded by recording per implant whether slot membership changed and reporting the effect separately for changed and unchanged, and by the ATC control, which alters composition identically but creates no candidate; (b) composition/GC -- excluded by drawing cassette interiors from DINUCLEOTIDE-SHUFFLED 30-mers of the recipient 5'UTR. Note the adjacency to section 6: what died there is the dinucleotide-preserving shuffle of a 3-MER, which has exactly one arrangement and is the identity map. A 30-mer does not have that property, and the number of distinct arrangements should be counted and reported per cassette rather than assumed; (c) the midpoint clip or the transcript-end fill changes for an existing slot -- recorded and required unchanged, or the isoform is dropped. STATED FLOOR: the ORF scan has a 33-nt minimum, so cassettes must be >=33 nt and a canonical 3-codon regulatory uORF (ATF4 uORF1) cannot be implanted at all. That is a limitation of the instrument, and it is worth reporting as one.
matched_reference: (1) Noise floor: implanting the cassette and then reverting the edit -- exercises the whole re-scan path and must return to the baseline logit bitwise, which is a much stronger floor than a window-local no-op because it tests the harness as well as the model. (2) Other positions: implants (i) and (ii) at offsets o and o+1 -- identical sequence, identical length, identical Kozak, identical composition, positions differing by 1 nt. Nothing except the frame relation to the main AUG differs. This is the tightest matched reference available anywhere in this project. (3) Matched population: the ATC-start control at the same offset in the same isoform, which isolates 'a new ORF exists' from 'new bases exist'.
would_refute: If (ii) minus (i) is indistinguishable from zero while (i) minus (iii) is clearly positive, the model registers 'an upstream ORF was created' but not the frame relation that distinguishes the potent class from the leaky one -- the expected negative, and it is the finding. It converts an architectural argument (attn_score is per-slot, frame channels are ORF-relative) into a measurement, and it is the concrete justification for a cross-slot retrain, which is otherwise being argued from code reading alone. If (i) minus (iii) is ALSO zero, then implanting a bona fide upstream ORF into a naive background does not move the prediction, and the model's uORF signal is entirely a selection artifact of which ORFs occupy the slots -- which would reframe the whole upstream-ORF section of the manuscript. If the paired difference is positive as predicted, the model has learned a relation the architecture was not obviously able to hold, and that itself needs explaining (most likely via n_downstream_ejc differing between the two cassettes, which must be checked before any positive is believed).

title: Transcript extent 3' of the stop as an element: a two-arm truncation ladder that separates 3'UTR length from EJC count
element: The amount of transcript sequence present 3' of the stop codon -- long-3'UTR / EJC-independent NMD. Encoded to the model as the FILLED EXTENT of the stop window's downstream half, which is unclipped except by the transcript end, so 'padding begins at +L' literally means 'the transcript ends at +L'.
test: A PAIRED TRUNCATION LADDER on slot 0's stop window. Select isoforms whose downstream half is filled to at least the 60th percentile of observed fill. For remaining extents L in {450,400,...,100,50,25,0} (never truncating below the 5th percentile of the real fill distribution, so BatchNorm's running statistics are never asked to generalize outside their calibration range), zero all 9 channels at positions beyond +L and recompute channel 5 over the new filled extent with the existing recompute_gc(). WHY ZEROING IS LEGITIMATE HERE, and why this is not the dead entry: section 6 kills NAIVE ZEROING AS MODALITY DROPOUT, a TRAINING-time failure -- with the input identically zero, dL/dW = delta.x^T = 0 exactly, so the weights reading it cannot relearn. That argument is about gradients and does not apply at inference. More importantly, an all-zero column is not an arbitrary off-manifold value in this encoder: it is EXACTLY the representation the encoder uses for 'transcript ended here' (encode_window_v5 zero-fills beyond w_end, data_prep.py:130-146). Occlusion by zeroing is therefore ON-manifold in this specific architecture, which is a rare and checkable property and should be stated as the design's justification rather than glossed. TWO ARMS, and the two-arm structure is the proposal:   ARM A (biologically consistent): remove channel-4 marks beyond +L and decrement n_downstream_ejc accordingly. This is 'the transcript ends at +L'.   ARM B (sequence-only): truncate the nucleotides but hold every channel-4 mark and the tabular count at baseline. Physically impossible, deliberately so. Arm A minus arm B is the EJC contribution to the truncation; arm B's residual dose-response is the bare length element with the EJC route pinned shut. That difference is what no single-arm design can deliver, and the EJC/length confound is precisely the one this project keeps re-encountering. SPURIOUS IF: (a) it is the GC recomputation over a shorter support -- excluded by matching, per isoform, the GC content of the removed segment between the downstream arm and the inward control arm to within 2%; (b) it is BatchNorm drifting on unusual fill fractions -- excluded by the 5th-percentile floor and by verifying that the effect is present within the interquartile range of real fills; (c) it is the junctions alone -- that is the entire point of arm B.
matched_reference: (1) Noise floor: truncating zero positions, an exact no-op through the identical recomputation path. (2) Other positions: the INWARD control arm -- remove the same NUMBER of positions, with per-isoform matched GC content, from the CDS-side (upstream) end of the stop window instead. That side is bounded by the ORF midpoint clip rather than by the transcript end, so removing it does not mean 'the transcript is shorter'; it is matched on count, on composition, on the channel-5 recomputation path and on the model's exposure to zero columns, and differs only in which side of the stop the removal happens. (3) Matched population: paired within isoform at every rung, and stratified by baseline fill and by n_downstream_ejc so the slope distribution is not read off transcripts that are all short or all EJC-rich.
would_refute: If arm B is flat within the no-op floor at every rung while arm A is not, the model has NO 3'UTR-length element and its entire downstream signal is the EJC count -- EJC-independent NMD is simply not represented, which is a clean, stateable limitation and a constraint on how the manuscript can describe the model's coverage of NMD mechanisms. If BOTH arms are flat, the downstream half of the stop window contributes nothing beyond what the tabular block already carries, which would call into question the value of the 1000/2000-wide stop window entirely and has direct architectural consequences. If the inward control arm shows the same slope as the downstream arm, the effect is 'zeros were added' rather than 'the transcript got shorter', and the finding is withdrawn.

title: The stop-to-junction distance boundary: is it 50 nt (biology) or 42 nt (the receptive field)?
element: An exon-exon junction mark (input channel 4) located exactly d nucleotides 3' of the termination codon. The element is the junction's POSITION relative to the stop, not the count of downstream junctions.
test: Background population: the 15,765 'PTC- no trigger' isoforms, where implanting one mark creates the trigger de novo against a clean baseline. Grid d in {6,12,...,300} in the stop window's downstream half (unclipped except by transcript end). 2x2 factorial per d: (channel-4 mark implanted / not) x (n_downstream_ejc incremented by 1 / left at the observed value) - this separates 'junction as a positioned sequence event' from 'junction as a tabular count' rather than confounding them. Mirror arm: the identical mark at -d, upstream of the stop inside the CDS, where junctions are real and NMD-neutral. Eligibility applied identically at every d: filled extent covers d +/- 25, no real junction within 25 nt of the implant site. Channel 5 is untouched by a channel-4 edit, so the operator is composition-neutral BY CONSTRUCTION, not by matching - the first operator in this project for which trap 2 cannot operate. Per isoform, fit Delta_i(d) with a monotone-constrained isotonic regression and take b_hat_i as the largest discrete jump. Repeat the whole bank anchored on the ref-AUG-traced stop and on a Kozak-fill slot, so the answer does not condition on the annotated ORF (trap 6).
matched_reference: Three references, all required. (i) METHOD FLOOR: implanting a mark where one already exists is a no-op; its |effect| is the arithmetic floor and every effect is reported against it. (ii) POSITION-MATCHED: the upstream mirror at the same |d| carries an identical channel-4 edit, identical mark count, identical composition and identical recomputation path, but no NMD meaning. Every statistic is reported as target-minus-mirror at matched |d|. This is precisely how the design escapes the dead inference-time flag ablation (brief section 6): that method died because it shrank control positions (0.66x) alongside targets (0.42x), i.e. it measured global attention re-weighting. Differencing target against mirror at each d cancels any global re-weighting term exactly, because both arms perturb the same slot's same channel by the same amount. (iii) POPULATION-MATCHED: the same implant in PTC+ isoforms (n=6,864, already 70.0% NMD+), where an added junction should saturate - a dose-response prediction, not a single contrast.
would_refute: (a) Delta_i(d) flat with no breakpoint above 10x the floor: the model's junction knowledge is entirely in the tabular n_downstream_ejc and channel 4 is decorative - which would retire several downstream claims about sequence contribution. (b) b_hat concentrated at 40-44 with 4-nt quantization matching the mid-pool stride: the boundary is the instrument's receptive field, not biology, and cannot be stated as a discovered element. (c) Target-minus-mirror null while both arms individually move: attention dilution, not distance. (d) In the retrain arm, unchanged test AUC after positional shuffling of channel-4 marks: positional junction information is unused and the premise fails outright.

title: uORF start-codon context acts on the NMD verdict through ORF selection, not through the verdict on any one ORF
element: The -6..-1 start-codon context, and specifically the -3 purine, of an UPSTREAM PTC-generating ORF - the Kozak strength of a uORF/oORF AUG. Not the main AUG's context, which is what has been measured so far.
test: Use the already-validated factorized head (probe_head_swap.py: ensemble dAUC -0.0008, rank correlation 0.9995, manual-form guard 1.43e-06). Per isoform, set slot r = the most upstream ORF starting 5' of the reference AUG. Run the existing measure_position_bank.py with --slot r over the frame-offset-matched bank (targets -3 and +4; 37 controls at the same codon frame offset). For each (isoform, member, position, operator in {A_vs_T, G_vs_C} - the two GC-neutral operators): TE = g_fac(alpha', e') - g_fac(alpha, e); NIE = g_fac(alpha', e) - g_fac(alpha, e); NDE = g_fac(alpha, e') - g_fac(alpha, e). Because attn_score sees one slot at a time (model.py:152), the mediator is a single scalar s_r and alpha = softmax(s); the mediator is deterministic, fully observed, and the treatment is assigned by us, so these are EXACT natural direct/indirect effects with no sequential-ignorability assumption and no completeness error - which is why this is not adjacent to the dead DeepSHAP/gradient route (129-307% completeness error) or to branch-Shapley credit assignment. Nothing is decomposed additively; everything is re-scored. Then fit, over isoforms, NIE ~ alpha_r(1-alpha_r)*(g(e_r) - g_bar) * PTC_r with gene-clustered standard errors. Two pre-registered coefficients: the slope and the PTC interaction, alpha = 0.025 each.
matched_reference: (i) The 37 frame-offset-matched control positions, each carrying the identical operator, identical created-motif exclusion rule and identical mediation decomposition; slope, interaction and excess rate are each reported as a percentile within the control set, and the control set's own median |t| and sign-agreement rate are printed alongside (across-member agreement alone is worthless - controls agree 65-92% against a 6.25% chance rate). (ii) Population-matched: the same perturbation in isoforms whose slot-r stop is NOT a PTC by the >50 nt rule. (iii) The no-op floor. Percentile resolution and family-wise error are stated: 37 controls give 38 attainable ranks, and with two operators x two positions the best-of-4 family-wise rate is ~1 in 10, so percentiles are reported as comparisons and never as tests.
would_refute: (a) NIE and NDE both at the control percentile: the element is not read at all. (b) NIE positive but the PTC interaction null: the model reads initiation strength as a generic feature and does not route it to a verdict - the mediation story is wrong even though a number moved. (c) NDE dominating NIE: the context is being read as a property of that ORF's own NMD verdict, which is not the biology and points at a residual composition artifact. (d) The alpha(1-alpha) slope null while the mean effect is nonzero: the attention-tercile sign reversal in the brief (+0.0058 middle, -0.0024 top) is not softmax geometry and needs a different explanation. Note the guard against a vacuous confirmation: the alpha(1-alpha) form is mechanically true of ANY softmax, so the slope alone is not evidence - only the slope TOGETHER WITH the PTC interaction is.

title: Sibling chimeras: transplant 100-nt tiles between label-discordant isoforms of the same gene to localize the causal sequence difference
element: The 100-nt sequence tile, within the start or stop window, that carries the transferable NMD difference between two isoforms of one gene with opposite labels. The tile is the discovery unit; the element is then NAMED post hoc on the tiles that transfer (junction position, stop codon identity, GC, motif) and re-tested by the targeted operators of the other hypotheses.
test: Build the within-gene, label-discordant sibling pair table and RESTRICT to the subset that shares slot-0 n_downstream_ejc - the brief's own harder validity subset (21.9% of pairs, within-gene concordance 0.803 there against 0.919 overall) - so the dominant structural feature is held fixed by design rather than adjusted for. For each pair (A NMD+, B NMD-), tile each 1000-nt window into 10 tiles of 100 nt. For tile t build the chimera B<-A_t: replace tile t of B's slot-0 window with A's aligned tile, recompute channel 5 over the filled extent exactly as data_prep does, and leave every tabular feature at B's values. Measure transfer_i(t) = [f(B<-A_t) - f(B)] / [f(A) - f(B)], both directions. Three sham arms: (i) B<-B_t, an exact no-op, giving the floor; (ii) tiles where A and B are byte-identical - this exercises the full splice-and-recompute machinery while carrying zero information, and is the SEAM control; (iii) a donor tile from a GC-decile- and junction-count-matched isoform of a DIFFERENT gene. Note what this design does not need: every input is real sequence in a real context, so the off-manifold objection that killed frame-rotation probes and that the Analysis 5 propagated-substitution control exists to police simply does not arise.
matched_reference: (i) The IDENTICAL-TILE sham is a within-pair, on-manifold, zero-information control that still incurs every seam and recomputation artifact - it is the exact matched reference for 'does splicing anything in move the prediction'. (ii) The cross-gene GC- and junction-matched donor is the composition- and structure-matched but biologically unrelated reference; it separates 'the specific sibling difference' from 'generic disruption'. (iii) The no-op floor. (iv) Gene identity is held fixed by construction, so the confounder class that has twice produced a confident-but-wrong negative in this project (trap 7 - population differences masquerading as sequence effects) cannot operate at all.
would_refute: (a) Transfer fractions flat across tiles: the gap is not localizable in the sequence windows and is carried by the tabular block, which the design deliberately holds at the recipient's values - that is itself a reportable result bounding what sequence contributes. (b) The identical-tile sham transferring as much as informative tiles: the seam artifact dominates and the method is dead on arrival, which is exactly what a control that can fail is for. (c) The cross-gene matched donor transferring as much as the sibling donor: the effect is generic window disruption, not the specific difference. (d) Argmax tiles uniformly distributed while median transfer is nonzero: an effect exists but is not attributable to a nameable element, and the discovery goal fails even though a statistic is significant.

title: Stop codon identity read as a composition-identical permutation: UAG vs UGA, an intervention provably orthogonal to the entire tabular block
element: The stop trinucleotide, contrasted as UAG versus UGA - an exact mononucleotide permutation of the same three bases - crossed with the +4 base (the readthrough tetranucleotide UGA-C).
test: In slot 0's stop window, substitute the stop codon among {UAA, UAG, UGA} and the +4 base among {A,C,G,U}: 12 cells, channel 5 recomputed over the filled extent, baseline built through the identical recomputation path. THE HEADLINE OPERATOR IS UAG vs UGA ALONE, because those two are arrangements of the same mononucleotide multiset: channel 5 is bit-identical between them, and frac_start, frac_stop, is_ref_cds, is_sqanti_cds and n_downstream_ejc are all invariant by construction because no ORF boundary and no junction changed. This is the only intervention available in this project that is PROVABLY orthogonal to the entire tabular block and to the GC channel simultaneously, which is a direct answer to trap 2 (under a G-vs-notG operator control positions are 100% same-signed with median |t| 5.79). UAA is retained as the composition-shifted arm purely to quantify how much of any UAA effect is composition rather than identity. This is explicitly NOT the dead dinucleotide-preserving 3-mer shuffle: that operator is the identity map because 100% of 64 3-mers have exactly one valid dinucleotide-preserving arrangement, whereas UAG and UGA are two DISTINCT arrangements of one mononucleotide multiset.
matched_reference: (i) Frame-matched control positions elsewhere in the stop window carrying the same A<->G transposition operator at the same codon frame offset, giving the operator's own null. (ii) The CEM-matched PTC- population, which is the population reference and the falsifier. (iii) The no-op floor. (iv) A positional mirror: apply the same UAG<->UGA transposition to an in-frame codon 30 nt upstream of the stop (a Trp/Arg-encoding codon) - the identical base edit, identical frame offset, identical composition, no termination meaning.
would_refute: (a) No UGA-vs-UAG difference above the control-position percentile in PTC+, with the equivalence test bounding it below 0.01 logit - a clean, statable negative. (b) An equal difference in the CEM-matched PTC- population: a local sequence preference, not a termination effect. (c) The sign inverted relative to readthrough biology (UGA MORE NMD-prone): the model has learned the genomic correlation between stop identity and 3'UTR composition rather than termination efficiency, and the finding cannot be stated as mechanism. (d) The +4 factor showing the same pattern at the positional mirror: the +4 effect is a generic base preference, which is exactly what the brief already found for Kozak +4.

title: Is the AUG triplet itself a 5'UTR element to this model, outside the ORF-slot machinery? A mononucleotide-permutation implant
element: A single AUG triplet implanted in the 5'UTR at a controlled offset from the main AUG and in a controlled reading frame relative to it.
test: Population: isoforms with a reference-AUG anchor, at least 150 nt of 5'UTR inside slot 0's ATG window, and ZERO AUG upstream of the main AUG in the full ORFik scan (1,540,674 ORFs over 42,043 isoforms), so the implant is the only upstream AUG present. Implant at offsets -40, -70, -100, -130 from the main AUG, at all three frames, recomputing channel 5 exactly as data_prep does. CONTROL ARRANGEMENTS: AGT, GAT and GTA - the three stop-free mononucleotide permutations of ATG - at the identical offsets; TAG and TGA are excluded because they create stop codons. Channel 5 is bit-identical across all four arrangements, so composition is controlled by construction. This is explicitly not the dead dinucleotide-preserving 3-mer shuffle (which is the identity map on every 3-mer); it is a mononucleotide-preserving permutation set with three distinct usable members. Frame-offset matching (trap 3) is enforced by balancing implant offsets mod 3 across the design rather than assumed. POSITIVE CONTROL THAT MUST FIRE: the same permutation operator applied at slot 0's actual start codon (ATG -> AGT). NEGATIVE CONTROL: implant in-frame inside the CDS at least 60 nt downstream of the main AUG, where an AUG is merely a Met codon. Crucially, the implanted ORF is NOT re-scanned into the slots and the tabular block is NOT updated - so this measures exactly and only what the sequence branch learned de novo, and that scope must be carried in the claim.
matched_reference: (i) The three permutation arrangements are exactly composition-matched (channel 5 bit-identical), share the implant offset, the seam and the recomputation path, and differ from the target only in base ORDER - the tightest identity-versus-composition contrast constructible on a 3-mer. (ii) The in-frame CDS implant is the position-matched, biologically-null reference: same triplet, same operator, no upstream-ORF meaning. (iii) The no-op floor. (iv) The positive control is the reference for operator validity, and it is what makes a negative interpretable rather than another confounder (trap 7).
would_refute: A null at every offset and frame WHILE the positive control fires is a clean, bounded negative and is the most likely outcome: it would say the model's upstream-ORF knowledge lives entirely in the ORF-slot and tabular pathway, and therefore that the sub-33-nt uORF blind spot and the 50.8% invisible upstream-PTC population cannot be repaired by anything short of changing the ORF scan. A positive with NO frame ordering (oORF ~ in-frame) refutes the mechanistic form of the hypothesis while leaving the weaker claim 'AUG is read as a token' standing - and those two outcomes must be reported as different results, not merged. A positive at the in-frame CDS implant too would say the model responds to any AUG anywhere, which is a model property and not a discoverable element.

title: Activation-maximal seqlet mining in the stop branch: a composition-independent 3'-proximal motif
element: A 6-12 nt motif in the ~200 nt immediately 3' of the stop codon, recovered as the aligned consensus of the 42 nt receptive-field seqlets sitting under each conv2 filter's global-max argmax in the stop branch. Pre-registered candidate consensuses so the analysis can fail: GU-rich / poly-U (UPF1, CELF1 recruitment), UAUUUAU (ARE), the exonic splice-junction remnant CAG|G, and the PAS hexamer (covered separately). The headline claim names whichever consensus is actually recovered.
test: 1) Register forward hooks on stop_cnn.conv2 (pre-max) for all 5 ensemble members at atg1000_stop1000. For every isoform x slot, record for each of 32 channels the max value and the argmax index i in [0,250). 2) Map i back to input coordinates. Receptive field is 42 nt (conv1 k=15 pad 7, MaxPool1d(4), conv2 k=7 pad 3), quantised to 4 nt by the pool; derive the offset from the padding arithmetic rather than assuming it. Extract the 42 nt seqlet with its anchor-relative offset, GC fraction and frame phase. 3) Per filter, keep the top 1% of seqlets by activation. 4) Build a PWM by aligning seqlets on the filter's own argmax, not on the stop anchor. 5) Cluster the 32 filter-PWMs across all 5 members by gapless-alignment cosine; keep clusters recovered in at least 4 of 5 members. 6) Null: for each real seqlet, draw 1000 control 42-mers from the SAME window of the SAME isoform at offset o' with o' congruent to o mod 3, |o'-o| >= 42, and |GC(o') - GC(o)| < 0.02; build control PWMs identically. 7) Statistic: total information content of the real PWM minus the 99th percentile of the control-PWM IC distribution. 8) Model-free confirmation outside the model: count the recovered consensus in the downstream half of stop windows of NMD+ vs NMD- isoforms matched on slot-0 n_downstream_ejc, window GC and 3'UTR length. The model points; the data must confirm.
matched_reference: Control 42-mers drawn from the same window of the same isoform, simultaneously matched on frame phase (mod 3), GC fraction (+/-0.02) and anchor-relative offset band. That holds isoform identity, composition, position and frame constant at once -- the four references section 7 says have each silently failed here. Cross-member reference: permute filter identity across the 5 members to get the chance rate for a PWM cluster to appear in >=4/5, so that recovery is not the dead 'across-member sign agreement' argument.
would_refute: No filter's top-seqlet PWM exceeds the 99th percentile matched-control information content in >=4/5 members. Then the stop branch holds composition, frame and junction flags and nothing else, there is no motif vocabulary to name, and the motif question is closed for this architecture. Equally refuting: a consensus is recovered but the model-free count in matched NMD+/NMD- windows shows no enrichment, which would make it a model artefact rather than biology.

title: The +14..+25 downstream structure element at an upstream AUG, read out through an exact decomposition of the attention score
element: A GC-rich (structure-forming) 12 nt segment positioned +14 to +25 nt 3' of an AUG. The claim is positional at fixed composition: the identical 12-mer occupying +14..+25 versus -25..-14 relative to the same AUG, with total window composition unchanged by construction because the two 12-mers are swapped rather than implanted.
test: INSTRUMENT (new, exact): at eval BatchNorm is affine and Dropout is identity, so the fusion ReLU is exactly diag(m) for a fixed example and the pre-softmax attention score equals (W_f^T diag(m) w)^T [atg_emb; stop_emb; struct_emb] + w^T diag(m) b_f + b_s. The 96-dim effective weight partitions into three 32-blocks, giving an ATG/stop/structural decomposition of the attention score with EXACTLY zero residual; the same construction applied to head+cls_head gives an exact 64-dim decomposition of the logit. Assert reconstruction to float32 tolerance before any use. OPERATOR: select slots whose ORF starts upstream of the reference CDS start. Excise the native 12-mer at -25..-14 and the native 12-mer at +14..+25 and SWAP them. Window composition is identical by construction; the two sites are 39 nt apart, a multiple of 3. Frame channels 6-8 are position-determined and therefore untouched by any sequence edit, but created motifs are not: exclude any isoform where the swap creates or destroys an AUG or an in-frame stop at either site, and report the exclusion rate separately at each site because section 7 item 3 documents 23.6% vs 8.7% at different codon offsets. MODEL-FREE CONFIRMATION: within each transcript, compare GC at +14..+25 of the GENCODE-annotated CDS AUG against GC at +14..+25 of every non-selected AUG in the same transcript. Within-transcript, so gene identity and global composition are controlled.
matched_reference: Two. (i) The same swap operation applied to a 12-mer pair at -/+(109..120) about a point 200 nt from the anchor: matched on separation, on the magnitude of GC displaced, and on frame, but not straddling the AUG -- this isolates 'downstream of the AUG' from 'GC moved around inside the window'. (ii) The 37 frame-matched control positions already banked from the Kozak work, as the method's own noise floor. Per section 7 item 1, a claim needs the method's noise floor, other positions, and a matched population; (ii) supplies the first two and the within-transcript GENCODE check supplies the third.
would_refute: The median per-isoform Delta falls inside the distribution of the distance-matched non-anchor swap, or the fraction positive is indistinguishable from 0.5. Independently refuting: the within-transcript GENCODE check shows no +14..+25 GC excess at annotated starts -- if the element is not in the data, the model cannot have learned it and a model-side positive would have to be an artefact.

title: Stop+4 C-versus-G: the readthrough-permissive termination context, probed then causally patched between siblings
element: The nucleotide immediately 3' of the stop codon (stop+4), contrasted C versus G within UGA-terminating ORFs, together with the stop+4..+9 hexamer context. This is the stop codon's own 3' context, not the start codon's Kozak +4.
test: 1) PROBE: extract slot-0 stop_emb (32-dim post-fc) for every isoform across all 5 members. Train an L2 logistic probe for C vs G at stop+4, restricted to UGA-terminating slot-0 ORFs, fitted on training chromosomes and reported on test chr1/3/5/7 so the chromosome split is preserved. 2) PROBE REFERENCE: the identical probe for C vs G at stop+40, subsampled to matched class balance -- same encoder, same window, same base pair, same 3-way-free binary contrast, but outside the +1..+9 codon-context region. If stop+4 does not beat stop+40, the encoder is memorising local sequence generically and stop+4 is not special. 3) COMPOSITION: stratify the test set into GC deciles of the stop window and require the stop+4 advantage to hold within decile. C vs G is itself one of the two operators section 7 certifies as GC-matched, so the single-base composition confound is null by construction rather than by adjustment. 4) CAUSAL GATE, ON-MANIFOLD: use the within-gene label-discordant sibling pairs, specifically the 21.9% that additionally share slot-0 n_downstream_ejc (the project's own best-matched population, the one yielding 0.803 concordance). Within it, split pairs into stop+4-discordant and stop+4-concordant. Replace isoform i's slot-0 stop_emb with its partner's REAL stop_emb, recompute attention and logit, record Delta logit. Every patched vector is an activation the encoder actually produced from a real sequence, so this is not the off-manifold failure that killed frame-rotation probes. 5) Additionally project each patch displacement onto the probe's weight vector to confirm the discordant patches move further along the stop+4 direction. 6) In-place synthetic G<->C substitution at stop+4 as a third arm, with created-motif exclusions (a +4 substitution can create a downstream in-frame stop or an AUG) reported separately.
matched_reference: Three. (i) The stop+40 C-vs-G probe -- same base pair, same encoder, same window, distance- and balance-controlled -- which is the encoder's generic sequence-memorisation floor. (ii) Stop+4-concordant sibling patches: same gene, same slot-0 EJC count, discordant NMD label, but matched at stop+4, so the only thing removed is the stop context and everything else the siblings differ in is held. (iii) Within-GC-decile stratification of the probe's test set.
would_refute: Probe AUC at stop+4 fails to exceed the balance-matched stop+40 probe; or the stop+4-discordant patch Delta logit fails to exceed the stop+4-concordant patch Delta logit; or the sign is inverted, with the readthrough-permissive C associated with MORE predicted NMD. Any of the three closes the readthrough-context hypothesis.

title: Sparse dictionary on the pre-pool ATG-branch map: an out-of-frame upstream AUG detector, and the count the max-pool destroys
element: An AUG triplet located 5' of the anchor AUG and in a reading frame different from it -- an oORF/uORF initiation element -- recovered as an atom of an overcomplete sparse dictionary fitted to the 32-channel pre-pool conv2 activation map, together with the full spatial profile of where that atom fires.
test: 1) Hook atg_cnn.conv2 pre-max and collect (32, 250) maps at atg1000_stop1000 for slot 0 of a 6,000-isoform training-chromosome subsample (~1.5M position-vectors, ~200 MB float32). 2) Fit an overcomplete sparse dictionary, 32 -> 256 -> 32 tied-weight autoencoder with L1 on the code, or K-SVD. This fits a probe to activations only; the NMD model stays frozen. 3) Per atom, take the top 0.1% firing positions, map to 42 nt receptive fields, build a PWM plus a histogram of anchor-relative offset and of frame-channel occupancy at the AUG position. 4) ACCEPTANCE requires BOTH: (a) firing positions enriched for a nameable event -- an AUG at frame != 0, an in-frame stop, a junction -- above a null of positions from the same windows matched on offset band, GC (+/-0.02) and frame phase; and (b) causal weight: project the entire activation map onto the orthogonal complement of the atom at EVERY position, continue the forward pass, record Delta logit, and compare against projecting out 200 random 32-dim directions of matched norm. 5) COUNT TEST: define n_oof_upstream_atg model-free from the raw window sequence and ask whether the accepted atom's number of supra-threshold firings tracks it. 6) RETRAIN ARM: retrain one member with x.max(dim=-1) replaced by concat(max, mean of top-3) -- a 32 -> 64 branch, one line in model.py and no data_prep change -- and ask whether AUPRC improves specifically on the PTC-minus-with-upstream-PTC-ORF class (5,913 isoforms, 12.6% NMD+) and not on PTC+ (6,864, 70.0%). A class-specific gain is the signature of a count that was being destroyed.
matched_reference: (i) Atom enrichment: control positions from the same windows matched on anchor-relative offset band, GC and frame phase. (ii) Projection test: 200 random 32-dim directions of matched norm projected identically. This is precisely the reference the dead 'inference-time flag ablation' lacked -- that one shrank control positions 0.66x alongside targets 0.42x with nothing to difference against, so it measured attention dilution; here the matched random directions absorb the dilution and the statistic is the excess. (iii) Retrain arm: the PTC+ class as an internal negative control, since extra pooling capacity per se should help both classes.
would_refute: No atom's firing positions are enriched for any nameable sequence event above the matched null; or accepted atoms' Delta logit lies inside the random-direction distribution of matched norm; or the top-3-mean pooling retrain yields no class-specific AUPRC gain. The last would establish that the 32-dim code carries presence rather than count and that the max pool destroys nothing -- a useful negative, since it would close the 'the architecture is throwing away the uORF count' explanation for the weak uORF signal.

title: The PAS hexamer AAUAAA as a 3'-end ruler: its absence within the stop window increases susceptibility
element: The polyadenylation signal hexamer AAUAAA (and the variant AUUAAA) occurring within the downstream half of the stop window, and its distance from the stop codon. The claim is hexamer IDENTITY, not A-richness.
test: 1) PROBE: train an L2 logistic probe on slot-0 stop_emb for 'a canonical PAS hexamer occurs within 500 nt downstream of the stop', fitted on training chromosomes and reported on test chromosomes, with labels from a direct hexamer scan of the FASTA cross-checked against SQANTI's polyA_motif_found / polyA_motif / polyA_dist (the join already exists in 09_export_polya.py). 2) THE CONFOUND, LED WITH: PAS-in-window is nearly collinear with transcript-end-in-window, and the encoder sees zero padding past the transcript end, so the model could be using the padding boundary as a length ruler and never the hexamer. EXCLUSION (a): evaluate the probe only on isoforms whose transcript end lies entirely OUTSIDE the window, so padding is absent in both arms and only internal/alternative PAS hexamers differ. 3) EXCLUSION (b), causal and composition-exact: in isoforms with a long 3'UTR and no PAS in window, IMPLANT a hexamer at +150, +300 and +450 from the stop, and compare AAUAAA against the five other distinct arrangements of five A and one U (AAAAAU, AAAAUA, AAAUAA, AUAAAA, UAAAAA). Identical mononucleotide composition, identical GC, identical rolling-GC channel to within the U's placement -- the contrast is arrangement alone. 4) FRAME: the three offsets are mutually congruent mod 3 so channels 6-8 are unchanged across offsets; report created-motif exclusions (an implant can create an AUG or an in-frame stop) separately at each offset, per section 7 item 3. 5) FILTER CROSS-CHECK: ask whether any conv2 filter from the seqlet-mining proposal has AAUAAA in its top-seqlet consensus. Convergence of an implant effect with a filter consensus is the strong form of the claim; either alone is weak.
matched_reference: Within isoform, within offset: the five non-PAS arrangements of the same six bases. Composition, GC, offset, frame phase and isoform identity are all identical and only the U's position differs. Second reference: the same implant series run in isoforms that ALREADY carry a PAS within the window, where adding another should do measurably less -- a dose-saturation control that a generic sequence-insertion artefact would not respect.
would_refute: AAUAAA implants are indistinguishable from their five A5U1 permutations at every offset, AND the PAS probe collapses to chance once transcript-end-in-window is matched. That would establish that the model's 3'UTR-length signal is the padding boundary -- a length ruler, not a sequence element -- and close the PAS hypothesis. It would also be worth reporting on its own, since it names a length cue that is an artefact of windowing rather than of biology.

title: Junction-blind retraining with a stop-branch EJC auxiliary head forces the mature-mRNA exon-junction seam k-mer into the sequence encoder
element: The exon-junction seam k-mer in mature mRNA: the 6-mer spanning the last 3 nt of the upstream exon and the first 3 nt of the downstream exon (literature expectation ~ ...MAG | G..., i.e. a seam ~AG|G), occurring more than 50 nt 3' of a stop codon. The implant motif must be the PWM consensus derived empirically from results_4ct_dn/junctions.tsv joined to the SQANTI FASTA over these 41,765 transcripts, not a remembered consensus; the join must first settle whether the 1-based junction coordinate parsed by data_prep.parse_junctions names the last base of the upstream exon or the first base of the downstream one, since that shifts the implant frame by one.
test: Regime: delete channel 4 (the junction indicator) from the input, 9 -> 8 channels, by slicing index 4 out of conv1.weight (32,9,15) -> (32,8,15), and delete n_downstream_ejc from ORF_FEATURE_COLS, 5 -> 4, by slicing struct_fc.weight. Both are dimension deletions with an exact warm start on the surviving weights from the published checkpoint -- not zeroing, so no weight is left with identically zero input and identically zero gradient. Add an auxiliary head on stop_emb ONLY (32 -> 1, tabular block excluded from it) supervised on has_downstream_ejc with weight lambda in {0.1, 0.3, 1.0}; the withholding is what makes this head non-trivial, since with channel 4 present it is solved by counting marks. Train 5 seeds. Then: in the 15,765 'PTC- no trigger' isoforms (no real junction downstream of slot-0's stop), implant the empirical seam 6-mer at +80 nt downstream of the stop codon and record the change in the main classification logit. The auxiliary head is discarded at readout.
matched_reference: Three references, matching the three the project has silently failed before. (1) Noise floor: composition-identical permutations of the seam 6-mer implanted at the same position in the same isoform -- identical GC, so the recomputed channel-5 rolling GC is identical and the composition-dominates-identity trap cannot fire. (2) Other positions: the same seam 6-mer implanted at -80 nt (inside the ORF, 5' of the stop), where an EJC is mechanistically not a trigger -- same motif, same composition, same distance, only the side of the stop differs; plus the 37 banked frame-matched control positions. (3) Matched population: isoforms that already carry a real junction near +80, where the implant should be near-saturating and the effect should shrink.
would_refute: Seam implants indistinguishable from their own composition permutations after per-isoform gating, at every lambda and every seed, refutes it: mature-mRNA sequence carries no junction signature recoverable at 32 conv channels, and the model's PTC ability is entirely annotation-borne. A positive effect that survives the permutation control but is equal at +80 and -80 also refutes the causal reading -- that would be a seam detector with no positional gating, i.e. a splicing-composition effect rather than an NMD effect.

title: CDS-flag-blind retraining, with the by-construction positives removed from the loss, makes the out-of-frame upstream AUG a discoverable element
element: An out-of-frame AUG in the 5'UTR within ~150 nt 5' of the annotated start codon. The contrast is the reading register of an otherwise identical trinucleotide: an AUG at an offset congruent to the main ORF's frame is an N-terminal extension and mechanistically inert, while the same AUG one or two bases over opens a competing ORF.
test: Regime: delete columns 2 and 3 (is_ref_cds, is_sqanti_cds) from ORF_FEATURE_COLS, 5 -> 3, by slicing struct_fc.weight; exact warm start on the surviving columns from each published checkpoint; drop the no_ref_isoform positives from the training loss (join required from Track A, or approximate as 'no isoform of this gene carries a ref-CDS slot'). Train 5 seeds; expect and accept an AUC drop, since performance is not the goal. Then, in the ~31,500 isoforms whose slot-0 5'UTR is >=150 nt (75% of slot-0 ORFs; median 5'UTR 325 nt) and which carry no natural uAUG in the target band, implant ATG at offsets -60, -90 and -120 relative to the annotated start, once at an offset congruent to the main frame and once at offset+1 and offset+2. Run identically on the published and the CDS-blind models.
matched_reference: (1) Noise floor: composition-identical permutations AGT, GAT, GTA implanted at the identical position -- same three bases, so channel-5 rolling GC is bit-identical and the composition trap is closed by construction rather than by matching. (2) Other positions: the same operator at -60, -90, -120, plus the 37 banked frame-matched control positions; frame is the variable here rather than a confound, which is the cleanest available answer to the 23.6%-vs-8.7% created-motif asymmetry. (3) Matched population: the in-frame implant is a mechanistically null population sharing isoform, position and motif; plus isoforms already carrying a natural uAUG in the band, where the implant should add little.
would_refute: If the CDS-blind model's out-of-frame-minus-in-frame median is not distinguishable from zero, or is no larger than the published model's, the hypothesis fails and the honest conclusion is that this architecture does not represent initiation competition even when it has to. A positive effect equal at in-frame and out-of-frame offsets refutes the mechanism and indicates a generic ATG detector, not a frame-aware one. Note the cap from trap 8: the coordinate is the annotated start, so the strongest available claim is 'relative to the annotated start', not 'predicts ribosome selection'.

title: A receptive-field ladder decides whether the 50-nt boundary is biology the model discovered or the instrument's own window
element: The positional relation 'nearest exon-exon junction lies within ~50 nt 3' of the stop codon'. This is the protective element; its absence -- a stop whose nearest downstream junction is far -- is the susceptibility element. Verified in the data rather than assumed: n_downstream_ejc as shipped counts junctions strictly downstream of orf_end with NO distance rule (100% agreement at offset 0 over 4,000 sampled ORFs, 90.3% at offset 50), so the 50-nt rule is nowhere in the model's tabular inputs. At slot 0, 3,366 isoforms have their nearest downstream junction <=50 nt -- the feature says 'EJC present', the biology says 'no trigger' -- against 7,492 with the nearest beyond 50 nt.
test: Arms: (a) the published checkpoints, unmodified, as the cheap first pass; (b) retrain with n_downstream_ejc deleted from the tabular block (5 -> 4, exact warm start on surviving columns) so the count shortcut is gone and channel-4 position is the only junction information; (c) arm (b) at four receptive fields via the conv2 kernel and mid-pool schedule -- k2 in {3,7,15} and MaxPool1d in {2,4}, giving RF ~26, 30, 42 and 74 nt at comparable parameter counts. Operator: the junction-RELOCATION scan. In isoforms with exactly one downstream junction at slot 0, move the single channel-4 mark from its true offset to each d in {8,16,...,200} nt downstream of the stop, holding the count, all four nucleotide channels, the frame channels and channel 5 fixed. Channel 5 is recomputed from nucleotides only, so this operator changes exactly one binary channel and nothing else -- the composition trap cannot fire at all.
matched_reference: (1) Noise floor: repeated relocations of the same mark to random offsets in the same isoform, giving that isoform's own relocation-noise distribution. (2) Other positions: the scan is itself a full positional reference -- every d is a control for every other d, within isoform. (3) Matched population: isoforms with zero downstream junctions, where there is no mark to move and the curve must be flat by construction (a sanity floor); plus, as an architectural control, ORFs >=1000 nt (33,396 of the selected ORFs) where the ORF-midpoint clip never binds at the 500-nt stop window, so a step cannot be an artifact of where padding starts.
would_refute: Flat curves at every receptive field refute the hypothesis and carry their own consequence: the model's NMD verdicts run entirely through a junction COUNT with no distance term, so no claim it supports may be stated in terms of the 50-nt rule. A step that scales with RF across the whole ladder refutes the biological reading and identifies the boundary as the instrument's window.

title: Scanning-order slot fill at K=8, warm started exactly, to make the strong-Kozak oORF a visible class
element: An upstream AUG in strong Kozak context whose ORF reads out of frame through the annotated start codon and terminates inside the CDS -- the overlapping ORF (oORF). Distinguished from its sibling element, an upstream AUG whose ORF terminates inside the 5'UTR, by exactly one computable property: where the first in-frame stop downstream of the uAUG falls relative to the annotated start.
test: Regime, two stages. Stage 1 is the published checkpoint used as an exact warm start -- legitimate because no parameter depends on K, so a K=5 checkpoint runs unchanged at K=8. Stage 2 fine-tunes at K=8 with slots filled, after the two CDS priority slots, by 5'-most-AUG scanning order instead of kozak_score. Both fill rules are label-independent and neither selects on PTC status, so no circularity is introduced (trap 6). Operator: the register implant from the CDS-blind proposal (out-of-frame ATG versus in-frame ATG at the same upstream base), applied separately to two strata determined by scanning the transcript for the first in-frame stop from the implant site -- implants that would open an oORF versus implants that would open a 5'UTR-terminating uORF.
matched_reference: (1) Noise floor: composition-identical AGT/GAT/GTA implants at the same base in the same isoform. (2) Other positions: matched implant offsets across strata, with 5'UTR length binned or propensity-matched, because oORF-producing sites sit systematically nearer the annotated AUG and would otherwise be confounded with offset. (3) Matched population: the uORF-producing stratum is the mechanistic comparator -- same operator, same window, same encoder, differing only in whether the resulting ORF overlaps the CDS. Fourth arm, and it is the one that makes the regime claim safe: the published K=5-trained model EVALUATED at K=8 with the same slot fill and no retraining, which isolates 'more slots at inference' (pure attention dilution) from 'trained with more slots'.
would_refute: No widening of the oORF-minus-uORF gap under the K=8 scanning-order regime refutes the proposal; and if the inference-only K=8 arm reproduces whatever widening is seen, the effect is attention dilution rather than learning -- exactly the failure that killed inference-time flag ablation, here made an explicit arm instead of a hazard. A gap present but equal across strata means the model responds to uAUGs generically and the oORF distinction is not represented.

title: Structure-first, sequence-on-the-residual two-stage schedule to expose the stop-codon +4 readthrough context
