Either says the model's uORF handling is frame-blind and the potent/leaky distinction is not encoded from sequence - which would be a real finding, because it would mean the model's uORF signal is entirely the supplied junction count.

title: An upstream PTC-bearing parse imposes decay in proportion to the initiation strength of its own start - tested by adding it as a sixth slot
element: An upstream ORF whose stop has at least one exon junction more than 50 nt downstream, taken together with the -3 purine of that ORF's own AUG as the graded modifier of how much initiation it captures.
test: Three steps. (a) Titration null: duplicate slot 0 m=1..5 times, record dlogit/dalpha per isoform, and verify the softmax redistribution against the exact prediction. (b) Injection with external ground truth: for gene-matched sibling pairs where A is NMD- and B is NMD+ and the two share 5' junction structure (checkable in the local junctions.tsv, so the injected window is sequence A actually contains), inject B's upstream PTC-bearing slot into A at K=6 with B's own tabular block. (c) Graded: edit the injected slot's -3 base under the GC-matched A-vs-T operator and measure d(alpha_new) and d(logit). The chimera is on-manifold for the ENCODER - whose input distribution is over slots, not over transcripts - which is the specific reason this is legal here and would not be in a transcript-level model.
matched_reference: (i) The duplication titration - pure attention movement, zero sequence change, matched alpha_new - which is the strongest available null because it isolates "adding any slot dilutes attention" from "adding THIS parse means something". (ii) Injecting a NON-PTC ORF slot from the SAME donor B: same transcript, same local sequence statistics, same donor, differing only in whether the stop has a junction >50 nt downstream. (iii) Injecting a PTC-bearing slot from an unrelated gene, as the specificity control.
would_refute: Injection moves A's prediction by no more than the duplication titration predicts at matched alpha_new, or the non-PTC donor slot from the same transcript moves it equally. Either says the model treats an added slot as attention dilution and the element carries nothing. Step (c) refutes separately: if alpha_new is insensitive to the injected slot's -3 base, then selection in this model is driven by the annotation flags (is_ref_cds/is_sqanti_cds) rather than by initiation-context sequence - which is a direct, non-circular motivation for the flags-removed retrain, and unlike inference-time flag ablation it does not measure attention dilution because the titration null subtracts exactly that.

title: The distance kernel: the stop-to-junction rule is a step whose location is pinned to the receptive field, not to 50 nt
element: The relation d = (position of nearest exon-exon junction downstream of the stop) - (last base of the stop codon), in nucleotides. Not the junction position (supplied, channel 4) and not the junction count (supplied, n_downstream_ejc = sum(junctions > orf_end) over ALL distances, verified in orf_features.tsv) - the arithmetic difference between them, which appears in no table the model reads.
test: Junction-relocation operator. Restrict to slots with exactly one junction downstream of the stop and inside the stop window. Move that single channel-4 mark to d = 1..400 nt downstream (about 120 sampled values), leaving channels 0-3 and 5-8 byte-identical and leaving n_downstream_ejc at its native value - relocation cannot change sum(junctions > orf_end), so the tabular block is constant by construction. Score all 5 ensemble members at atg1000_stop1000, repeat at atg2000_stop2000. About 600 forward rows per isoform, ~1.3 s at the measured 475 rows/s, so 2,000 isoforms x 5 members is under an hour of wall time at 20-way parallel. DECISIVE ARM (retrain): three architectures identical in parameter count, differing only in conv2 dilation 1/2/3 -> receptive fields 42/63/87 nt (padding = dilation*(k//2)); measure where the step lands in each. NATIVE COMPANION, model-free: empirical NMD+ rate as a function of the same d, computed directly from junctions.tsv + selected_orfs.tsv over all 41,765 isoforms, excluding the 2,240 no_ref_isoform deterministic labels, gene-clustered bootstrap (variance inflation 5.47 already measured).
matched_reference: Three, matched on different axes. (i) NOISE FLOOR: relocate the mark to its own native position through the identical code path; must return exactly zero. The ISM probe's analogous no-op returned 3.3e-5 and was recorded as an indexing error, so this is a live check. (ii) OTHER POSITIONS, within isoform: relocate a natively intra-CDS junction mark over mirrored UPSTREAM distances in slots that also retain their downstream junctions untouched - the tabular count is genuinely unchanged and canonical biology says traversed EJCs are inert, so this arm must be flat. (iii) ARCHITECTURE: the identical relocation in the ATG branch, which has identical kernel sizes, pooling and receptive field but separately trained weights. A receptive-field-shaped step present in both branches is a pooling artifact; one present only at the stop is learned.
would_refute: No resolvable step in more than half of isoforms; or an upstream mirror kernel with a step height statistically indistinguishable from the downstream one; or the same step shape in the ATG branch; or a downstream curve that keeps declining well past 42 nt without any architectural route to do so. Any of these says the model does not compute the relation and that the ~43% of the decision carried by n_downstream_ejc is junction PRESENCE, not junction distance.

title: Proximal-EJC antagonism: does a junction inside 50 nt blunt the trigger from one outside it?
element: A junction PAIR downstream of a single stop, {d_near <= 50 nt, d_far > 50 nt}. The relation at issue is whether the operative variable is min(d) over downstream junctions or an ANY over d > 50 - i.e. which junction actually decides.
test: MODEL ARM: two-mark relocation at fixed count. Restrict to slots with exactly two downstream junctions inside the window; hold n_downstream_ejc at its native value throughout (both marks are retained, only their positions move, so the count is invariant). Full factorial d_A in {10, 25, 40, 60, 100} x d_B in {150, 300}; score all 5 members. Ask whether Delta-logit depends on d_A once d_B is outside the receptive field. NATIVE ARM: among isoforms whose reference-AUG stop has at least one junction more than 50 nt downstream, compare NMD+ rate with vs without an ADDITIONAL junction at or under 50 nt, matched on n_downstream_ejc, on 3'UTR-length decile, and on mechanism class from results_interp_all/mechanism_classes.tsv; gene-clustered bootstrap. GATE BEFORE COMMITTING: count the near+far stratum from junctions.tsv + selected_orfs.tsv; run only if it is in the hundreds.
matched_reference: (i) The same factorial with mark A placed UPSTREAM of the stop at mirrored distances - a traversed EJC, which must be inert; this separates 'proximity to the stop matters' from 'a second mark anywhere near the anchor matters'. (ii) In the native data, the identical near-junction contrast restricted to isoforms whose stop has NO junction beyond 50 nt: there is nothing to antagonise there, so any rate difference in that stratum is confounding (junction density, structural category, intron retention) and is subtracted from the interpretation of the main stratum. (iii) Matching covariates chosen to be exactly the ones that co-vary with having a close junction: 3'UTR length, total downstream junction count, mechanism class.
would_refute: No dependence on d_A at fixed d_B in the model AND no rate difference in the matched native contrast - the rule is a clean ANY and proximal junctions are neutral. A rate difference that appears equally in the control stratum (stop with no far junction) is confounding, not antagonism. The informative asymmetric outcome is also possible and is itself a result: a native antagonism that the model does not reproduce localises something the architecture cannot see.

title: EJC footprint composition: the 24 nt immediately 5' of the triggering junction sets its potency
element: The 24 nt of exonic sequence immediately UPSTREAM of the first junction lying more than 50 nt downstream of the stop - the EIF4A3 footprint - as distinct from the 24 nt immediately downstream of the same junction and from a GC-matched 24-mer elsewhere in the same 3'UTR.
test: Block-swap operator on slots with exactly one downstream junction inside the window at d > 50. Three arms, each preserving the transcript's base multiset exactly: (a) swap [-24,-1] relative to the junction with a donor 24-mer from the same 3'UTR at least 150 nt from any junction, chosen to match GC to within 1/24; (b) the identical swap on [+1,+24]; (c) the identical swap between two donor blocks, neither touching a junction. Channel 5 recomputed through data_prep's own rolling-GC path (measure_position_bank.py already reimplements it and verified agreement to 2.4e-4 against the stored channel); channels 4 and 6-8 untouched; n_downstream_ejc untouched. Restrict to junctions inside the unpadded extent, computed by the existing frame_span(), so the ORF-midpoint clip cannot silently truncate a block. Exclusions: any swap that creates or destroys AAUAAA, or that changes the number of channel-4 marks.
matched_reference: Arm (c) is the matched-POSITION reference at matched GC, matched block length and matched operator. Arm (b) is the matched-DISTANCE reference on the other side of the same junction, so distance to the stop, local GC regime and gene are all held. The noise floor is a self-swap (donor block = target block) through the identical code path. Composition is neutralised by construction rather than by argument - the base multiset of the transcript is invariant under every arm - which is the only class of operator that has ever produced a near-null control here (GC-matched A vs T, G vs C).
would_refute: Arm (a) indistinguishable from arm (c): junction potency is not composition-modulated in anything the model learned, and 'a junction is a junction' stands. Arm (a) approximately equal to arm (b): the model responds to a junction's neighbourhood but with no 5' asymmetry - generic locality, not EJC deposition, and the footprint claim dies.

title: Termination efficiency modulates the same geometry: UGA vs UAG at an EJC-triggering stop
element: The stop tetranucleotide at a stop whose geometry already satisfies the >50 nt rule: codon identity UGA vs UAG (exact anagrams - identical base multiset) and the stop's +4 base.
test: Transposition operator: swap bases 2 and 3 of the stop codon (UAG <-> UGA). The codon's base multiset is exactly preserved and the rolling-GC channel moves by at most one position - quantify that residual explicitly and require it to be no larger than at the control positions. Separately, a GC-matched A-vs-U operator at the stop's +4 (note: this is the STOP's +4, untested; the START's +4 is already dead and is a different position). Run all 5 members. Stratify the population by whether the perturbed slot's own stop is EJC-triggering, using the ptc array in results_interp_all/mechanism_classes.npz, at matched slot-attention weight - the same stratification that already exposed the Kozak sign flip (+0.0087 triggering vs -0.0001 not).
matched_reference: The identical 2<->3 transposition applied at every IN-FRAME codon in the same window whose bases 2 and 3 are {A,G}: same operator, same composition change, same frame, different position. This family cannot create a stop - a codon with T at position 1 and {A,G} at positions 2-3 is already a stop, so no in-frame upstream member exists - which removes the created-motif confounder that killed the Kozak +4 = T operator (18.9% created in-frame stops). The same transposition at OUT-OF-FRAME codons is the frame-matched control, mandatory because created-motif exclusion rates differ 23.6% vs 8.7% between codon offsets. Population reference is the non-triggering stratum at matched attention. Native marginal (SF37 stop-codon frequencies from selected_orfs.tsv `stop_codon`) is reported alongside, precisely to show it is GC-confounded and that the operator is the clean instrument.
would_refute: No UGA/UAG difference at matched geometry; or a difference of the same magnitude at the banked in-frame control codons; or a difference that does not interact with the slot's EJC-triggering status. Any of these says stop identity is a compositional correlate rather than a termination-efficiency signal, and the readthrough story dies.

title: 3'-end proximity as an antagonist of the EJC trigger, not as an independent long-3'UTR trigger
element: The distance from the stop codon to the transcript 3' end, as a MODIFIER of the stop-to-junction relation. The claim is an interaction term, distinct from the known main effect that long 3'UTRs trigger EJC-independent NMD.
test: 3'-truncation operator: zero all 9 channels beyond distance d downstream of the stop, which is exactly the encoder's view of a transcript ending at d. Sample d = 20..600. Run (a) alone, to obtain a stop-to-end kernel directly comparable to H1's junction kernel, restricting to d greater than the position of every retained junction mark so truncation never removes one (removed-mark counts logged and those cases dropped, not silently averaged); and (b) crossed with H1's junction relocation at a fixed far distance, to obtain the interaction. frac_stop is a tabular feature that also encodes relative 3' position, so run each arm twice - once with frac_stop native, once renormalised to the truncated length through the stored normalization/orf_feat_mean and _std - and report both; their difference separates the sequence-channel route from the tabular route. NATIVE COMPANION: among isoforms with a junction more than 50 nt downstream of the reference-AUG stop, NMD+ rate by stop-to-3'-end decile, matched on n_downstream_ejc and on nearest-junction distance, gene-clustered, excluding no_ref_isoform; plus the same split on SQANTI polyA_motif_found / polyA_dist, which 09_export_polya.py already produces.
matched_reference: (i) The identical truncation applied in the ATG branch, same architecture and receptive field, separate weights: a kernel that appears identically in both is a zero-padding artifact rather than a 3'-end signal. (ii) The interaction is its own reference - the junction step height is measured twice in the SAME isoform, so nothing but the truncation differs. (iii) Noise floor: truncation at d beyond the window half-width, which must be an exact no-op. (iv) In the native arm, matching on nearest-junction distance is what prevents the contrast from collapsing into 'short 3'UTRs have fewer downstream junctions'.
would_refute: A flat stop-to-end kernel, or a junction step height that does not change with truncation - 3'-end proximity is not an antagonist in anything the stop branch encodes, and the PABPC1 exception is not represented. A kernel present identically in the ATG branch refutes it as a padding artifact. A native rate gradient that vanishes once nearest-junction distance is matched refutes the interaction framing and returns the observation to the already-known long-3'UTR main effect.

title: Initiation strength at the uORF's own AUG, as a within-isoform paired slot contrast
element: The base at −3 of the Kozak context of an UPSTREAM, PTC-bearing ORF (purine vs pyrimidine, tested as A_vs_T and G_vs_C separately), with +4 G as a second arm. The element is initiation-context strength at the uORF's own start, not at the main AUG.
test: Generalize measure_position_bank.py (analysis_plans/) from a scalar --slot to a per-isoform slot vector, taking slot u = most-upstream qualifying PTC ORF and slot m = the is_ref_cds slot from results_interp_all/mechanism_classes.npz (fields up/most_up/mi/ptc). Bank = {−3, +4} plus every frame-offset-matched control within ±60 (37 positions; the offset-matching is already implemented and is load-bearing — created-motif exclusion is 23.6% at one offset vs 8.7% at another). Operators A_vs_T and G_vs_C as primary (each individually GC-neutral), GC_vs_AT alongside as the deliberate confound isolate, purine and G_vs_notG for continuity with the existing runs; complete-case sides only. Five members (results_4ct_sweep, seeds 100–500), both tags. TWO DESIGN CHANGES FROM ANALYSIS 5, both required here: (i) the substitution is a TRANSCRIPT-COORDINATE perturbation propagated to every window covering that coordinate with channel 5 recomputed in each — the uORF's −3 lies in the 5′ leader and is almost always also inside the main slot's 500 nt upstream ATG window, so window-local perturbation is not just off-manifold, it silently breaks the pairing; window-local becomes the sensitivity arm, not the headline. (ii) Every effect is additionally re-scored with attention FROZEN at baseline (mix the perturbed per-ORF embeddings with the baseline attn_weights, then run model.classifier), splitting each effect into a selection term and a verdict term. Mechanism predicts the selection term carries it.
matched_reference: Three references, per trap 1. (1) Method noise floor: the no-op cells (observed base substituted for itself), measured at 3.3e−5 to ~7e−7. (2) Other positions: the 37 frame-offset-matched controls, each carried through the identical two-slot pairing, so the reference is a distribution of D and not of Δ. (3) Matched population: the same two-slot pairing in PTC− no-trigger isoforms (n=15,765), where the upstream slot's stop is clean — D must be ≈0 there. Plus observed-base stratification, which is not optional: Kozak-filled slots are 93.1% purine at −3 against 79.6% for ref_cds slots, so slot u and slot m differ in composition at the target position by construction.
would_refute: Median D_i ≈ 0 with D at −3 sitting inside the control-position distribution, in BOTH GC-neutral operators, at n≥2,000 and eligibility ≥90%. Or D is real but equally large in the PTC− no-trigger population — then it measures 'perturbing a non-reference window', not initiation. Or D appears only in GC_vs_AT and vanishes in A_vs_T and G_vs_C — composition, not identity. One eligibility caveat that must be reported rather than discovered later: the midpoint clip means a uORF of 33–60 nt has only ~17–30 nt of filled downstream extent, so the +4 target survives but its region-matched downstream controls (+7…+58) do not exist for short uORFs — the +4 arm loses its matched reference in exactly the short-uORF stratum, and must be reported on the upstream-control arm with that stated. Note also that the paired design is the specific fix for why +4 died: a GLOBAL preference for G is common to both slots and cancels in D, so +4 gets one fair re-test here and is not a re-proposal of a dead result.

title: A created AUG raises susceptibility only when the ORF it opens is EJC-triggering
element: An AUG triplet created in the transcript by a single substitution, classified by the RELATION between the stop of the reading frame it opens and the nearest downstream exon junction: PTC-opening (junction >50 nt past the new stop) vs clean-opening.
test: THE PILOT COSTS ZERO FORWARD PASSES. measure_position_bank.py writes vals for all four bases unconditionally and only flags created-motif cells in a separate `excl` array, so results_interp_all/bank_slot0_n500.npz already contains 5-member Δlogit for every AUG-creating substitution it ever measured. Step 1: from the H5 windows, separate created-AUG cells from created-stop cells, which the single `excl` boolean currently conflates (the flag fires for either). Step 2: for each created-AUG cell, decode from the window's own channels the new frame relative to the slot's AUG, the first in-frame stop downstream, and whether a junction lies >50 nt past it — using build_mechanism_classes.py's exact >50 nt rule including the beyond-window rescue via n_downstream_ejc, so the call is window-width independent. Step 3: contrast PTC-opening vs clean-opening. Production run afterwards at n≈2,000 with the upstream arm (5′ leader: genuine new uORFs) and the downstream arm (internal out-of-frame AUGs) as separate strata, and the substitution propagated across overlapping windows.
matched_reference: (1) Non-AUG-creating substitutions at the same positions and bases — the null operator, carried through the identical within-isoform pairing. (2) Created-STOP cells, the other motif class, which truncate the slot's own ORF and must behave differently; if PTC-opening and stop-creating cells move together, the readout is measuring motif creation in general. (3) Population reference: PTC− no-trigger isoforms (n=15,765, 2.2% NMD+), where creating an EJC-triggering uORF has maximum headroom, against PTC+ isoforms (n=6,864, 70.0% NMD+), where the message is already doomed and the contrast should compress toward zero. Method floor as in H1.
would_refute: The paired PTC-opening-minus-clean-opening difference is centered on zero and sits inside the distribution of the same statistic computed for non-AUG-creating substitutions. Given the 42 nt receptive field this is a live and expected-by-some outcome, and a clean null is a real result: it is direct evidence that the model has no sequence-side route from a new start site to its downstream junction relation, which is the strongest available argument that n_downstream_ejc is doing the work rather than being recomputed. Confound to exclude before believing a positive: created-AUG cells are base-asymmetric and offset-asymmetric, so the contrast must be formed within (substituted base × frame offset × arm) cells, never pooled across them.

title: Reinitiation competence — uORF length and the intercistronic gap modulate the initiation effect
element: Two geometric relations of the supplied upstream parse: (a) the uORF's own length, and (b) the intercistronic gap orf_start(main) − orf_end(uORF), which is negative for an oORF that reads into the CDS.
test: Primary arm rides entirely on H1's forward passes: stratify H1's per-isoform statistic D_i by (a) uORF length in strata the data supports — the ORFik scan floor is 33 nt and 467,424 of 1,540,674 scanned ORFs are 31–60 nt, so the short stratum is real and populated — and (b) the gap, including the negative-gap oORF class (n=626). Secondary, model-free label arm: NMD+ rate against the gap within the 5,287 proper-uORF isoforms, matched on the uORF's own n_downstream_ejc, the isoform's junction count, transcript length and GC. Third, mechanism-localizing and explicitly secondary because it is off-manifold: sweep the uORF slot's frac_stop across the main slot's frac_start, once with n_downstream_ejc held at baseline (isolating the reinitiation relation from the EJC count) and once co-varied (the realistic move), restricted to frac_stop values that actually occur for uORFs of this class. This is a graded counterfactual on a continuous geometric feature, NOT modality ablation — the distinction matters because inference-time flag ablation is dead here for measuring sequence contribution.
matched_reference: The same length/gap stratification applied to the CONTROL positions' D — the gradient must be absent there, otherwise it is a property of the stratum (short uORFs have less filled window extent, which changes padding and therefore the method's behavior at every position). Population reference: PTC− no-trigger isoforms, where the gap is defined but there is no trigger, so no gradient should exist. Eligibility reference: report per-stratum n and the eligibility rate, because short uORFs lose their downstream control arm entirely (see H1).
would_refute: D_i flat across length and gap strata, and the label-side gap gradient null after matching. This starts from a measured null rather than from enthusiasm, which is the point: the UNMATCHED binary is already flat — proper uORF 12.6% NMD+ (n=5,287) vs oORF 12.8% (n=626). So a positive must come from the graded relation and the matching, and if it does not appear there, the reinitiation axis is dead in this dataset and should be reported as such. Architectural caveat that must be stated with any negative: the gap is a CROSS-SLOT relation, attn_score sees one slot at a time and cannot compute it, and only the mixture + head can — so a negative on the model-side arm is partly architectural, whereas a negative on the label-side arm is not. The label arm is what decides the biology.

title: Scanning order — the 5′-most competent PTC-bearing uORF sets the verdict, not the count
element: The ordinal position of a PTC-bearing upstream ORF within the leader (5′-most vs distal), and the −3 initiation context of the 5′-most one. The element is ORDER, a positional relation among supplied parses, not a count.
test: Run H1's operator and bank at EVERY PTC-bearing upstream slot in these isoforms. Per isoform, rank that isoform's own uORF slots by frac_start and regress the control-normalized response on cap rank, RESIDUALIZING on the slot's baseline attention weight — attention is the alternative explanation and it has already reversed the sign of a Kozak result between terciles here, so residualizing on it is not optional. Separate label-side arm run on the FULL ORFik scan rather than the slots: NMD+ rate vs the number of PTC-bearing upstream ORFs (expect saturation, not linearity), and, holding count fixed, vs the kozak_score of the 5′-most.
matched_reference: (1) The identical within-isoform ranking computed at the frame-matched control positions — it must be unordered with respect to cap rank. (2) The ranking by baseline attention, which is the competing explanation the residualization removes; report both the raw and residualized versions. (3) Population reference: isoforms with ≥2 upstream ORFs in slots of which NONE is PTC-bearing — cap order should carry no response gradient there.
would_refute: Response rank is fully explained by attention with no residual cap-order term, or it is ordered the wrong way (distal > proximal). Two known biases must be reported alongside the result because either could manufacture a false positive. First, the ORF selection rule: data_prep.select_priority_orfs fills slots 1–4 by descending kozak_score with a mean 6.3 ORFs tied at each isoform's maximum, and pandas' multi-column sort_values is a stable lexsort, so ties should preserve scan order and bias the slots toward cap-proximal ORFs — I am reading that from the code plus pandas internals, not from a measurement, and it must be verified directly before this analysis is trusted. Second, half the true upstream-PTC population is invisible to the slots (12,010 in the full scan vs 5,913 in slots) and the invisible half is the weak half (3.9% vs 12.6% NMD+), so slot-based counts are not full-scan counts and the two arms must never be pooled.

title: The shield — a clean-stop upstream ORF that captures ribosomes protects a PTC-bearing main ORF
element: The −3 initiation context of an upstream ORF whose OWN stop has no junction more than 50 nt downstream, in an isoform whose main (reference-AUG) ORF is PTC+.
test: One experiment, the same bank, operators, propagation and exclusions as H1, stratified into the four cells: PTC+ isoforms (n=6,864) with a clean-stop upstream ORF in a slot; PTC− uORF-PTC (H1's cell, n=5,913); PTC+ with a PTC-bearing upstream ORF; PTC− no trigger (n=15,765). For each cell, perturb the upstream slot and, in the same run, the reference slot, so every isoform supplies its own paired D_i as in H1. Decompose every effect into a SELECTION term (re-score the mixture with attention frozen at baseline) and a VERDICT term (the residual); the mechanism predicts the sign pattern lives in the selection term, and a pattern living in the verdict term is a different and more surprising claim that must be reported as such rather than folded in.
matched_reference: Within each cell, the frame-matched control positions carried through the identical statistic; the claim is precisely that the four CONTROL distributions are indistinguishable from one another while the four TARGET distributions are not. Across cells, matched n by subsampling the large cells down to the smallest, so a sign difference cannot be a power difference. Method floor from the no-op cells. Observed-base stratification, since the upstream slots are Kozak-selected and purine-enriched at −3 in every cell.
would_refute: The sign is the same in all four cells — that would mean an initiation-context response with no NMD content. Note that the obvious deflationary alternative ('attention just follows Kozak, and the score just follows the attended slot') does NOT survive this design, because it still has to produce the partner-dependent flip, and if it does then it IS the mechanism expressed in the model's terms. The refutation is a uniform sign, or four target distributions that differ no more than the four control distributions do. One standing caution: a confident negative in this area has twice been a confounder rather than the model, so any null must be re-run at matched n against matched controls before it is written down, and reported with its eligibility rates.

title: The stop-to-junction proximity relation is computed from sequence, and its threshold is pinned to the conv2 receptive field, not to 50 nt
element: An exon-exon junction mark lying within ~42-50 nt 3' of the stop codon, co-occurring with that stop inside one conv2 receptive field. The element is the RELATION 'junction close behind the stop', not the junction and not the stop separately.
test: Two instrumented training arms, five seeds each, on the standard config. Arm A is the unmodified model. Arm B deletes n_downstream_ejc from ORF_FEATURE_COLS (n_orf_features 5 -> 4; the column is REMOVED, not zeroed -- naive zeroing is dead per brief section 6 because dL/dW = 0 exactly and the branch becomes a learned constant). Channel 4 is untouched in both, per the scoping decision. Checkpoint every 10 optimizer steps, not every epoch: analysis1's run log shows the stored best epochs are 5 and 7, and members run ~14-17 epochs, so with ~26k train isoforms at batch 256 (~102 steps/epoch) there are only ~500-700 steps to peak and epoch granularity would collapse the whole trajectory into 5 points. ~170 snapshots x 453 KB x 5 seeds = ~0.4 GB. Three measurements at every snapshot: (1) score a fixed 4,000-isoform probe set stratified by mechanism_classes.tsv in eval mode and bank the per-isoform logit; (2) junction-shift response curve -- per isoform take slot 0's stop window, clear channel-4 marks in the unclipped downstream half, insert a single mark at d = 1..200 nt from the stop, leaving channels 0-3, 5 and 6-8 untouched (channel 4 is orthogonal to all of them, so no GC recomputation is needed and the operator is composition-exact), record delta log-odds vs d and fit a per-isoform inflection; (3) on the ~5,400 DEMOTED slots (ejc >= 1, no junction beyond 50 nt), record the snapshot at which each isoform's logit crosses from the count-rule prediction to the correct side, and compare against the snapshot at which the count rule itself is established, measured on isoforms where count and the 50 nt rule agree. Harness base: measure_position_bank.py already does per-position perturbation with exact channel-5 recomputation and a per-run no-op floor.
matched_reference: Three, as brief section 7 trap 1 requires. (i) Method noise floor: insert the junction mark at its own observed position through the identical code path; the measured floor for this harness is 9.5e-7 to 1.4e-6 per member at production batch size, and it is reported per run rather than asserted to be zero. (ii) Other positions: the same single-mark insertion in the UPSTREAM half at -d, where no rule exists, and the same insertion into the ATG window; both must be flat or monotone in d and must never show an inflection. (iii) Matched population: DEMOTED slots versus PTC+ slots matched on the exact n_downstream_ejc value, on the slot-0 annotation-flag pair (ref only 49.5% NMD+, ref+TD2 12.0%, TD2 only 27.8%, neither 13.9% -- an unmatched comparison here is dominated by this), and on 3'UTR-length decile.
would_refute: Any one of: the per-isoform shift curves show no inflection at any snapshot in either arm (monotone or flat in d); DEMOTED isoforms never flip and their residual fails to shrink across training in arm B; or the d-hat_i distribution has no mode and its across-member spread exceeds the 42-vs-50 gap. Each says the >50 nt relation is not computed from sequence and the model's PTC calls are count-based, which is a publishable negative and directly answers the open question in the scoping note. Spuriousness controls: an apparent effect could be 'more mass in channel 4 raises the score' (excluded by the -d insertion, which adds identical mass), or a 3'UTR-length proxy (excluded by the matched population). Note the mid-pool quantizes position to 4 nt, so 42 vs 50 is two pool bins -- resolvable, but only just, and that limit is stated rather than discovered later.

title: Termination efficiency at the PTC: TGA blunts decay and TAA sharpens it, and the effect exists only where the stop is premature
element: The stop tetranucleotide at the supplied stop -- codon identity TAA / TAG / TGA plus the immediately 3' (+4) base. Not where the stop is; whether termination there is efficient.
test: Primary operator is TAG <-> TGA at the supplied stop. This is a mononucleotide-composition-preserving rearrangement, and it is explicitly NOT the dead dinucleotide-preserving 3-mer shuffle: TAG's dinucleotides are TA,AG and TGA's are TG,GA, so the map is not the identity. Because the base multiset {T,A,G} is unchanged, the 50 nt rolling-GC channel 5 is invariant at every offset except the at-most-two offsets whose 50 nt support contains exactly one of the two swapped positions -- an exact, checkable invariance rather than the approximate GC-matching that every single-base operator has to settle for. Channels 4 and 6-8 are invariant by construction, and the parse is untouched: both sides are valid stops at the same coordinate. Both alternatives are measured from a COMMON baseline by restricting to isoforms whose observed stop is TAA, so TAG and TGA are each counterfactual and neither is the observed base -- this removes the training-frequency asymmetry (TGA is the most common mammalian stop). Secondary operator at +4 is A_vs_T, the only operator in the Analysis 5 table with a near-null control reference (control |mean| 0.00111, |t| median 1.00, 73% same-signed, 8% all-five agreement against a 6.25% chance rate). The training-dynamics core: evaluate the contrast at every snapshot of H1's checkpoint stream, separately in PTC+ slot-0 isoforms and in the matched PTC- population, and record (a) the snapshot at which the PTC+ minus PTC- difference-in-contrast first exceeds its control reference, (b) the across-member spread of that difference at each snapshot, (c) whether members that acquire it are the members with higher late-snapshot AUPRC restricted to PTC+ isoforms.
matched_reference: (i) Noise floor: the stop codon substituted for itself through the identical recomputation path, per run. (ii) Other positions: a frame-matched control bank in the stop window under the same operator class, so the off-manifold contamination of a window-local substitution is present in the reference too. (iii) Matched population: PTC+ versus PTC- slots matched on n_downstream_ejc, annotation-flag pair, 3'UTR-length decile, observed +4 base, and slot-attention tercile -- attention matching is mandatory because the Kozak effect is already known to reverse across terciles (+0.0058 middle, -0.0024 top).
would_refute: The TAG<->TGA contrast sits inside its control-position distribution at every snapshot; or it is statistically equal in PTC+ and matched PTC- slots, which would make it an unconditional stop-codon preference (a composition or annotation proxy) rather than a termination-efficiency effect; or it appears BEFORE the EJC relation is established, which is incompatible with it being a modifier of a conditional and would relocate it as a confound. A confident null must be checked at matched n against the control distribution before it is believed -- a confident negative in this area has twice been a confounder.

title: uORF initiation efficiency, measured in the part of the start context that the slot-selection rule provably cannot have leaked
element: The -6..-1 and +5/+6 context of an upstream, PTC-bearing ORF's own AUG in slots 1-4 -- specifically the components orthogonal to kozak_score. kozak_score is only a 3-level integer, (-3 purine) + (+4 G), so A versus G at -3 (purine-matched, identical score) and A_vs_T / G_vs_C at -1, -2, -4, -5, -6 are selection-invariant by construction.
test: Three training arms, five seeds, sub-epoch checkpoints: (A) standard; (B) is_ref_cds and is_sqanti_cds columns DELETED from the tabular block (n_orf_features 5 -> 3); (C) n_downstream_ejc deleted (shared with H1). Inference-time flag ablation provably cannot answer the override question -- it shrinks control positions 0.66x alongside targets 0.42x, so it measures attention dilution, and it is dead per section 6. Retraining can. At every snapshot in each arm, measure the contrast at the selection-orthogonal positions and at Kozak -3/+4, in the uORF slot's ATG window, over slots 1-4 flagged as upstream PTC-bearing ORFs in isoforms whose reference-AUG stop is clean. Created-motif exclusions applied identically at target and control positions and evaluated per isoform before any contrast is formed; a contrast is formed only when BOTH sides survive, because the exclusion rate is strongly base-asymmetric (at -3: A 0.044, C 0.000, G 0.034, T 0.288) and one-sided guarding would silently convert the purine operator into mean(A,G) - C, whose low side is 100% GC.
matched_reference: (i) Method floor per run. (ii) Control positions spread over +/-60 of the uORF AUG at the SAME frame offset -- frame matching is mandatory because the created-motif exclusion rate is 23.6% at one codon offset and 8.7% at another; the same trajectory computed at control positions is the null for any global scale drift over training. (iii) Matched population: uORF slots stratified on kozak_score, which holds the selection rule exactly fixed since the rule sees only those two bits; on slot-attention tercile; and on whether the uORF terminates in the 5'UTR (n = 5,287) or reads into the CDS as an oORF (n = 626).
would_refute: The contrast at selection-orthogonal positions never exceeds its control reference in any arm at any snapshot; or it exceeds it identically in the standard and flags-removed arms, which leaves no override and therefore no crowding-out story; or the trajectory rises and falls while control positions show the same shape, making it a global scale artifact. A null must be demonstrated at matched n against a control distribution before it is reported -- one earlier null in this area came from ~40 isoforms and was purely underpowered.

title: The reinitiation relation: an AUG a short distance 3' of an upstream ORF's stop, and its frame -- a relation the tabular branch is architecturally incapable of expressing
element: The distance from an upstream ORF's stop codon to the next downstream AUG, together with that AUG's reading frame relative to the upstream ORF. In one phrase: is there a re-start close behind this stop, and is it in a different frame.
test: All work is in the uORF slot's stop window, whose downstream half is unclipped to the transcript end (500 nt visible at W=1000, 1000 nt at W=2000; 5'UTR intercistronic distances are typically well inside that). (a) Destroy the nearest downstream AUG by a mononucleotide-preserving permutation, ATG -> AGT or GTA, never TAG/TGA which are stops, so channel 5 is invariant by the same construction as H2. (b) Insert an AUG at controlled distance d in {10,20,...,400} via a composition-preserving 3-mer swap, in each of the three frames relative to the uORF, and record the per-isoform delta log-odds surface over (d, frame). (c) Do both at every snapshot of H1's checkpoint stream, so the emergence step of any distance or frame structure is observed rather than only its endpoint. (d) Categorical arm: the same measurements contrasted between 5'UTR-terminating uORFs and oORFs.
matched_reference: (i) Permutation control: the same 3-mer replaced by a different composition-matched non-AUG permutation at the same coordinate, which isolates AUG identity from A/G content. (ii) Frame control: the identical insertion in the two non-triggering frames, which is the internal reference for 'any AUG anywhere raises the score'. (iii) Matched population: uORF (n = 5,287, NMD+ 12.6%) versus oORF (n = 626, NMD+ 12.8%) -- base rates equal to 0.2 pp, an unusually clean match that removes base rate as an explanation for any difference the model shows. (iv) Position control: the same insertions in slot 0's stop window, where no reinitiation question arises.
would_refute: Delta log-odds flat in d and identical across the three frames at every snapshot -- the model reads no reinitiation relation, and since the tabular branch provably cannot express it either, the relation is simply absent from the decision. Equally refuting: an effect identical for AUG and for its composition-matched permutations, which makes it an A/G-content effect. Honest prior: the equality of NMD+ rate between the uORF and oORF classes already argues that the CATEGORICAL version of this hypothesis is null in this population, so the continuous distance-and-frame version is where the room to be positive is, and the categorical arm is best read as a pre-registered expected null that validates the readout.

title: Where the 50 nt threshold actually sits in these data, read off training difficulty rather than off a perturbation
element: The distance from the stop codon to the nearest downstream exon-exon junction, and the threshold value of that distance at which the trigger switches on. The 50 nt figure is a consensus from reporter assays, not a measurement in this system.
test: From the instrumented rerun (H1's standard arm, five seeds, ~170 sub-epoch snapshots), restricted to probe-set isoforms whose slot 0 has n_downstream_ejc >= 1, compute per isoform: (a) epoch-of-mastery -- the first snapshot after which the predicted probability stays on the correct side of the pos_weight-adjusted threshold for every remaining snapshot (the persistence requirement is what keeps this from being noise); (b) trajectory instability -- the number of sign crossings across snapshots; (c) across-member discordance at the final snapshot. Bin by the stop-to-nearest-downstream-junction distance, read from channel 4 of the stop window with the beyond-window rescue that build_mechanism_classes.py already implements (a junction beyond the window is necessarily beyond 50 nt, so the binning stays window-width independent). Locate the mode of residualized difficulty; repeat per member for five independent estimates of d-hat*. Architecture discriminator: repeat on an arm with conv2 widened to k=13 (receptive field 66 nt) and on an arm with the mid-pool removed (position quantized finer than 4 nt). If d-hat* moves with the receptive field it is architecture; if it stays put it is the data, and the number is a biological claim about this system.
matched_reference: (i) The same curve on isoforms where the count rule and the >50 nt rule agree -- these must show no interior mode. (ii) A randomly-initialized snapshot as the floor for across-member discordance. (iii) Matched population: bins matched on the exact n_downstream_ejc value, on the annotation-flag pair, and on 3'UTR-length decile, so distance is the only thing varying. Non-circularity argument, which is the reason this readout is admissible at all: the labels are mashr differential-expression calls across four cell types and are not defined by any distance rule, so a difficulty peak located at d* is a statement about biology and about the model, not a restatement of how the label was constructed. Contrast this with the shape expected if the model uses only the count: difficulty would be high and FLAT across all small d for count-positive, truly-negative isoforms, with no interior mode.
would_refute: Residualized difficulty is flat or monotone in distance with no interior mode -- the model has no learned distance threshold and works from the count alone. Or d-hat* varies across the five members by more than the 42-vs-50 gap, in which case the instrument cannot resolve the question at this n and the honest report is 'unresolvable', not a number. Note the mid-pool quantizes position to 4 nt, so 42 and 50 are two pool bins apart; that is the resolution ceiling and it is stated up front.

title: The >50 nt stop-to-junction relation is computable from channel 4, and the model's learned threshold can be located by count-conserving junction relocation
element: An exon-exon junction lying more than ~50 nt 3' of the termination codon — the EJC-deposition relation itself. Not the junction positions (supplied), not the stop (supplied), but the DISTANCE between them, which no input carries.
test: Three parts, all local, no retraining. (a) NATIVE CONTRAST, no perturbation: at slot 0, compare log-odds for the demoted set (n_downstream_ejc>=1, no junction >50 nt) against isoforms with the SAME n_downstream_ejc value and same mechanism class that do have a junction beyond 50 nt. Matching on the count is what makes this a test of the relation and not of the count. build_mechanism_classes.py already computes beyond50 and beyond_window from the HDF5 channel 4 — reuse it, do not rewrite it. (b) CAUSAL PROBE — junction relocation: in the stop window only, move one channel-4 mark from distance d to d'. Channels 0-3 and 5-8 are bitwise unchanged, the transcript sequence is unchanged, and every tabular feature including n_downstream_ejc is unchanged, so the COUNT is exactly conserved and only the RELATION moves. Restrict to slots with exactly one downstream junction inside the window so 'move' is unambiguous. Sweep d' in 4 nt steps (the mid-pool quantum) from 4 to 200 nt. (c) CROSS-CONFIGURATION REPLICATION: run the identical curve on all five members of both configurations. The canonical-rule account predicts the step location is width-invariant; the dilution account predicts the amplitude shrinks at 2000 while the location holds; a location that moves with the window edge is neither and kills the reading.
matched_reference: Three, plus one new. (1) Method noise floor: relocations that do not cross the candidate threshold (e.g. 100 -> 200 nt) must give ~0. (2) Other positions: the same relocation performed in the ATG window, which is clipped at the ORF midpoint and therefore cannot carry the stop relation — same operator, same magnitude of input change, no possible signal. This is the control that the dead 'inference-time flag ablation' lacked, and it is why this probe is not that probe: the flag ablation shrank controls 0.66x alongside targets 0.42x because it re-weighted attention globally; a count-conserving single-mark move inside one window cannot, and slot-0 attention weight is asserted unchanged within tolerance as a precondition. (3) Matched population: same n_downstream_ejc, same mechanism class, same 3'UTR length decile. (4) NEW — aperture: the step location must be invariant across stop widths.
would_refute: A flat Delta-vs-d' curve; or a curve indistinguishable from the ATG-window control; or a step location that differs between atg1000_stop1000 and atg2000_stop2000 by more than the 4 nt pooling quantum; or a native contrast (part a) that vanishes once n_downstream_ejc is matched — which would say the model reads the count and never the distance, and that the 43% is entirely tabular.

title: Aperture titration: read the existing stop-width ladder {50,250,500,1000} nt as a titration of the 50 nt rule, and cross training aperture against inference aperture
element: The downstream radius over which the stop-to-junction relation is actually computed. Same relation as H1; here the measured quantity is its spatial extent, and the instrument is the window edge.
test: Stage 1, hours, needs nothing new: TRAIN-APERTURE x INFERENCE-APERTURE crossing. Take the 10 existing checkpoints (2 trained widths x 5 seeds) and evaluate each at all four stored widths — 8 cells, forward passes only. The diagonal must reproduce the published AUC/AUPRC (that is the correctness check). The off-diagonal separates what the model LEARNED to use from what it CAN see. Primary readout is per-isoform log-odds change and test AUPRC, NOT Shapley share — because branch-Shapley share as a success criterion is dead when redundancy can be manufactured, and changing aperture can manufacture redundancy with the tabular count exactly as modality dropout did. Stage 2, if stage 1 shows structure: recover the other 50 sweep checkpoints from Explorer (atg{100,500,1000} x stop{100,500,1000,2000} x 5 seeds were all submitted; only 10 are local) and run the exact 8-coalition branch decomposition on the stop{100,500} cells to test the inverted-U. Stage 3, only if the step is bracketed too coarsely: intermediate apertures can be synthesized WITHOUT rebuilding the HDF5 by slicing the w2000 stop arrays and recomputing channel 5 with compute_rolling_gc on the sliced support (data_prep.py:87-107, 203-205) — because channel 5 is defined as window-local, the slice reproduces the real array exactly.
matched_reference: The APERTURE-NULL STRATUM defined in H3 — isoforms whose windows gain only zero padding when the width increases. For them the inference-width change adds literally no information, so their Delta is the pure geometry term (padding fraction, BN running statistics estimated at the training width, more positions competing in the global max). Subtract it from every other stratum; the residual is content. Second reference: the diagonal cells, which must reproduce the published numbers or the harness is wrong. Third: the atg branch under the same crossing, which should respond differently if the effect is 3'-specific.
would_refute: A monotone decline in stop-branch share from stop100 through stop2000 with no peak, TOGETHER WITH no AUPRC loss when a wide-trained model is evaluated narrow. That combination says the aperture effect is geometry, the sequence branch never computed the relation, and — importantly — no cross-configuration difference anywhere in this project may be read as content, which retroactively bounds Track A handoff sections 2, 3 and 5. Equally refuting in the other direction: a large AUPRC loss at narrow inference that is identical in the aperture-null stratum, which would mean the loss is distribution shift in BatchNorm and not information.

title: Distal 3'UTR content is not an NMD determinant here: an on-manifold truncation ladder bounds the informative radius 3' of the stop
element: 3'UTR length and distal 3'UTR sequence composition as an EJC-independent NMD trigger (long-3'UTR NMD). The measured quantity is the informative radius: how far 3' of the stop codon NMD-relevant sequence extends.
test: (a) TRUNCATION LADDER. Zero the stop window beyond distance p downstream, recompute channel 5 exactly as data_prep does, sweep p in {50,100,200,300,500,750,1000}. Per-isoform Delta log-odds versus p is the informative radius, read directly. Restrict the headline population to n_downstream_ejc = 0 slots, where the EJC mechanism cannot operate and long-3'UTR NMD is the only candidate. (b) CROSS-CONFIGURATION REPLICATION over the overlap: run the same ladder on both configurations' members. Over 0-500 nt both apertures cover identical sequence, so the two curves must agree within member spread — if they do not, neither curve is measuring the transcript and the whole readout is void. (c) APERTURE-NULL STRATUM. Define the stratum as 5'UTR <= 500 AND (tx_length - orf_end) <= 500 AND orf_length <= 1000, from selected_orfs.tsv columns orf_start/orf_end/orf_length/tx_length. For these isoforms the wide windows contain the identical non-zero content as the narrow ones. Compute the paired per-isoform branch-share difference between configurations within this stratum and within each revealed-content stratum, matched on label, slot-0 n_downstream_ejc, and mechanism class (mechanism_classes.tsv already carries the class per isoform).
matched_reference: (1) The aperture-null stratum itself, which is the point: real isoforms, matched on everything except revealed content, differing only in how many zeros the encoder is handed. (2) A LENGTH-MATCHED SHAM: truncate the same number of positions from the UPSTREAM (CDS-side) end of the stop window, which is already midpoint-clipped and largely padding for short ORFs. Any Delta common to both is length competing in the global max, not 3' content. (3) Composition matching across strata on label, slot-0 n_downstream_ejc and mechanism class, because 3'UTR > 500 isoforms are not a random sample.
would_refute: A truncation ladder that stays flat beyond p = 50 in the last-exon-stop population while the aperture-null stratum reproduces the full 9.93 pp structural shift. That is a publishable negative with two parts: distal 3'UTR sequence carries no usable NMD signal in this dataset, and the configuration dependence recorded in Track A sections 2 and 3 is an artifact of window geometry rather than biology. The opposite outcome — a ladder that keeps declining out to 750-1000 nt, concentrated in long-3'UTR isoforms and absent in the aperture-null stratum — supports EJC-independent long-3'UTR NMD as a second, sequence-readable mechanism.

title: Termination context: stop-codon identity and the +4 base set how efficiently a supplied stop terminates — and aperture invariance is the reference that certifies a local element
element: The termination tetranucleotide — the stop codon (UAA/UAG/UGA) plus the base immediately 3' of it, at stop-window indices W/2-1, W/2, W/2+1 and W/2+2. Secondarily the -1 codon.
test: (a) +4 SUBSTITUTION with a GC-matched operator: C<->G at index W/2+2, and separately A<->T. GC-matched operators are the only ones with a reference approaching null here — under a G-vs-not-G operator control positions are 100% same-signed with |t| median 5.79, which is confident structure at every position. Exclude any substitution that creates an in-frame stop in the next codon or creates/destroys a canonical polyadenylation hexamer within reach. (b) STOP IDENTITY BY MATCHED POPULATION, not substitution, because UAA<->UGA cannot be GC-matched: compare native-UGA against native-UAA slots matched on n_downstream_ejc, distance to the nearest downstream junction, 3'UTR length, local GC over +/-50 nt, and mechanism class. selected_orfs.tsv carries stop_codon per slot. (c) APERTURE INVARIANCE as the validity filter — this is the lens applied: repeat (a) at stop500, stop1000 and stop2000 under the H2 inference-width crossing. A genuine local element must give the same per-isoform Delta within member spread at every width. An element claimed to be local whose measured behavior changes when a window edge 500 nt away moves is an artifact of pooling or normalization, and no amount of sign consistency rescues it.
matched_reference: Four. (1) Method noise floor at production batch size, ~7e-7. (2) Other positions: the identical GC-matched operator at FRAME-MATCHED control positions +7, +10, +13 ... +40 in the same window — frame-matched because the created-motif exclusion rate is 23.6% at one codon offset and 8.7% at another. (3) Matched population: native-UAA controls matched on junction geometry, 3'UTR length and local GC. (4) NEW, and the contribution of this lens: APERTURE-APPROPRIATE RESPONSE. The project currently has three references (noise floor, other positions, matched population) and all three have silently failed at least once. Window width adds a fourth that is two-sided and nearly free — local elements must be invariant to it, distal relations (H1, H2, H3) must respond to it, and an element whose aperture behavior contradicts its claimed span is excluded regardless of how well it passes the other three.
would_refute: No per-isoform sign consistency at +4 above the frame-matched controls at matched n; or a consistent sign that flips or vanishes between stop widths, which excludes the element rather than confirming it; or UGA indistinguishable from UAA once junction geometry, 3'UTR length and local GC are matched. Note the standing warning: a confident negative in this area has twice been a confounder rather than the model, so a null must be shown to be adequately powered at matched n before it is stated.

title: Within the uORF-PTC class, initiation efficiency rather than uORF architecture decides whether the parse triggers decay
element: The Kozak context of an upstream ORF's own start codon (-3 purine, and the -6..-1 hexamer), as a determinant of whether that uORF captures the scanning ribosome and is therefore actually translated.
test: (a) DATA CHECK FIRST, and it gates everything else. Within the 5,913, is the uORF slot's own kozak_m3/kozak_p4/kozak_score (selected_orfs.tsv columns 11-13) associated with the isoform label, at matched uORF n_downstream_ejc, matched uORF length, matched distance from the uORF stop to the main AUG, and matched mechanism class? If the association is absent in the data, the model cannot be asked to have learned it and the model probe is not run. (b) MODEL PROBE at slots 1-4, which is where the hypothesis lives and where nobody has looked. The existing Kozak measurements are all at slot 0 — which is the annotation-selected CDS and has the WEAKEST Kozak context of all five slots (1.230 against 1.665-1.879), because the ranking rule fills slot 0 by annotation and slots 1-4 by descending Kozak. Substitute the uORF slot's own -3 with the GC-matched purine/pyrimidine operator (A vs T). Prediction: strengthening a uORF's initiation context RAISES predicted NMD susceptibility, and does so more for slots whose own stop is EJC-triggering than for slots whose stop is not — the slot-0 version of this contrast is already measured at +0.0087 versus -0.0001. (c) APERTURE DISCRIMINATOR, the lens applied to the one branch whose share went UP with width. Initiation context is local to the uAUG and must be aperture-invariant. uORF architecture — where the uORF stop sits relative to the main AUG — needs hundreds of nt of context and must be aperture-dependent, appearing only where widening reveals real sequence. Stratify by 5'UTR length: isoforms with 5'UTR <= 500 nt gain only zero padding in the ATG window when the width goes 1000 -> 2000, so nothing architectural is revealed for them. If the start branch's rise (9.81% -> 11.63%) is concentrated in the 5'UTR > 500 group it is 5' content; if it is equal in both groups it is geometry and the start branch learned nothing from the extra aperture.
matched_reference: (1) Frame-matched control positions in the same uORF ATG window under the identical A-vs-T operator. (2) Stratification by selection_reason (selected_orfs.tsv column 19), because slots 1-4 are Kozak-SELECTED — their -3 is purine 93.1% of the time — so the substitution population is unbalanced and rank 0 mixes three populations with purine-at--3 rates of 79.6% / 61.9% / 93.1%. Report within stratum. (3) The 5'UTR<=500 stratum as the internal null for the aperture contrast: real isoforms for whom the wider ATG window is literally zeros.
would_refute: No per-isoform Kozak sensitivity at slots 1-4 beyond frame-matched controls at matched n; or a sensitivity equal for triggering and non-triggering uORF slots; or, at step (a), no association between uORF Kozak and label once uORF geometry is matched. Any of these kills the initiation-efficiency account and leaves the identical oORF/uORF rates unexplained, which is itself worth reporting because it is a measured fact that contradicts the standard mechanistic ordering.

title: The EJC rescue zone: stop-to-junction DISTANCE is a step function the model may or may not compute from channel 4
element: The relation "distance from the terminating stop codon to the nearest downstream exon-exon junction mark in channel 4 of the stop window" — the >50 nt rule as a positional relation, as distinct from the junction COUNT that is handed over in n_downstream_ejc.
test: Junction-repositioning in silico mutagenesis, touching channel 4 ONLY. Restrict to isoforms where n_downstream_ejc == 1 and exactly one downstream junction mark is visible in the stop window (this population is directly selectable with the chunked channel-4 extraction already written and verified in analysis_plans/build_mechanism_classes.py lines 111-123). Move that single mark to each distance d in 1..250 nt from the last base of the stop, holding the entire tabular block — including n_downstream_ejc — bit-identical, so the model is told throughout that one junction exists downstream and only the position changes. Score all 5 members (seeds 100-500) at both atg1000_stop1000 and atg2000_stop2000. Fit a per-isoform monotone logistic to delta-log-odds vs d and record the inflection d*. ARCHITECTURE-VS-DATA DISCRIMINATOR, which is the part that decides the sub-hypothesis: repeat on two retrains that move conv2's receptive field (k2 7->15 gives RF 74; mid_pool 4->2 gives RF ~24). If d* tracks RF it is architecture; if d* stays near 50 across all three it is data. EXTERNAL CORROBORATION, which is what lifts this from "the model uses it" to "the cell uses it": overlay the model's dose-response on the per-PTC NMD-escape probability vs distance-to-last-junction curve published from allele-specific expression across thousands of human tumor PTCs (Lindeboom et al., Nat Genet 2016; NMDetective, Nat Genet 2019) — an independent, human, non-reporter measurement of the same curve, and a resource that substitutes entirely for new bench work. Nagy & Maquat 1998 supplies the original 50-55 nt reporter boundary. Additionally join the specific junctions being moved to measured EJC occupancy from eIF4A3 iCLIP/RIPiT-seq (Sauliere et al. 2012; Singh et al. 2012; Hauer et al. 2016), since a junction with no EJC should not participate.
matched_reference: Three internal, plus one external. (i) NOISE FLOOR / METHOD REFERENCE: the identical single-mark move performed UPSTREAM of the stop inside the ORF body at matched |d|, where the EJC rule predicts a flat response and the perturbation is exactly as off-manifold — this is the method's own null under the identical operator. (ii) OTHER POSITIONS: the same move in the ATG window at matched distances from the AUG. (iii) MATCHED POPULATION: isoforms in the PTC- no trigger class (n=15,765, 2.2% NMD+), where the same manipulation should give a markedly shallower step. Composition is untouched by construction — channels 0-3 and 5 are bit-identical across the whole sweep — so trap 2 (composition dominates identity) cannot operate at all. This is the only genuinely composition-free operator available in this model, and that is the main reason to run it first. External matching: the Lindeboom curve is matched on the same axis (distance to the last junction) and on the same event class (PTC-bearing human transcripts), and differs in readout (allele-specific expression) and population (tumors), which is what makes agreement informative.
would_refute: A flat or non-monotone target-arm dose-response indistinguishable in shape from the upstream-arm reference; or d* distributed with no mode; or d* moving 1:1 with the receptive field across the three architectures. Any of those states that the model reads the supplied count and never computes the relation — which is a publishable negative and directly answers the open question Pete names as unmeasured. Failure of the external overlay (Spearman ~0 between the model's dose-response and Lindeboom's escape-probability curve) refutes the biological reading even if the model's own step is clean.

title: uORF Kozak strength as initiation efficiency, with a pre-registered sign flip between mechanism classes
element: The Kozak context (-3 purine, +4 G) of an UPSTREAM ORF's AUG — not the main ORF's — in the population where the reference-AUG main ORF has a clean stop and an upstream ORF is itself a PTC (the PTC- uORF-PTC class, n=5,913 in slots, 12.6% NMD+).
test: Reuse the existing position-bank harness (analysis_plans/measure_position_bank.py) with --slot pointed at the most-upstream qualifying PTC-bearing ORF slot rather than slot 0. That slot index is recomputable from the stored mechanism classes (results_interp_all/mechanism_classes.npz already carries cls, uorf_kind, has_ref and the ref slot). Operators: A_vs_T at -3 (the GC-matched form of the purine contrast, and the only operator whose control reference behaved like a null: control |t| median 1.00, 8% all-member sign agreement against a 6.25% chance rate) and G_vs_C at +4 (the GC-matched form of the G contrast, and the operator under which the one clean +4 cell appeared). Same created-motif exclusions, same channel-5 recomputation, same 37 frame-matched control positions, now computed inside the uORF slot's own start window. Stratify by uORF vs oORF, by slot attention tercile, and by whether the full ORFik scan agrees the upstream PTC ORF exists. EXTERNAL CORROBORATION, the step that answers trap 8 directly: partition the model's uORF slots into ribosome-profiling-supported vs not, using the GENCODE/Ribo-seq ORF phase 1 consensus set (Mudge et al., Nat Biotech 2022; ~7,264 curated translated ORFs including uORFs and oORFs, multi-dataset supported), with Chothani et al. Mol Cell 2022 and RibORF (Ji et al., eLife 2015) as replication catalogs, and initiation-site profiling (QTI-seq, Gao et al. Nat Methods 2015; GTI-seq, Lee et al. PNAS 2012) as the sharper "is this AUG initiated" readout. Prediction: the model's per-isoform Kozak sensitivity is higher for Ribo-seq-supported uORFs. Second external axis with no bench cost: correlate per-isoform Kozak sensitivity against measured mean-ribosome-load for the surrounding 50-mer from the Optimus 5-Prime MPRA (Sample et al., Nat Biotech 2019; 280k random 5'UTRs, polysome readout), which supplies an independent quantitative initiation-strength scale. MINIMAL BENCH if external data is equivocal: adenine base editing of the +4 of a native uORF from A to G (ABE makes exactly this edit, and it strengthens the Kozak) at one endogenous locus, readout = allele-resolved host-transcript abundance +/- SMG1 inhibitor, plus a uORF-luciferase to confirm the initiation change. One locus, two guides, two conditions. A -3 purine-to-pyrimidine edit is NOT accessible to base editors and would require prime editing — stated so the experiment is not proposed as easier than it is.
matched_reference: (i) The 37 frame-matched control positions within the same window under the identical operator and identical exclusions — frame matching is load-bearing, since the created-motif exclusion rate is 23.6% at the targets' codon offset and 8.7% at another. (ii) MATCHED SLOTS: non-uORF slots in the same isoform at matched attention weight, so the contrast is not confounded by how much of the prediction a slot's perturbation can reach (measured slot-0 attention terciles are 0.343 / 0.709 / 0.910, and the sign of the existing Kozak result reverses across them). (iii) MATCHED POPULATION: isoforms in PTC- no trigger that carry a Kozak-selected upstream ORF in a slot whose stop is NOT a PTC — same slot type, same selection route, no NMD-relevant stop, so the effect must vanish there. (iv) EXTERNAL MATCHING: Ribo-seq-negative uORFs matched to Ribo-seq-positive ones on uORF length, 5' position, Kozak tier and host-transcript expression, since Ribo-seq detection is expression-dependent and an unmatched split would recover expression, not translation.
would_refute: Per-isoform percentiles centered at 0.5 in the uORF class; or no excess of the uORF-slot sensitivity over the slot-0 sensitivity; or no sign flip between PTC- uORF-PTC and PTC+ under the identical operator; or the effect present equally in the matched no-trigger population. On the oORF arm specifically, this is set up to fail honestly: the marginal NMD+ rates are 12.6% (uORF, n=5,287) and 12.8% (oORF, n=626), i.e. indistinguishable, so a large oORF/uORF difference in Kozak sensitivity would be conditional structure the marginal does not show and must clear a high bar before being believed at n=626. Externally, no difference in sensitivity between Ribo-seq-supported and unsupported uORFs refutes the "the cell uses it" reading even if the model's internal contrast is clean.

title: The stop tetranucleotide: termination efficiency at a fixed parse
element: The 4-nt termination signal read in the stop window — the stop codon's variable bases (TAA / TAG / TGA at window indices W/2-1, W/2, W/2+1) together with the +4 base immediately 3' of it (index W/2+2), i.e. the stop tetranucleotide whose readthrough efficiency is measured biochemistry.
test: Two operators, neither of which alters the parse. (a) +4 CONTEXT: substitute at the single base immediately 3' of the stop, operators A_vs_T and G_vs_C, using the existing bank machinery re-pointed at the stop window. The three stop bases are never touched, so the ORF, the stop and every structural feature are preserved by construction. (b) STOP IDENTITY: single-base swaps that keep the codon a stop — TAA<->TAG (position 3, A<->G) and TAA<->TGA (position 2, A<->G). These are unavoidably GC-changing, so the operator is A_vs_G and the matched reference is A_vs_G applied at the 37 frame-matched control positions, which carries the identical composition delta; the target is reported as a percentile within that control distribution rather than as an absolute effect. (c) MECHANISM STRATIFICATION, which is the built-in control no artifact can imitate: stratify by whether the perturbed slot's stop has a junction >50 nt downstream (the ptc array is already computed and stored in mechanism_classes.npz). A readthrough or termination-kinetics effect must exist in the PTC+ stratum and be absent in the PTC- stratum. Assemble the full 12-cell table (3 stops x 4 +4 bases) of mean per-isoform percentiles. EXTERNAL CORROBORATION: Spearman-correlate that 12-cell table against the measured dual-luciferase readthrough efficiencies for all stop tetranucleotide contexts (Loughran et al., NAR 2014; Cridge et al., NAR 2018) — this is a directly matched 12-cell external table and requires no new bench work at all. Second, genome-wide and endogenous: ribosome profiling of readthrough with G418 (Wangen & Green, eLife 2020) gives per-transcript 3'UTR ribosome density, so the model's per-isoform effect can be joined to a measured readthrough rate for the same genes; standard Ribo-seq 3'UTR/CDS ratio is a weaker but universally available proxy. MINIMAL BENCH: a PTC reporter with a fixed TGA and +4 varied A/C/G/T, read out as (i) dual-luciferase readthrough and (ii) mRNA level +/- SMG1 inhibitor — 4 constructs, 2 conditions. Loughran's series already covers (i) entirely; only (ii) is new.
matched_reference: (i) 37 frame-matched control positions in the same stop window under the identical operator, identical created-motif exclusions, identical channel-5 recomputation — the exclusion set gains one rule (any substitution creating a new in-frame stop is dropped), and the three stop bases are never substituted, so the parse is invariant by construction rather than by filtering. (ii) The PTC- stop stratum as a mechanism-matched null: same operator, same positions, same population selection route, no downstream EJC to displace. (iii) Conditioning on the observed base and on local GC, since the +4 base composition is not uniform across isoforms. (iv) EXTERNAL MATCHING: Loughran's table is matched cell-for-cell on the same 12 tetranucleotides, measured in a reporter with an otherwise fixed context, so the only thing varying between the two tables is the readout (readthrough vs modeled NMD susceptibility).
would_refute: +4 percentile distribution centered at 0.5 under both GC-matched operators; or an effect of equal size in the PTC+ and PTC- strata, which would say the model is reading a generic post-stop base preference rather than termination biology; or Spearman ~0 between the model's 12-cell table and the published readthrough table. A clean effect with an unresolvable sign (some strata readthrough-like, others kinetics-like) is reported as such and is not forced into one model.

title: Not all junctions are equal: the EJC deposition footprint as a modulator of a supplied junction
element: The ~20-24 nt exonic sequence immediately 5' of a downstream exon-exon junction — the EJC deposition footprint — and its motif content, as distinct from the junction position itself.
test: MONONUCLEOTIDE-PRESERVING SHUFFLE of the 24 nt immediately 5' of the single downstream junction inside the stop window, 200 shuffles per isoform. This preserves base composition EXACTLY, so channel 5 changes only in local ordering and trap 2 is neutralized by construction rather than by control; channels 4 and 6-8 are untouched so the junction position, the parse and the frame are invariant. This is explicitly NOT the dead perturbation from section 6 — that result is specific to dinucleotide-preserving shuffles of 3-mers, where 100% of 64 trimers have exactly one valid arrangement; a 24-mer under mononucleotide preservation has a combinatorially large shuffle space. Statistic per isoform: the observed sequence's log-odds against its own 200-shuffle null, as a z. Then the external split, which is the whole point: partition the junctions by measured EJC occupancy from published eIF4A3 iCLIP and RIPiT-seq (Sauliere et al., NSMB 2012; Singh et al., Cell 2012; Hauer et al., Cell Rep 2016) and ask whether the model's footprint sensitivity is larger at occupied junctions. MINIMAL BENCH if the external split is ambiguous: an intron-containing PTC reporter in which the 24 nt upstream of the intron is swapped between a high-occupancy and a low-occupancy native footprint, read out as mRNA level +/- SMG1 inhibitor plus eIF4A3 RIP-qPCR to confirm the occupancy difference — 4 constructs. Note honestly that ribosome profiling is the wrong instrument here; this hypothesis's validation is CLIP-based, and that is a weakness relative to the other four.
matched_reference: (i) SHUFFLES OF A NON-FOOTPRINT 24-MER in the same isoform at a matched distance from the stop (e.g. 100 nt further downstream, no junction within 50 nt) — identical operator, identical composition preservation, no EJC meaning. (ii) The same footprint shuffle in isoforms where that junction is UPSTREAM of the stop, where the EJC rule predicts no contribution. (iii) EXTERNAL MATCHING: iCLIP-occupied vs unoccupied junctions matched on upstream exon length, footprint GC, distance to the stop, junction ordinal within the transcript, and host-gene expression — CLIP detection is expression- and length-biased, and an unmatched split would recover those instead of occupancy.
would_refute: Footprint z centered at 0; or footprint shuffles statistically indistinguishable from non-footprint shuffles at matched distance; or no difference in sensitivity between iCLIP-occupied and unoccupied junctions after matching. Given 32 conv channels bound the number of distinct features the encoder can hold, and the junction position is already supplied as a clean binary channel, a null here is a plausible and informative outcome: it would say the model treats junctions as interchangeable marks, which is itself worth stating against the known non-uniformity of EJC deposition.

title: Reinitiation denied: an AUG too close downstream of a uORF stop
element: The intercistronic relation "distance from an upstream ORF's stop codon to the next downstream AUG" — specifically a downstream AUG within roughly 40 nt of the uORF stop, read inside that uORF slot's own stop window.
test: AUG-creation dose-response inside the uORF slot's stop window. For isoforms in the PTC- uORF-PTC class, substitute an ATG at distances d in {6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 40, 60, 90, 150, 240} nt downstream of the uORF stop, one distance at a time, restricted to positions whose native trimer is neither an AUG nor a stop. THE CREATED MOTIF IS IDENTICAL AT EVERY DISTANCE, so any distance-dependence is self-controlled and cannot be a created-motif artifact — which turns section 7's created-motif trap from a confound into a constant. Run a mirrored arm with a composition-matched non-AUG, non-stop trimer (AGT / GAT / GTA) at the identical positions, giving an exact GC match and therefore an identical channel-5 recomputation. Score 5 members, both widths. EXTERNAL CORROBORATION with no bench cost: the Optimus 5-Prime library (Sample et al., Nat Biotech 2019) is 280k random 50-nt 5'UTRs with measured mean ribosome load, and it contains uAUG/stop arrangements at every intercistronic distance, so the distance-to-reinitiation curve can be extracted from published measurements directly and overlaid on the model's; Kozak 1987 supplies the original reporter statement that reinitiation rises with intercistronic length. Whether the downstream AUGs in question are actually initiated is checkable against initiation-site profiling (QTI-seq, Gao et al. Nat Methods 2015) and the GENCODE Ribo-seq ORF phase 1 set. MINIMAL BENCH: a 5'UTR reporter with a fixed uORF and spacers of 10/25/40/70/120 nt to the main AUG, read out as luciferase (reinitiation) and mRNA level +/- SMG1 inhibitor — 5 constructs, 2 conditions.
matched_reference: (i) COMPOSITION-MATCHED TRIMER at identical positions — exact GC match, identical channel-5 recomputation, identical off-manifold status, so it isolates AUG identity from "any 3-base perturbation at this distance". (ii) The distance sweep itself, since the created motif is constant across distances. (iii) MATCHED POPULATION: the same AUG insertion in PTC- no trigger isoforms with no upstream ORF, where reinitiation is not at issue. (iv) EXTERNAL MATCHING: Optimus 5-Prime constructs matched on uORF length and Kozak tier, so intercistronic distance is the varying quantity in both the model sweep and the MPRA slice.
would_refute: No distance dependence for AUG insertion; or an identical distance profile for the composition-matched trimer, which would say the model responds to any perturbation at that offset; or an inflection that tracks the receptive field across the retrained architectures used in hypothesis 1, which would make it geometry rather than reinitiation. The external arm refutes independently: if the published MPRA shows no intercistronic-distance effect on ribosome load in matched constructs, the biological reading fails even with a clean model result.

title: Termination context: the nucleotide 3' of the supplied stop sets readthrough, and readthrough is NMD escape
element: The stop tetranucleotide — the supplied stop codon plus position +4, the first nucleotide of the 3'UTR, at stop-window array index W/2+2; secondarily +5 and +6 (W/2+3, W/2+4). All three sit inside the same conv1 kernel (k=15) as the stop codon itself, so one filter can read the tetranucleotide as a unit.
test: Point the existing position-bank harness at the stop branch: measure_position_bank.py currently perturbs s["atg_windows"][SLOT]; the stop-window analogue changes the window key and the target list and nothing else, because pos_to_index already puts codon position +4 at W/2+2 under the same codon convention. Targets +4, +5, +6; controls every frame-offset-matched position in +7..+61 and -5..-59 (offset matching is mandatory — created-motif exclusion rates measured 23.6% vs 8.7% across codon offsets).
