Substitute all four bases at every position, recompute channel 5 over the window's filled extent through the identical path, and derive contrasts afterwards so operators can never differ in anything but the operator. Primary operator A_vs_T — the only one measured here with a near-null control reference (control |mean| 0.00111, |t| median 1.00, all-5-member agreement 8% against a 6.25% chance rate); G_vs_C secondary and read only against its own control distribution, which is measured to be far from null (|t| median 4.30, 81% same-signed). n~1,500 per mechanism stratum. Carry over the Analysis-5 anchor-shift control: rerun the identical bank with the anchor displaced +37 nt, which preserves geometry, padding and operator while destroying the anchor's meaning.
matched_reference: Three, per the project's own rule that importance is a contrast. (1) Method floor: the no-op substitution — putting the observed base back through the identical GC-recomputation path — measured at 9.5e-7 to 1.4e-6 in the existing bank, three orders below any interpretable effect. (2) Other positions: 30+ frame-offset-matched control positions in the same window, same operator, same created-motif exclusions, same eligibility test. (3) Matched population: the identical operator at the identical array index in PTC- no-trigger isoforms, where readthrough at a normal stop has no NMD consequence. The operator, the index, the padding and the composition change are all held fixed across (3); only the mechanism differs, which is exactly what a composition artifact cannot imitate.
would_refute: The paired per-isoform D at +4 falls inside the interquartile range of the frame-matched control positions, AND the PTC+ versus PTC- no-trigger difference in signed D has a gene-clustered bootstrap CI containing zero, AND there is no ordering by observed stop identity. That is a clean negative: the model encodes where the stop is but not how efficiently it terminates, and termination context is not part of what it discovered.

title: Pyrimidine (CU) tracts in the proximal 3'UTR protect a PTC from decay
element: A >=20 nt pyrimidine-rich tract (>=15 of 20 C+T, containing a UCUU/CUCU core) located between stop+10 and stop+200 — i.e. inside the region the supplied parse defines as 3'UTR and inside the stop window's unpadded downstream half.
test: For each PTC+ isoform carrying a qualifying tract: 20 independent Altschul-Erikson dinucleotide-preserving shuffles of the 20-nt tract, plus 20 mononucleotide shuffles (which additionally destroy stacking), each scored against the unshuffled baseline through the same channel-5 recomputation path. Before any scoring, enumerate the number of distinct valid arrangements per tract and drop any tract with fewer than 8 — the 3-mer version of this operator died because it was the identity map, and that failure mode must be excluded by counting arrangements rather than assumed away; at 20 nt it is not degenerate, but that has to be shown per tract, not asserted. In parallel, apply the identical shuffle to a GC-matched, pyrimidine-matched, stop-distance-matched decoy block elsewhere in the same isoform's 3'UTR. Same run as hypothesis 3, which adds two further arms at the same blocks.
matched_reference: The within-isoform decoy block is the primary reference: same isoform, same window, same padding, same GC, same pyrimidine fraction, same distance from the stop — only the arrangement class differs. The shuffle-to-shuffle spread across the 20 draws is the method's own noise floor and is measured per tract rather than assumed. The PTC- no-trigger stratum is the matched population: identical element, identical operator, no mechanism for it to act through.
would_refute: The paired D (tract minus decoy) has a median inside the shuffle-to-shuffle noise, or is statistically indistinguishable between PTC+ and PTC- no-trigger isoforms. Either outcome says the model carries no arrangement-specific 3'UTR RBP signal and that whatever the 3'UTR contributes is compositional — which is hypothesis 3 winning.

title: Post-stop GC composition, not arrangement, drives susceptibility — and only downstream of the stop
element: The G+C fraction of 20-nt blocks in stop+10..stop+200, contrasted against those same blocks' base arrangement; and the same quantity at a GC-matched block upstream of the stop inside the stop window's CDS half.
test: Third and fourth arms of the hypothesis-2 run. Arm 3: transition recode (A<->G, C<->T) of the 20-nt block — this preserves the purine/pyrimidine string exactly and flips GC at every position, so it is the exact complement of the shuffle operator, which preserves composition and destroys arrangement. Arm 4: the identical recode applied to a GC-matched block upstream of the stop inside the stop window's CDS half, gated per isoform on the ORF being long enough that the midpoint clip does not bind. Additionally contrast the mono-shuffle against the di-shuffle arms of hypothesis 2 to separate a stacking/structure term from a mononucleotide-composition term without needing a folding package.
matched_reference: The upstream block in the same isoform, at matched absolute distance from the stop and matched observed GC, holding operator, isoform, window, padding and magnitude of composition change fixed and varying only which side of the supplied stop the block sits on. Reported alongside: the hypothesis-2 shuffle arms at the identical blocks, which give the identity-versus-composition reference; and the shuffle-to-shuffle spread as the floor.
would_refute: A_iso straddles zero — the GC effect is positionally uniform, i.e. a model-wide composition artifact with no relation to the supplied stop. Alternatively, if the composition-preserving shuffles move the logit as much as the recode does, the signal is arrangement and hypothesis 2 wins instead. Both are decidable from the same run.

title: EJC-footprint sequence at -24..-20 of the first triggering junction
element: The 12 nt centered at -22 relative to the first exon-exon junction more than 50 nt downstream of the supplied stop, in mature-mRNA coordinates — the canonical eIF4A3 footprint. Explicitly not the junction itself: no block in this design comes within 7 nt of it.
test: 20 dinucleotide-preserving shuffles of the footprint block, against the identical shuffle of blocks centered at -46, -34 and +12 relative to the same junction (all >=7 nt away from it), and against the same block offsets around a decoy position >=100 nt from any junction, matched on distance from the stop and on GC. The 7 nt exclusion zone means the exonic halves of the 5'ss and 3'ss consensus are never touched, so this cannot become a splice-site probe. Secondary arm: does the effect decay with the block's distance to the junction, and does it exist only when a junction mark lies within the 42 nt receptive field of the block?
matched_reference: Within-isoform decoy blocks matched on distance-from-stop and GC (these control for the fact that distance from the stop is itself expected to matter, per hypothesis 5); the -46/-34/+12 blocks around the same junction give a distance profile with the junction held fixed; the shuffle-to-shuffle spread is the method floor.
would_refute: Footprint D indistinguishable from the -46/-34/+12 blocks and from the stop-matched decoy, at a power sufficient to exclude effects at the measured per-isoform scale. That negative is worth having on its own: it bounds sequence-encoded EJC occupancy at below what an AUPRC-0.835 NMD model can resolve, and supports the standard position that deposition is position- rather than sequence-determined.

title: The discoverable content is concentrated in the termination zone, not spread over the 3'UTR
element: A positional relation: the distance from the supplied stop at which composition-preserving sequence perturbation stops changing the decay call. Predicted to be concentrated in stop+1..stop+50 with a shoulder, rather than uniform over the 3'UTR.
test: Tile stop+1..stop+500 in 42 non-overlapping 12-nt blocks; 20 dinucleotide-preserving shuffles per block, arrangement count checked per block; per-isoform gating before any aggregation. Pre-registered calibration, decided before the run: the scan must recover the stop+1..+12 block — which contains the hypothesis-1 element — as top-ranked in the PTC+ stratum. If it does not, the scan lacks the sensitivity to discover anything new and is abandoned rather than mined for whatever survives. Enrichment step afterwards: k-mer composition of top-decile versus bottom-decile blocks, matched WITHIN isoform on GC and on distance from the stop, adjudicating CU-rich (PTBP1), GA-rich, GU-rich, DRACH, and Alu-consensus k-mers against that matched null.
matched_reference: Within isoform, each block is referenced to other blocks in the same isoform matched on GC and on padding status, so the comparison never crosses isoforms. Shuffle-to-shuffle spread is the floor. The PTC- no-trigger stratum is the population reference and its profile should be flat and small; if it is not, the profile is a property of 3'UTR sequence in general and not of susceptibility.
would_refute: The fraction of isoforms whose maximum block effect lies within 50 nt of the stop is no greater than the uniform expectation from the number of blocks in that zone, AND the k-mer enrichment of top- versus bottom-decile blocks is null after within-isoform GC and distance matching. Also refuted, in a different and more useful way, if the calibration fails — a scan that cannot re-find a known effect does not get to report an unknown one.

title: The stop-to-junction distance relation is computed from channel 4, and its threshold is biological (~50 nt) rather than architectural (42 nt)
element: An exon-exon junction lying more than ~50 nt 3' of the termination codon — the RELATION between the supplied stop and the supplied junction marks, plus its dosage (marks beyond the first). Not the junction's position, which is supplied.
test: Composition-invariant channel-4 translocation. Operator T_delta moves ONE junction mark from downstream offset d to d' = d +/- delta inside the stop window, leaving channels 0-3, 5, 6-8 and all five tabular numbers bit-identical. This is the only operator in the project with a PROVABLY null composition confound: a junction mark never enters compute_rolling_gc (data_prep.py:97 reads only G/C from channels 0-3), so channel 5 is unchanged exactly, not approximately. Sweep d over 1..200 at delta in {10,25,50}, two arms: CROSSING (d <= 50 < d' or d' <= 50 < d) and NON-CROSSING (both >50, or both <=50). Dose-response Delta-logit(d) at fixed mark count locates the step. Dosage arm: add k marks at d>50 with the tabular n_downstream_ejc HELD at its true value, so the count change is sequence-only. MANDATORY INSTRUMENT GATE before any null is reportable — a forward hook records each of the 32 conv2 channels' argmax index; the branch output is fc(per-channel max), so a perturbation whose 42 nt receptive field contains no channel's argmax is EXACTLY null by construction. That is almost certainly what the reported AUG->CCC median of 0.00000 is: an exact zero cannot arise from a real change propagating through float32, so it is a dead instrument, not a null effect. Score such isoforms NOT MEASURED, never 0. Predicted liveness lies between ~4% (all 32 argmaxes coincident) and ~74% (argmaxes independent-uniform over 250 pooled positions with a ~10.5-position RF footprint); the already-measured 9x dilution implies ~11%, which this gate tests directly.
matched_reference: PRIMARY: the non-crossing translocation of identical magnitude, same isoform, same mark, same mark count, same window. Every marginal — nucleotides, GC, frame, junction count, all five tabular numbers, the other slots' inputs — is identical; only the relation to the 50 nt boundary differs. This is the general recipe for a relation claim: TRANSLOCATE, never delete, because deletion changes a marginal (the count) while translocation changes only the relation. SECOND: the mirror translocation by the same delta in the 5'-of-stop half of the stop window, where NMD biology says junctions are irrelevant. NULL SUPPORT: the permutation ensemble of all within-window translocations of magnitude delta that do not cross the threshold — an empirical null over the actual reachable edit set, not a Gaussian. POSITIVE CONTROLS that must fire or the instrument is broken: (i) set tabular n_downstream_ejc to 0 on PTC+ isoforms — must be large, given the measured 61.0%/64.4% within-structural share; (ii) delete every channel-4 mark in the stop window with the tabular held at truth — if this is null, the sequence-side junction channel is inert and every H1 null is explained by that rather than by the relation; (iii) swap the whole stop window between an NMD+ and an NMD- isoform matched on n_downstream_ejc and padding extent — must move, since the two sequence branches carry 22-41% of displacement.
would_refute: Delta_crossing indistinguishable from Delta_non-crossing at matched delta WHILE positive control (ii) is non-null (channel live) refutes the hypothesis: the model does not compute the relation from sequence and n_downstream_ejc does all the work, so the ~43% is not reconstructable. A step at 40-44 nt instead of 48-56 nt refutes the biological reading in favour of the receptive-field reading. Equal response in the mirror arm refutes 'relation' in favour of 'junction density anywhere in the window'. Flat dosage arm refutes multi-EJC additivity.

title: Stop codon identity at a PTC: UGA versus UAG by composition-exact transposition
element: The identity of the termination codon at a premature stop — specifically UGA versus UAG, reached by transposing the single purine within the codon (TGA <-> TAG).
test: Transposition operator X(Y,Z) -> X(Z,Y) on the in-frame codon at the stop-window centre (indices W/2-1, W/2, W/2+1, verified 100%). TGA <-> TAG is composition-exact: the mononucleotide multiset is unchanged, so the rolling-GC channel changes at exactly TWO window positions (i2-25 and i2+26 of the 51-base centred support of GC_ROLLING_WINDOW=50) instead of the ~51 positions any single-base substitution moves — a ~25-fold reduction of this project's dominant confounder, and checkable arithmetic rather than an assumption. Frame channels 6-8, channel 4 and all five tabular numbers are bit-identical, and the codon remains a stop, so the supplied parse is untouched. TAA is a FIXED POINT of the operator and is excluded by construction; the TAA arm is reachable only under a composition-changing operator whose control reference is already measured non-null (G_vs_notG control |t| median 5.79), so it is not claimed. Created-motif algebra, enumerated over all 64 codons: the only in-frame codons whose transposition yields a stop are the stops themselves (TAG<->TGA, TAA->TAA). In-frame created-stop exclusion is therefore VACUOUS for the control codons — unlike base substitution, where the created-motif rate is 8.7-23.6% and is frame-offset dependent. Only out-of-frame ATG creation over the +/-2 flank needs excluding; report the rate. Both directions are measured per isoform (observed->other and other->observed); their sum is the operator's own no-op and is the reported method floor. Liveness gate from H1 applies unchanged.
matched_reference: WITHIN ISOFORM: the identical transposition applied to every frame-matched in-frame non-stop codon in the same window whose positions 2 and 3 differ — ~150-300 control codons per isoform under a map that is literally the same function, at the same GC-invariance, with a vacuous in-frame exclusion. That is a far cleaner control bank than the 37 frame-matched single-base controls, whose best operator (A_vs_T) still has control |t| median 1.00 and 73% same-signed. ACROSS POPULATION: the same operator at the same anchor in the 15,765 'PTC- no trigger' isoforms. This is the DiD reference and it cancels every confounder acting equally on both classes, including the model's generic 'the window centre is a stop codon' feature and any window-geometry effect — which is exactly the failure mode that produced the two false Kozak negatives.
would_refute: Delta(PTC+) approximately equal to Delta(PTC-) refutes it: stop identity is then not an NMD-specific determinant here even if it moves the logit. Delta falling inside the within-isoform control-codon reference distribution refutes it as a stop-specific effect at all. A POSITIVE sign (TGA more NMD-susceptible than TAG) refutes the readthrough reading and would instead support the slow-termination reading, which predicts the opposite — so the pre-registered direction can genuinely fail rather than being unfalsifiable in sign.

title: Kozak strength of an upstream PTC-bearing ORF sets its initiation efficiency and therefore its trigger competence
element: The -3 purine of an UPSTREAM ORF's start codon — the Kozak context of the uORF/oORF, not of the main ORF.
test: A_vs_T single-base substitution at -3 of the slot's ATG window, channel 5 recomputed over the filled extent. A_vs_T is the ONLY operator whose control reference approaches a null in this model — measured control |t| median 1.00 with 73% same-signed, against 3.65 (purine), 4.30 (G_vs_C), 5.66 (GC_vs_AT), 5.79 (G_vs_notG), all of which are 100% same-signed at control positions and are therefore the composition gradient rather than a reference. Note that being GC-matched is NOT sufficient: G_vs_C is GC-matched and its control reference is 4.30, so 'GC-matched' cannot be assumed to imply 'null support' and must be measured per operator. Apply at the slot flagged as the most-upstream PTC-bearing ORF by build_mechanism_classes' `up` matrix, NOT at slot 0. Three populations, one operator, and the 37-position frame-matched control bank recomputed inside each: (a) upstream PTC-bearing slot in the 5,913 'PTC- uORF-PTC' isoforms; (b) upstream non-PTC slot in the 15,765 'PTC- no trigger' isoforms; (c) the 6,097 isoforms where the FULL ORFik scan finds an upstream PTC ORF but the five slots do not (fullscan_upstream_ptc & ~slot_up, already on disk). Stratify (a) by uORF (5,287) versus oORF (626). Liveness gate applies: report the fraction of isoforms in which -3 falls inside the receptive field of any conv2 argmax — a null measured at 0% liveness is an instrument state, not a biological null, and this project has twice mistaken a confounder for a negative.
matched_reference: Population (c) is the strong one and is only constructible because the full 1,540,674-ORF scan is on disk: it is matched on carrying a TRUE upstream PTC ORF and differs from (a) only in whether the model can see it. No biological confounder distinguishes (a) from (c); only model visibility does. Population (b) is matched on slot geometry and differs in trigger status. The uORF/oORF split is a second matched reference built into the class definition: their marginal NMD+ rates are 12.6% and 12.8%, so a differential SENSITIVITY between them cannot be a prevalence artifact. Method reference is the 37 frame-matched control positions; magnitude reference is the same bank's median.
would_refute: Equal Kozak sensitivity in (a) and (b) refutes trigger competence as the mechanism. Equal sensitivity in (a) and (c) refutes any uORF-specific reading — the response would then be to slot geometry, not to the uORF. Absence of an oORF/uORF gradient refutes the reinitiation-rescue distinction; state the honest prior that the identical marginal rates (12.6% vs 12.8%) are already evidence AGAINST that gradient in this dataset, so this arm is the one expected to fail. If nothing exceeds the population's own control bank on sign-reliability, the claim dies — magnitude alone is insufficient, since Kozak scored only 1.07x control on magnitude.

title: An AAUAAA hexamer 3' of the stop reduces susceptibility, tested by a permutation that leaves the GC channel bit-identical
element: The poly(A) signal hexamer AAUAAA located within a few hundred nucleotides 3' of the termination codon.
test: Composition-exact permutation of an A/T-only hexamer. AAUAAA has exactly 6 distinct permutations (enumerated), all A/T-only, so LOSS is AATAAA -> one of the 5 non-functional rearrangements and GAIN is an existing A/T-only hexamer -> AATAAA. Permuting A and T moves no G and no C, so channel 5 is BIT-IDENTICAL everywhere — an exactly composition-invariant MOTIF operator, which no base-substitution operator in this project achieves and which the dead 3-mer dinucleotide shuffle failed to be (that failure was specific to 3-mers, which have exactly one valid arrangement; a 6-mer does not). Channels 4 and 6-8 and all five tabular numbers are untouched. Exclusions: the permutation can create or destroy TAA in any frame, since TAA is A/T-only; the in-frame case is downstream of a stop and mechanically irrelevant but the model carries frame channels, so exclude and report in-frame and out-of-frame rates separately. Distance response: repeat the GAIN operator at 20, 50, 100, 200 and 400 nt downstream of the stop in the same isoform. Liveness gate applies; a 6 nt edit spans a 42+6 nt receptive field, so liveness should be measurably higher than for a single-base edit, and that difference is itself a check that the gate is behaving.
matched_reference: WITHIN ISOFORM: the same permutation applied to A/T-only hexamers at matched distance from the stop that are NOT the transcript's terminal signal (decoys), and to A/T-only hexamers in the 5'-of-stop half of the stop window. ACROSS ISOFORM: matched on distance-to-transcript-end AND on the stop window's PADDING EXTENT — this second matching is essential and is the trap the design exists to avoid, because the padding boundary in the stop window's downstream half is an exact readout of 3'UTR length and would otherwise supply the answer the motif is being credited with. The operator's own no-op (permuting a hexamer to itself) is the method floor.
would_refute: No distance dependence; loss and gain not antisymmetric; the same effect at decoy hexamers; or the effect disappearing once matched on padding extent — the last would show the model is reading 3'UTR length off the padding boundary rather than reading the motif, which is the specific spurious explanation this design is built to exclude.

title: 3'UTR length as an EJC-independent trigger, separated from the window's padding boundary
element: The stop-to-3'-end distance — the amount of sequence 3' of the termination codon, the EJC-independent counterpart of the >50 nt junction relation.
test: Filled-extent extension built from the isoform's own sequence. The stop window's downstream half carries real sequence to the transcript end and zeros thereafter, so the padding boundary is an exact readout of 3'UTR length up to W/2. Operator E extends the filled extent by L nucleotides using a dinucleotide-preserving shuffle of the isoform's own downstream window sequence, continuing the channel 6-8 frame periodicity and adding NO channel-4 marks; block length is >= 50 nt, so the 3-mer identity-map failure does not apply. Matched control C replaces an equal-length INTERNAL stretch with the same shuffled sequence WITHOUT moving the boundary. E minus C isolates 'the 3'UTR got longer' from 'the sequence content changed' — this is the length analogue of H1's translocate-don't-delete rule: change the relation while every marginal, here nucleotide composition and the number of edited bases, is held. Third arm: apply E at the ATG window's 5'-side edge, where the same instrument-level boundary move occurs and no NMD length rule exists. L in {50, 100, 200, 400}. The liveness gate is load-bearing here for a specific reason: global max pooling discards absolute position, so the branch can detect the PRESENCE of a padding boundary but not its location, which makes a graded response architecturally implausible. Pre-register binary-not-graded; if a graded response appears, that is the finding and it means position survives pooling in a way the architecture analysis says it should not.
matched_reference: C — the same content change with no boundary move, inside the same isoform, same shuffled block, same edit length. And the 5'-side application of E, which has the identical instrument-level effect (a boundary moves, a shuffled block appears) with no NMD mechanism attached. Between them these two references absorb the two spurious explanations: 'the model responded to new sequence' and 'the model responded to a moving padding edge'. The population reference is PTC+ versus PTC- no trigger, which tests the saturation prediction as a DiD.
would_refute: E approximately equal to C at every L refutes it: the model has no length-relation representation, and the class's 2.2% NMD+ is not sequence-explained. E significant on the 5' side too shows the response is to the padding boundary as an artifact rather than to 3'UTR length. A clean graded response refutes the pre-registered binary prediction and demands an architectural explanation before it can be read as biology. Equal magnitude in PTC+ and PTC- refutes saturation and argues the two triggers are independent rather than redundant.

title: H1 — Susceptibility is written in the proximal termination environment, and it is transplantable between same-parse siblings
element: The proximal 3′ termination environment: the ~150 nt immediately downstream of the stop codon (stop-anchor window indices 502–651 at W=1000), treated as a transplantable interval of nucleotide sequence. The claim is that this interval, and not the start-codon environment, carries the sequence difference between label-discordant siblings that share a parse.
test: PAIR SET (the design core; H2–H5 reuse it). (1) Universe = the 41,765 HDF5 isoforms; drop category=='no_ref_isoform' (2,334 — label deterministic by construction, brief §4) and the 278 '::' fusion ids (ambiguous gene membership). (2) Group by gene_id from ref_cds_features.tsv, which covers ENST-named and ENSG-named isoforms alike (12,613 genes). (3) Require slot 0 (orf_rank==0) to be the reference-AUG-traced ORF in BOTH siblings (is_ref_cds==1): this is literally supply-the-parse — both siblings are read at the same annotated start, so nothing in the contrast is about which ORF was picked. Measured availability: 28,723 isoforms, 3,076 label-discordant genes, 13,895 all-vs-all pairs. (4) Pre-registered matching ladder, all tiers reported: T1 all discordant (13,895 pairs/3,076 genes); T2 + same slot-0 n_downstream_ejc (2,449/849, 17.6% — reconcile against the brief's 21.9% before use, the difference is universe definition); T3 + both siblings have ≥1 downstream junction (384); T4 + stop-to-first-junction distance straddles 50 nt (111 pairs/72 genes). (5) ONE PAIR PER GENE, selected label-blind and model-blind by minimizing ‖(Δfrac_start, Δfrac_stop, Δn_downstream_ejc, Δlog tx_length)‖; the gene then IS the unit, which is what the gene-clustered bootstrap (VIF 5.47) would have cost anyway. (6) Family capping: exclude paralog-holdout genes (paralog_genes.tsv, val_paralog_genes.tsv); assign genes to families by paralog table + symbol root; cap each family at 1% of pairs; report the top-10 families' pre-cap share and a leave-one-family-out range. This matters specifically here — AS-NMD autoregulation (SRSF1–7, HNRNPs, TRA2B poison exons) is exactly the biology that manufactures within-gene label-discordant siblings, so an uncapped pair set is expected to be family-skewed and 'a discovered element' could be one family's sequence. (7) Genes never span chromosome splits, so pairs are within-split by construction; use all data, report test-only as sensitivity (per project rule, only performance metrics are test-only).  OPERATOR. Index-aligned reciprocal transplant. Both siblings' stop windows are anchored on the stop's middle base, and I verified in the HDF5 (1,000 valid ORFs, w1000, zero disagreements on shared support) that channels 6–8 are an anchor-locked period-3 phase grid identical for every ORF in both windows — so an index-aligned transplant preserves them automatically and no frame mismatch can be introduced. Transplant ONLY channels 0–3 from sibling B into sibling A over a tiling of 50 nt intervals (150 nt coarse pass first) spanning both windows; leave channel 4 as A's (the parse stays A's — 'supply the parse, swap the content'); recompute channel 5 over the filled extent exactly as measure_position_bank.py:recompute_gc does. Score all 5 members, both configurations. SATURATING ARM, run first: transplant the whole downstream half, the whole stop window, the whole ATG window, and separately the 5-number tabular block, to bound the TRANSPLANTABLE FRACTION — the ceiling for every other hypothesis in this fan-out.  DECOMPOSITION. Report each effect twice: native g(Σ α_r e_r), and the classifier-inside-the-mixture form Σ α_r g(e_r) (brief §3: costs 0.0008 AUC, no retraining, makes selection-vs-verdict exact). This separates 'the element changed this slot's verdict' from 'the element changed which slot the model listens to'.
matched_reference: Three references, one per failure mode named in brief §7.1. (i) Other positions: for every interval, the same-length interval at the mirrored distance on the 5′ side of the SAME anchor, transplanted between the SAME two siblings — same pair, same amount of sequence changed, same composition-change regime. (ii) Matched population: the sibling itself — the pair is the matched population, which is the reference that failed when 'restricting to long transcripts' changed the Kozak estimate 3.2×. (iii) Method noise floor: the identical-sequence transplants, which are exact no-ops, plus the no-op re-substitution arm in every batch. A fourth, composition-specific: a same-length interval matched on |ΔGC| between the pair, because brief §7.2 says composition dominates identity and a transplant moves composition by construction.
would_refute: A flat profile — no interval beats its mirrored control in the per-gene median; or a peak in the ATG window rather than downstream of the stop; or a transplantable fraction near zero while the tabular-block transplant alone closes the gap. That last outcome says the same-parse discordance is not sequence-resident at the model's resolution at all, which is a clean negative and the honest ceiling statement for the entire discovery program. Reciprocity is also a refutation channel: the two transplant directions must be opposite in sign and comparable in magnitude; a one-sided effect is a sequence-quality artifact (e.g. B's sequence is simply more padded or more GC-extreme), not an element.

title: H2 — The stop-to-first-downstream-junction distance is the element, and the model's threshold is set by the receptive field, not by 50 nt
element: d1 — the interval in nucleotides between the stop codon and the nearest downstream exon–exon junction. A RELATION between two supplied landmarks, not the location of either. This is the ~43% of the decision currently handed to the model as n_downstream_ejc.
test: JUNCTION-MARK SLIDE. For every isoform with a slot-0 downstream junction (7,912 ref-anchored isoforms, measured), move the FIRST downstream junction mark in channel 4 of the stop window from its true index to d ∈ {3, 6, …, 300}, in 3 nt steps so the mark's codon phase against the anchor-locked frame grid is held constant (plus a separate ±1 nt phase probe to measure whether phase matters at all). Hold constant: the number of marks in the window, the tabular n_downstream_ejc at its true value, and every nucleotide. THIS OPERATOR CHANGES COMPOSITION BY EXACTLY ZERO — channels 0–3 and 5 are untouched by construction — which removes the confound that brief §7.2 says has dominated every previous positional measurement here, and it does so by construction rather than by matching. Fit each isoform's step location from the maximum of a smoothed first difference. ESCALATION if it comes out flat: retrain with the tabular block reduced 5→4 by DELETING the n_downstream_ejc column (an input-dimension change, explicitly not the dead 'naive zeroing' operator, which leaves a weight with identically zero gradient). PAIRED ARM (confirmatory, not headline — it is underpowered and I measured exactly how much): T4 pairs, 111 pairs across 72 genes, where the two siblings share slot-0 n_downstream_ejc but their d1 straddles 50 nt; test whether the within-pair sign of Δlogit follows the straddle direction, by sign test over the 72 genes.
matched_reference: (i) The same slide applied to the SECOND downstream junction mark, which crosses no threshold and must be flat — same channel, same operation, same isoform. (ii) The same slide applied to a junction mark in the ATG window relative to the AUG anchor, where no such biological rule exists. (iii) A phantom-mark arm: add a mark at the same d values in isoforms with n_downstream_ejc==0, testing whether the window's mark alone produces the effect while the tabular count disagrees — this separates 'the sequence window computes the relation' from 'the window modulates a decision the tabular feature already made'. (iv) Noise floor: the d-equals-true-position arm is an exact no-op.
would_refute: Flat curves; amplitudes at the method floor; or an inflection located at the window edge rather than near 42–50 nt, which would mean the model counts marks inside the window rather than measuring distance — distinguishable because the slide holds the count constant. Any of these says the relation carrying ~43% of the decision is NOT recoverable from sequence at this architecture. That is the negative Pete's narrower argument is built to be able to return, and it is the strongest available justification for the one retrain worth running.

title: H3 — The stop tetranucleotide modulates susceptibility at a fixed parse, and only where the stop is EJC-triggering
element: The stop tetranucleotide: stop codon identity (TAA/TAG/TGA) plus the immediately 3′ base — the readthrough/termination-efficiency context of a stop whose location is supplied.
test: Two composition-exact operators, applied within the SPS pair set from H1 and read as a within-pair difference-in-differences. (1) TAG ↔ TGA IS AN ANAGRAM — the same multiset {T,A,G} — so channel 5 is invariant by construction and mononucleotide composition is exactly untouched, while codon identity and dinucleotide content change. State explicitly that this is NOT the dead dinucleotide-preserving 3-mer shuffle (which is the identity map on all 64 3-mers); it is a named permutation, chosen because it happens to be composition-exact. TAA is run as a third arm with its one-base GC change declared. (2) The +4 base under G_vs_C and A_vs_T — the two GC-matched operator classes already measured to have a control reference approaching null (control |t| median 1.00 for A_vs_T against 5.79 for G_vs_notG). Created-motif exclusion as already implemented in measure_position_bank.py, with its known frame-offset asymmetry (23.6% vs 8.7%). INTERACTION ARM, which is the real test: apply the same operator to a slot whose stop has a downstream junction and to a different slot in the SAME isoform whose stop does not. That contrast is isoform-matched, so everything that differs between transcripts cancels.
matched_reference: The identical anagram permutation applied to the two codons immediately 3′ and the codon immediately 5′ of the stop — frame-matched, same permutation, composition change of exactly zero, same created-motif screening. Plus the existing 37-position frame-matched control bank (19 upstream, 18 downstream) for the +4 operators. Population reference: the non-triggering slot in the same isoform. Method floor: the observed-base no-op arm in every batch.
would_refute: TAG and TGA indistinguishable beyond the frame-matched controls at every stratum; no +4 effect under either GC-matched operator; or — most informative — a main effect with NO dependence on the slot's PTC status, which would say the model has a generic sequence preference at the stop anchor rather than a representation of termination. The observational arm is thin by construction and I measured it: only 410 same-EJC-count discordant pairs across 212 genes differ in slot-0 stop identity, so it is declared confirmatory in advance and cannot rescue a null causal arm.

title: H4 — A polyadenylation signal close downstream of the stop suppresses the verdict; the element is the hexamer and its distance from the stop
element: The canonical polyadenylation signal AAUAAA/AUUAAA occurring within the stop window's downstream half, and the stop-to-PAS distance. A discrete 6-mer with an exact composition-preserving control (its own anagram).
test: ANAGRAM-CONTROLLED HEXAMER SWAP. At offsets δ ∈ {30, 60, 120, 240, 480} nt downstream of the slot-0 stop, replace the native 6 nt with (arm 1) AATAAA or (arm 2) a fixed non-PAS permutation of the same letters, e.g. ATAAAA. Both arms overwrite the identical native 6 nt and have identical mononucleotide composition, so the arm1-minus-arm2 contrast is composition-exact and channel 5 is bitwise identical between arms — the composition confound is removed by construction rather than by matching. DESTRUCTION ARM: in isoforms carrying an annotated proximal PAS inside the window, permute the native hexamer to its non-PAS anagram; PAS annotations already exist in the pipeline (SQANTI polyA_motif / polyA_dist, joined by 09_export_polya.py). OBSERVATIONAL ARM: within SPS pairs, Δ(polyA_dist) versus the label direction — these pairs are generated by alternative last exons and APA, which is exactly the natural experiment. INTERACTION ARM: the same insertion in isoforms whose slot-0 stop has NO downstream junction, where poly(A) proximity should be mechanistically irrelevant.
matched_reference: Primary: the anagram arm at the SAME site in the SAME isoform — mononucleotide-exact, so this is the strongest matched reference available in this project and it is available only because the element is a motif with non-functional permutations. Secondary: the same insertion into non-triggering-stop isoforms (population reference). Tertiary: insertion at δ beyond the window's reach is impossible, so the far-δ arm serves as the distance null. Floor: overwriting the native 6 nt with itself is an exact no-op.
would_refute: PAS and its anagram move the model identically at every δ, i.e. the model does not encode poly(A) proximity despite having the input to learn it — a clean, interpretable negative about a real determinant. Stated caveat that bounds this hypothesis up front: I measured the median 3′UTR length in the ref-anchored slot-0 population at 1,339 nt, while the W=1000 stop window reaches only +500 — so the NATIVE PAS is outside the model's view for most isoforms. The insertion arm is therefore primary, the destruction and observational arms are restricted to short-3′UTR isoforms, and W=2000 (+1000 nt of reach) is the pre-registered sensitivity configuration. If the effect exists only at W=2000, that is a statement about window width, not about biology, and must be reported as such.

title: H5 — uORF initiation efficiency: Kozak strength at a competing upstream start decides whether that ORF's stop is treated as a trigger
element: The −3 purine and +4 G at the start codon of a NON-slot-0, upstream ORF — the initiation-efficiency context of a competing ORF whose position is supplied.
test: A_vs_T at −3 and G_vs_C at +4 applied to the ATG window of UPSTREAM ORF slots (never slot 0), on the H1 SPS pair set restricted to pairs whose slot-0 parse is identical and whose 5′UTR content differs. Stratify by three variables that are already known or suspected to move the sign: (a) the perturbed slot's own PTC status (already measured: +0.0087 where the perturbed slot's stop is EJC-triggering vs −0.0001 where it is not, at matched attention); (b) the slot's attention weight (already measured to reverse: +0.0058 middle tercile, −0.0024 top); (c) uORF class from mechanism_classes.tsv — 5′UTR-terminating uORF vs out-of-frame oORF, 89.4%/10.6% of the visible upstream-PTC population. Created-AUG exclusion at −3 (known 4.0% rate) as already implemented. Competition arm: repeat for the 5′-most upstream ORF versus one lying downstream of a stronger-Kozak competitor, which tests scanning order rather than motif presence.
matched_reference: (i) The identical operator at slot 0's −3/+4 in the same isoforms — same window type, same anchor-relative index, different slot: an internal control that holds isoform, composition regime, and created-motif regime fixed. (ii) The 37-position frame-matched control bank rebuilt inside the perturbed slot's own window (frame matching is load-bearing: exclusion rate 23.6% vs 8.7% across codon offsets). (iii) Population reference: the sibling. (iv) Floor: the observed-base no-op.
would_refute: No ordering across the three strata; or an effect indistinguishable in size from slot 0's, meaning the model treats every slot's start context identically and initiation efficiency is not represented; or an effect that survives only in the pooled estimate and vanishes in every stratum, which would mean the pooled number was averaging opposing populations, as already happened for the −3 attention terciles. Two hard ceilings stated in advance rather than discovered later: (a) without ribosome profiling the only ground truth for which ORF is translated is GENCODE traced through the isoform, so a positive result reads as 'predicts the annotated/scanned parse', not 'predicts ribosome selection'; (b) half the true upstream-PTC population is invisible to the model (12,010 in the full scan vs 5,913 in the slots) and the invisible half is the weak half (3.9% vs 12.6% NMD+), so any estimate is biased toward strong triggers and the negative direction cannot be claimed for weak ones.
